jobs.title: Embedded Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At DeWarmte, we develop technology that helps homes move away from gas. Our heat pumps combine hardware, embedded control software, cloud services and data – and the quality of the software connecting those elements directly determines how well our products perform in customers’ homes.


We are looking for an experienced Embedded Controls Software Engineer to develop and evolve the software that operates our heat pumps and, increasingly, a broader range of connected energy devices. As part of our Control & Data team, you will work directly on production software, refine control algorithms, improve product performance and help shape the next generation of our embedded software platform.


This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software, hardware, control engineering and energy systems. You will work on technology that is already operating in customers’ homes while building the technical foundations for future products and use cases.

Your mission

Build reliable, efficient and extensible control software that enables our products to operate intelligently in an increasingly connected and flexible energy system.
You will inherit working software already deployed in the field. Your job is to understand it deeply, maintain and improve it, and progressively evolve its architecture to support new products, control strategies and regulatory requirements.
Together with the Lead Controls & Data Engineer and our Hardware R&D team, you will help build an embedded software platform that can scale with DeWarmte’s ambitions.

What you will do

Maintain and improve our control software

  • Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps.

  • Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality.

  • Develop, refine and validate control algorithms to improve product performance, stability, safety, energy efficiency and customer comfort.

  • Use operational data and real-world measurements to understand product behaviour and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Diagnose complex behaviour across software, electronics, sensors, hydraulics and the physical installation.

  • Improve automated testing, simulation, observability and release practices.

  • Help ensure reliable operation of both newly developed products and our existing installed fleet.

Evolve our embedded software platform

  • Contribute to the architecture and technical evolution of our on-device software stack.

  • Gradually migrate our existing Python-based control software to a compiled systems programming language, with Rust as the preferred direction.

  • Improve software maintainability, runtime reliability, resource efficiency and testability while preserving proven control behaviour.

  • Develop and extend our over-the-air (OTA) software update mechanisms, enabling reliable and controlled software deployments across our connected device fleet.

  • Contribute to the development of our next-generation embedded hardware configuration, working closely with our Hardware R&D colleagues on hardware-software integration and platform design.

  • Establish clear interfaces and reusable software components that allow the platform to evolve without unnecessary complexity.

Expand our control capabilities

  • Extend our control software to support new devices, product configurations and energy management use cases.

  • Develop control strategies that respond to external signals, dynamic energy prices, grid constraints and demand-side flexibility opportunities.

  • Translate evolving regulatory requirements and interoperability standards into robust, testable software functionality.

  • Develop interfaces that enable our products to interact with external energy management systems, other connected devices and third-party services.

  • Help balance energy efficiency, customer comfort, equipment longevity and flexibility in our control strategies.

Work across the product

You will collaborate closely with colleagues in hardware, software, data, product development, assembly, installation and service. You will help resolve immediate customer and operational issues while protecting the long-term quality of our software platform.

You will actively contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, documentation and shared engineering practices, ensuring that our software can be understood, maintained and evolved by the entire team.

What success looks like in your first month

  • You develop a solid understanding of our existing heat pump control software, development workflows and embedded environment.

  • You become familiar with the physical behaviour of our products and the interfaces between software and hardware.

  • You actively contribute to day-to-day software development, debugging and maintenance.

  • By the end of your first month, you are able to independently drive the development of new control functionality, with support from the wider team where needed.

In the following months

  • You take increasing technical ownership of our on-device control software.

  • You independently design, implement, test and deploy improvements to our control algorithms and functionality.

  • You contribute to measurable improvements in product reliability, performance and software quality.

  • You help define and validate the architecture for migrating our Python-based control software to a compiled language.

  • You begin extending and improving our OTA software update mechanisms.

As the role develops

  • You drive the progressive migration of our control software towards a modern, robust and maintainable systems programming stack.

  • New control functionality can be delivered predictably and safely across our installed fleet.

  • You contribute to the design, development and validation of our next-generation embedded hardware and software platform.

  • Our control software supports an increasingly diverse range of devices, regulatory requirements, interoperability standards and energy management use cases.

  • Critical software components are well documented, thoroughly tested and understood by more than one engineer.

  • You become a key technical contributor to the evolution of DeWarmte’s control software platform.

What we are looking for

Essential experiences and skills

  • Several years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally at mid- to senior level, including experience with production systems.

  • Practical experience developing, implementing and validating control algorithms for physical products, machines or energy systems.

  • Practical experience with HVAC systems, thermal energy systems or controllable energy assets in the context of demand-side flexibility, including an understanding of their physical behaviour and operational constraints.

  • Experience developing software in embedded or hardware-connected environments.

  • Hands-on experience with a modern systems programming language such as Rust or Go. Extensive experience with C, C++ or comparable low-level languages is also relevant, provided you are willing and able to transition to a modern systems programming stack.

  • A good working knowledge of Python and the ability to understand, maintain and evolve an existing Python codebase.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD workflows.

  • The ability to reason across software, hardware and physical-system behaviour and systematically diagnose complex problems.

  • Comfort working with modern LLM-based and agentic software development tools and workflows, while maintaining a high standard of engineering quality, code review and verification.

  • The ability to take functionality through the complete development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment and real-world operation.

Additional valuable experience

  • Embedded Linux development, particularly experience with Yocto or Buildroot, custom system images and embedded Linux deployment workflows.

  • Direct experience developing control software or control algorithms for heat pumps.

  • Experience with OTA software updates, connected-device fleet management and reliable software deployment to remotely operated devices.

  • Familiarity with industrial or energy-sector communication protocols, interoperability standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, control system modelling or optimisation.

  • Experience with front-end paradigms and languages, whether web-based or native, preferably using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks.

We do not expect you to bring experience in every one of these areas. We value strong software and control engineering fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly develop a deep understanding of complex physical products.

How you work

  • You take ownership of problems from initial investigation through to implementation, validation and deployment.

  • You enjoy working at the intersection of software and the physical world and are interested in understanding why a system behaves the way it does.

  • You solve urgent problems without allowing permanent workarounds to become the architecture.

  • You balance pragmatic improvements today with the technical investments needed to scale tomorrow.

  • You use modern development tools, including AI-assisted and agentic workflows, to work effectively without compromising reliability or your understanding of the software.

  • You explain complex technical matters clearly to people with different backgrounds.

  • You share knowledge by default and build software that other engineers can intuitively understand, easily test and safely change.

  • You are comfortable switching between debugging a specific installation, refining a control algorithm and developing the architecture for our next generation of products.

What you will get

  • Direct influence on technology that contributes to the energy transition.

  • Ownership of software that sits at the heart of a real physical product.

  • The opportunity to work on challenging problems at the intersection of embedded software, control engineering and energy systems.

  • The opportunity to shape the transition towards a modern embedded software platform

  • A role that starts deeply hands-on and grows into broader technical ownership and architectural responsibility.

  • Close collaboration with colleagues across the complete product lifecycle.

What we offer

  • A monthly gross salary between €4.500 and €6.000, based on full-time.

  • 27 vacation days plus 8% holiday allowance.

  • Participation in our SAR (Stock Appreciation Rights) programme.

  • Plenty of ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to shape products that directly contribute to the energy transition.

  • A talented, ambitious, and highly collaborative team.

  • A healthy daily lunch at the office.

  • Laptop and everything you need to do your best work.

  • Regular team events, company drinks, our annual beach day, and winter trip.

  • Lots of room to grow, develop yourself, and make a lasting impact.

Interested?

Do you want to build intelligent control software for real physical products and help shape the next generation of connected, energy-efficient heating and energy systems?

We would like to meet you!

Compensation: €4.5K – €6K per month

  • • €4.5K – €6K per month

jobs.title: Head of Operational Integration
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Acquisitions are our second growth path. We buy established industrial distribution businesses in the EUR 20-40M revenue range, owners and management stay on board, and we connect them to our platform, our procurement, our financing lines and our AI stack. Three deals are live, two are close to signature, and at run rate we intend to close around five per year out of a mapped universe of roughly 200 targets.

Role Overview

You own what happens after signing.

Origination, valuation and deal execution sit with the CEO and our senior M&A advisor. Your mandate starts the day a company becomes part of Andercore and it ends when that company runs better than it did before.

These are analog businesses. Fifteen years old, owner-led, hemdsärmelig, a well-run P&L and almost no technology underneath it. They are profitable, they are growing, and they are at their operational limit. Our hypothesis is that our platform, our purchasing power, our credit facilities and our automation take them past that limit. Your job is to find out on the ground whether that hypothesis holds, in which order, and at what pace - and then to make it happen with the management team, not to them.

We do not arrive as the saviour with the AI magic box. We say so explicitly to every seller, and you will hold that line.

What You Will Own

Holding Management from Day 1

  • Access to accounting and financials from day one, monthly numbers on a fixed close, one reporting framework across all acquired entities.

  • Set the baseline: revenue, margin, working capital, cash, customer and supplier concentration. No opinion without the number behind it.

  • Pick up the commitments made during due diligence and turn them into the operating rhythm of the first 100 days.

  • Run the portfolio as a financial participation first. Both companies are growing. Do not put anything into a skid.

On-the-Ground Diagnosis

  • Spend real time inside the acquired businesses and find out where they actually stand, which is never where they say they stand.

  • Map the connection points: procurement, pricing, inventory, sales productivity, logistics, financing, ERP, reporting.

  • Test our integration theses against reality, quantify the ones that hold, kill the ones that do not, and bring the correction back to the CEO fast.

Value Creation

  • Sequence and land the levers with the management team: central procurement, our credit and working-capital facilities, pricing, sales productivity, customer intelligence, automation of manual back office.

  • Decide with the CEO what gets centralized, what stays entrepreneurial, and what we take from them - the flow runs in both directions, several of these companies do things better than we do.

  • Track every lever against the original investment case in euros.

Owner and Management Relationship

  • Be the peer of a Geschäftsführer who built a EUR 30M business himself. Credibility comes from having done operating work, not from a framework.

  • Be the one who checks whether things are as good as they are described, and who says it out loud when they are not. The CEO stays the partner; you bring the uncomfortable version.

  • Manage expectations in the other direction too: we are not a service provider that solves the acquired company's problems for it.

Playbook and Team

  • Codify integration into a repeatable capability: Day-1 checklist, reporting standard, diagnostic framework, lever library, 100-day plan.

  • Make the fourth acquisition faster than the first, then build and lead the team that runs them in parallel.

Scope Boundaries / What This Role Is Not

  • Not M&A. No origination, no valuation, no LOI, no SPA. That sits with the CEO and our senior M&A advisor.

  • Not a PMO. Nobody here sends a 400-line integration plan with traffic lights to an owner-manager. That gets you thrown out of the room, correctly.

  • Not a consulting engagement. You are measured on the numbers of the acquired companies, not on the quality of the analysis.

  • Not a corporate integration role. These are not hierarchical organizations that execute what the centre decides.

  • Not a process you inherit. There is none yet. You build it.

What We Are Looking For

You are an operator out of a private equity value-creation or portfolio operations team, or a generalist from strategy and transformation with real time spent inside operating companies. Roughly eight to twelve years in.

You bring:

  • At least one integration or post-close situation you personally carried, where you can name the specific knotty problem you solved and why it worked. We will ask for that story in the first interview.

  • Operating substance: you have sat in procurement, pricing, supply chain, finance or sales of a real company, not only next to it.

  • Geländegängigkeit. You are comfortable with an entrepreneur who is highly intelligent, rough around the edges, and holds two cars and a boat inside the company. Nothing about that scenario throws you.

  • People work as roughly half the job. Influence without formal authority, because these managing directors did not sign up to be managed.

  • A strong observer. You read a business and a person quickly and accurately.

  • Fluent German and English. German is not optional; these conversations happen in German.

  • Fluency with modern AI tooling and the instinct to automate your own work. You do not need to be an engineer.

You do not need five PMI programmes on your CV. We would rather you had none than that you learned to fill in lists instead of thinking.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • Every acquired entity reports monthly on one framework, on a fixed close, with us having access to accounting.

  • Each acquisition has its integration thesis validated or killed with numbers within 90 days of closing.

  • The acquired businesses keep growing. No customer, supplier or key person lost to the transaction.

  • The first value-creation levers are live and their P&L impact is measurable in euros.

  • A documented playbook exists, and the next integration starts faster than the last.

Over time you own integration and value creation for the whole group at a pace of several acquisitions per year, and build the team that delivers it.

Package

  • Fixed base plus a variable component tied directly to the success of each integration.

  • Virtual equity in Andercore at the current strike, with meaningful upside if we build what we intend to build.

  • Direct work with the Founder & CEO, the M&A advisor, the Board and our investors.

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Role Overview

As VP Engineering, you own the Engineering organization and turn our platform and AI vision into shipped systems. You report to the Chief Product Officer and partner closely with product, commercial, operations, and finance. You lead our Senior Product Engineers, Staff Engineers and QA, and work closely with our product managers, who own product and design.

This is an execution mandate. You carve our core systems into a modern platform, build our AI agents into one holistic system that runs the trade lifecycle end-to-end, and scale the teams that deliver it. You inherit a working machine at full speed: your job is to rebuild it in flight without losing a day of momentum. In your first year, the priorities are the carve-out of our transaction core and bringing our AI agents into one orchestrating layer.

Key Responsibilities

AI and Automation

  • Build our AI agents into one holistic, orchestrating AI layer across sourcing, pricing, quoting, sales, logistics, and financing.

  • Drive automation of the full transaction lifecycle, and own automation-rate and no touch-quote targets as first-class delivery KPIs.

  • Work with our data team, which sits with the CPO, on systems that make our trade flows a compounding advantage, so every transaction makes the system smarter.

  • Keep us at the practical frontier of agentic AI: ship what creates leverage now, skip what is demo-ware.

  • Put the guardrails, evals, and human-in-the loop controls in place so automation stays reliable where it matters most: money touching and customer-facing paths, where a wrong output is a real loss, not just a bug.

Platform and Architecture

  • Own execution of the target architecture for the Andercore platform, the system of record for industrial trade.

  • Lead the carve-out of our transaction core into a modern, modular light ERP (a lean core system for our trade transactions), with a clear migration path and zero disruption to daily trading.

  • Shape the role of Salesforce in our landscape: decide what stays on the platform, what moves to the new core, and how the two work together.

  • Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls within the platform strategy and keep technology cost per transaction on a falling curve.

  • Make new-market launch a repeatable platform motion: multiple geographies, currencies, languages, and compliance regimes, built in rather than bolted on.

  • Keep the platform ready to pass technical due diligence at any moment: architecture, data, and security in shape for the next financing round.

Engineering Organization and Talent

  • Lead the Engineering organization: onsite talent in Berlin and a nearshoring team. Team structure and ways of working stay in-house, and you manage the nearshoring team directly and actively, not at arm's length through a vendor.

  • Build lean by default. The goal is not to grow headcount but to build a small, high-leverage team and raise output through AI across the engineering workflow. You lead as an AI-first engineering leader.

  • Hire and develop senior engineering leaders, including 1–2 Staff Engineers who report to you and own architecture across teams, and raise the talent bar with every hire.

  • Build an engineering culture of ownership, speed, and craftsmanship: small teams, high leverage, no bureaucracy.

  • Stay hands-on: review designs with your Staff Engineers, pair on the hardest problems, unblock teams, and keep decisions close to the code.

Enablement and Data Integrity

  • Enable business teams to build and automate with AI safely. Set the paved paths, standards, and review practices that let non-engineers move fast without compromising quality, security, or the systems underneath.

  • Partner with the CPO, who owns data, on data integrity: build systems that keep one source of truth with clear access and quality controls, so that faster building never degrades the data the company runs on.

  • Make speed and safety one operating model, not a trade-off, and communicate it across the company so every team knows how to move quickly within clear boundaries.

Delivery and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as technical sparring partner to the CPO on architecture, roadmap feasibility, and sequencing.

  • Translate the product roadmap into shipped software, and turn front-line needs from commercial and operations into delivery.

  • Support the CPO and CEO in technical due diligence with a clear, numbers-backed view of architecture, data, and AI.

  • Communicate technical priorities and trade-offs transparently across the company, so everyone understands what we build and why.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering operates with clear ownership and no loss of delivery speed.

  • Our transaction core runs on a modern, modular platform: the carve-out is live and the migration path is executed.

  • One orchestrating AI system increases automation rate and transactions per employee, quarter over quarter.

  • Technology cost per transaction falls while volume grows.

  • Architecture, systems, and AI stand up to any technical due diligence.

  • Hiring runs fast and consistently: senior hires close within six weeks, with one bar across interviewers.

What You Bring

  • Senior engineering leadership at scale, having run and grown multi-team organizations, ideally across more than one location.

  • Deep experience with transactional platforms, ERP-style systems, or comparable systems of record, ideally including regulated financial flows such as payments, lending, or KYC, and re-platforming or carve-outs in a live environment.

  • Hands-on track record shipping AI or ML in production, with a real sense for where agentic AI creates leverage today.

  • A demonstrated AI-first, lean mindset: you have applied AI in your own engineering organization to raise output without growing headcount, not just talked about it.

  • Strong architectural judgment, with security and data protection built into your decisions, and enough technical depth to stay close to the code.

  • The judgment to know where reliability must be absolute and where speed wins: you move fast on everything reversible and hold a high correctness bar on the irreversible, money-touching paths.

  • A plus: a track record of enabling non-engineering teams to build safely with AI, balancing speed

  • against quality and data integrity, and the communication skills to carry that across a whole company.

  • A plus: comfort in a company where operations come first and software follows, turning manual services into products.

  • A commercial mindset: you anchor engineering decisions in unit economics, working capital, and speed for buyers and suppliers.

  • A plus: experience with Salesforce as part of a larger system landscape.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin

  • Process: conversations with the CPO, the CEO, Chief of Staff, and members of the engineering team.

Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

We are a special projects team within Proxima’s engineering organisation, using software and computation to fundamentally change how complex machines are designed and built. We take on problems where a small team can deliver a step change in capability, with the goal of getting a stellarator connected to the grid as fast as possible.

As a Computational Engineer, you will bring together mechanical engineering experience and strong software development skills. You will work at the intersection of AI and computational engineering, developing approaches to problems that established tools cannot currently solve.

You will build things yourself: formulate problems, develop algorithms, write software, and test it against real engineering needs. Your experience with hardware will help you see what really moves the needle.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Make new engineering approaches possible. Build CAD-as-code representations, geometry algorithms, and physical models for problems that established tools cannot handle.

  • Enable rapid iteration. Build computational methods to propagate and assess hardware design changes at the speed of software development.

  • Develop agent-driven engineering workflows. Build harnesses and APIs that allow AI to contribute to our mechanical design in radically new ways.

  • Make engineering tools work together. Connect CAD, PDM, and PLM systems with computational workflows so engineers and agents can use information across tool boundaries.

  • Stay at the frontier and help to move it. Follow advances in AI and computational engineering, test promising ideas quickly, and develop new approaches where existing methods fall short.

  • Ship early and iterate fast. Work side by side with fast-paced engineering teams, put working tools into their hands early, and improve them through short feedback cycles on real projects.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong Python development skills, demonstrated through substantial engineering tools or computational models.

  • Experience taking mechanical hardware into manufacture, assembly, or test.

  • Depth in mechanical design, analysis, manufacturing, or integration.

  • The ability to reason from first principles and tackle problems without established solutions.

  • Care for software quality, usability, and adoption.

  • Ambition, initiative, and a focus on getting hardware delivered.

  • Understanding of finite element methods, including modelling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh convergence, and validation.

  • Experience with some of the following: CAD-as-code, PDM/PLM systems, HPC or cloud computing, and AI agents.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. jobs.title: Scientist, Model Validation and Experimental Data Analysis
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


TEAM AND ROLE

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will make Proxima's plasma simulation stack trustworthy by confronting it with reality. Every prediction we make for Alpha – Proxima's Q>1 experimental stellarator – and for Stellaris, our commercial power plant, rests on models whose credibility has to be earned against real measurements from an operating device.

W7-X is where we earn it. You will take our integrated modeling framework, FUS3, and our Bayesian plasma state estimation workflow to W7-X data: reconstruct the plasma state from diagnostic measurements, compare our predictive models against what the machine actually did, and turn the discrepancies into a prioritized map of where our physics is right, where it is not, and what we must fix before Alpha's first plasma. Modeling sits on Alpha's operational critical path and cannot be backfilled after first plasma – this role is how we get ahead of it.

You will be the person in the group who lives at the intersection of modeling and experiment: fluent enough in the physics to know what a model should predict, and close enough to the diagnostics to know what the data can actually support.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validate Proxima's predictive plasma models against W7-X experimental data – neoclassical and turbulent transport, 3D equilibrium, ECRH deposition, pellet fueling and drift, bootstrap current and iota evolution – and record each comparison as a reproducible validation report with quantitative agreement metrics, stated limitations, and a pinned regression test

  • Reconstruct the plasma state from real diagnostic measurements using our time-dependent Bayesian state-estimation workflow (Thomson scattering, interferometry, CXRS, ECE, XICS, bolometry, magnetics), with calibrated uncertainties, and benchmark it against established analyses such as Minerva/IDA reconstructions and ASTRA power-balance results

  • Work with raw and pre-processed diagnostic data, not just analyzed profiles – instrument geometry, sightlines, calibrations and the caveats that come with them – and own the forward models, noise models and profile fits that feed transport analysis

  • Validate against databases of discharges rather than single shots, across W7-X magnetic configurations and operating regimes, so the output is a map of model applicability and parameter trends rather than one-off discrepancy reports

  • Act as a technical interface to W7-X and IPP: scope and prioritize data requests, spend time on site in Greifswald working alongside diagnosticians and operators, and propose and support experiments that directly target our model gaps

  • Feed validation back into design – convert diagnostic placement and observability studies on W7-X into requirements for Alpha's diagnostic set, and into realistic uncertainty models for the synthetic measurements we use to design against

  • Extend the modeling stack itself: mappers from experimental archives into IMAS, synthetic diagnostics, and analysis workflows, so that interpreting a shot end-to-end – raw data to reconstructed plasma state to physics quantities – runs in minutes and is reproducible by anyone in the group

  • As Alpha approaches operation, help stand up the between-shot analysis loop that will run on day one

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD in plasma physics, fusion science, or a closely related discipline

  • Hands-on experience with experimental data from a magnetic confinement device – you have dealt with diagnostics, calibrations, systematic errors, and all the ways real data is messier than simulation output

  • Experience reconstructing the plasma state from measurements: profile fitting, integrated data analysis, equilibrium reconstruction, or power and particle balance analysis

  • Strong grounding in transport, equilibrium, and heating physics – enough to tell a code bug from a physics discovery

  • Rigorous about uncertainty; you treat a validation claim without error bars on both sides as incomplete

  • Comfortable writing and maintaining scientific software – version control, testing, and reproducibility are habits, not overhead

  • Can communicate effectively with physicists, diagnosticians, engineers, and experimentalists, and work productively inside an external collaboration

  • Self-directed; able to identify what needs to be done and execute

  • Willing to travel regularly to Greifswald, and later to the Alpha site

NICE TO HAVE

  • W7-X experience - operations, diagnostics, or data analysis, and familiarity with the W7-X data archive and Minerva

  • Stellarator physics background

  • Bayesian inference, uncertainty quantification, or machine learning applied to experimental data

  • Experience with integrated modeling and transport codes (FUSE, OMFIT, ASTRA, TRANSP, FUSE, JINTRAC, or similar) and with neoclassical (SFINCS, DKES, NEO) or gyrokinetic (GENE, CGYRO, GX, or similar) codes

  • Julia and Python programming – our integrated modeling framework is written in Julia

  • Familiarity with the IMAS data model

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

  • A track record of published validation studies or successful experimental proposals

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

jobs.title: Infirmier (H/F)

jobs.description: Envie de varier vos expériences professionnelles tout en mettant vos compétences au service des patients ? La complémentarité des compétences, la coordination des soins et le respect des bonnes pratiques sont au coeur du fonctionnement de l'établissement.Dans le cadre de besoins ponctuels, nous recherchons un.e Infirmier.e diplômé.e d'État pour des vacations, souhaitant mettre son savoir-faire et ses qualités humaines au service des patients.En tant qu'infirmier.e, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans le parcours de soins et contribuez chaque jour à la qualité et à la sécurité de la prise en charge.Vos principales missions seront de :- Réaliser les soins infirmiers prescrits et relevant de votre rôle propre, dans le respect des protocoles en vigueur.- Surveiller l'état de santé des patients et identifier toute évolution nécessitant une intervention.- Préparer et administrer les traitements, tout en assurant le suivi de leurs effets.- Assurer la traçabilité des soins et la mise à jour des dossiers patients.- Informer, écouter et accompagner les patients tout au long de leur prise en charge.- Collaborer avec les médecins, les aides-soignants et les autres professionnels de santé.- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et de prévention des risques.Votre quotidien sera rythmé par la technicité des soins, le travail en équipe et une dimension humaine essentielle.   Vous êtes infirmier.e diplômé.e d'État, rigoureux.se, autonome et à l'aise dans la prise en charge de patients présentant des pathologies chroniques ou plusieurs problématiques de santé. Vous êtes inscrits au Conseil de l'Ordre en France. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe, la relation humaine et le suivi des patients dans la durée. Votre capacité d'adaptation et votre sens de l'écoute seront de véritables atouts pour cette mission. Vous cherchez une mission où le soin ne se résume pas à un acte, mais s'inscrit dans un véritable accompagnement ? N'hésitez plus, contactez-nous et rejoignez nos équipes !

jobs.title: Market Lead DACH / Senior Account Executive
jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we?


We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu is looking for a Senior Account Executive / Market Lead to open the German market for our direct sales channel. You are the first Aquablu seller on the ground in Germany and you own the market end-to-end: you generate the pipeline, close the deals, work directly with our Facility Management and Contract Catering partners, and shape how we go to market in Germany.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with a clear entrepreneurial mandate: build. It is designed for a country builder or a former sales manager who wants to go back into a closing seat, own a market, and grow into leading the German team once the numbers justify it.

You are based in or around Frankfurt am Main, Berlin or Cologne/Düsseldorf.

What you'll do

Germany is yours to build

  • Own the German direct territory and build the pipeline that hits target. Work your named accounts, run your own outbound into end clients and the FM/CM layer, answer inbound within SLA, and qualify every meeting your BDR books.

  • Run the full cycle with SPICED. You'll lead discovery, demo to every stakeholder in the room, set up pilots with success criteria agreed upfront, and take Pay-Per-Drink proposals through negotiation to signature. HubSpot stays current, and your monthly forecast holds up when someone pushes on it.

  • Shape the German go-to-market plan with Marketing, from positioning and ABM to content and events. Sit down together every month and read the funnel.

  • Write the German playbook and make it the way the team sells. Coach the BDR Germany, build the case for the next German hires, and be ready to lead them when they arrive.

About you

  • 6–10 years of B2B full-cycle sales, with a proven record of carrying and beating a new-business target in a recurring-revenue or hardware-enabled-SaaS model

  • You have built before: opened a country, region or segment, or led a sales team and you now want to own a market as an individual contributor with a path to lead it

  • Fluent German, business-fluent English: you sell and contract in German and work in English with the Amsterdam team

  • Customer-centric seller: you run a structured, SPICED-based process from discovery to decision — you diagnose the customer's situation and impact before you pitch, and you build consensus across a buying committee without a single sponsor handing you the deal

  • Pipeline builder: you know how much pipeline your target requires and you generate it your own outbound, fast inbound conversion, BDR meetings as a bonus, not the plan

  • FM / Contract Catering / Workplace Services experience: you know how the FM layer, the site manager and the end-client Facilities or Procurement lead interact and who decides

  • Marketing-literate: you shape what the German buyer needs to hear and co-design campaigns and events for your market

  • Resilient, autonomous, mobile: office and field, regular travel across Germany, periodic weeks at Amsterdam HQ

Nice to have

  • Experience working hand-in-hand with Marketing on ABM and local demand generation

  • Background in sustainability, workplace experience or food & beverage services

  • FM / Contract Catering / Workplace Services experience: you know how the FM layer, the site manager and the end-client Facilities or Procurement lead interact and who decides

Why Aquablu?

You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!

💰 A yearly salary between €65k – €100k base salary

📈 70/30 uncapped OTE → Total OTE €93k – €142k

🌴 26 paid holiday days

📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan — everyone shares in what we’re building

🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches

💪 Urban Sports Club membership

🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings

🚆 Travel compensation >10km

👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven.

💧 Endless amount of our very own flavoured water !

💙Check out out our Youtube to get a feeling for the culture at Aquablu!

jobs.title: Growth Manager - AI Online Marketing (m/w/d) für Tax SaaS Startup
jobs.description:
Was dich bei boring.tax erwartet

boring.tax ist eine KI-native Buchhaltungs- und Steuerplattform für UGs und GmbHs in der DACH-Region. Software und Agenten übernehmen die Buchhaltung, und unsere eigene Steuerberatungskanzlei deckt alles ab, wofür gesetzlich ein Steuerberater nötig ist. Im November 2026 haben wir den nächsten Schritt gestartet: den Jahresabschluss – erstellt von einem Agenten, im Self-Service. Unsere Vision ist das autonome Back-Office zu werden.

Als Growth Marketing Manager verantwortest du den Funnel vom ersten Kontakt bis zum registrierten, aktivierten Kunden. Du berichtest direkt an die Gründer und bist unsere erste dedizierte Marketing-Person. Du fängst nicht bei null an: Paid, SEO/GEO, LinkedIn-Content und Outbound laufen bereits als agentengesteuerte Systeme („Maschinen“) aus Git-Repos heraus. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie zu betreiben, zu schärfen und daraus eine planbare Pipeline zu machen.

ICP - Aktuell liegt der Fokus auf operativ tätigen Tech-/SaaS-GmbHs und Dienstleistungsunternehmen (Professional Services) mit etwa 250.000–2 Mio. € Umsatz; Holdings und Neugründungen kommen über den Self-Service.

Deine Aufgaben:

Du verantwortest folgende Bereiche. Die meisten existieren bereits in irgendeiner Form – es geht also darum, sie zu betreiben, zu messen und zu skalieren, nicht darum, sie von 0 aufzubauen.

  • Demand-Gen-Strategie und Planung
    • Du verantwortest den quartalsweisen Marketing- und Demand-Gen-Plan: Ziele, Lücken im Funnel, Kanal-Mix, Budget und Taktung.
    • Du berichtest den 2 Gründern wöchentlich und monatlich über die Funnel-Performance.

  • SEO und GEO
    • Du verantwortest die organische Suche und die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Antworten (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
    • Du steuerst die Content-Pipeline, die deutsche und englische Artikel, Vergleichsseiten und Landingpages veröffentlicht.
    • Du baust Autorität auf: Backlinks, Tool-Verzeichnisse, Erwähnungen in Open-Source-Projekten und bei Partnern.

  • Organic Social und Gründer-Marken
    • Du betreibst das LinkedIn-Content-System für die Unternehmensseite und die Profile der Gründer – jeweils mit eigener Tonalität.
    • Du machst aus Produktneuigkeiten und Kundengeschichten Posts, die die Marke stärken und Leads bringen.

  • Outbound via Linkedin
    • Du betreibst LinkedIn-Outbound (Sales Navigator und Dripify) auf Basis signalbasierter Listen, z. B. Unternehmen, die gerade eine Teilzeit-Buchhaltungskraft suchen.
    • Du testest und skalierst Sequenzen mit von Agenten geschriebenen, individuellen Nachrichten pro Lead und übergibst qualifizierte Antworten an den Vertrieb.

  • Produktmarketing und Launches
    • Du verantwortest die Positionierung und das Messaging-Framework („Das autonome Back-Office“) über Website, Anzeigen und Vertriebsmaterial hinweg.
    • Du bringst jeden Feature-Launch durch unseren Launch-Workflow: Demo-Video, Blogartikel (DE/EN), LinkedIn-Posts, Kunden-E-Mail, Vertriebsvorlagen, Changelog.
    • Du leitest die großen saisonalen Kampagnen, beginnend mit der Jahresabschluss-Saison – inklusive Reichweite über Influencer, Podcasts und Partner.

  • Website und Conversion
    • Du verantwortest die Marketing-Website (Astro, Tailwind, Git-basiert) und veröffentlichst Seiten selbst mithilfe von KI-Tools.
    • Du baust und testest Landingpages pro ICP, Lösung und Kampagne und verbesserst den Weg vom Besuch zur Registrierung und Demo-Buchung.

  • Marketing Ops, Tracking und Brevo CRM
    • Du verantwortest das Conversion-Tracking durchgängig: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google-Ads-Conversions und Offline-Conversions aus dem CRM.
    • Du hältst das Brevo-CRM sauber: Lifecycle-Phasen, Deal-Pipeline, Automatisierungen in n8n, Make und Zapier.
    • Du stellst sicher, dass jeder Euro Paid-Budget bis zu Registrierungen, Opportunities und Umsatz nachverfolgt werden kann.

  • Lifecycle, Aktivierung und Bewertungen
    • Du verantwortest Onboarding- und Aktivierungs-E-Mails, die Testnutzer dazu bringen, ihre Bank zu verbinden und ihre ersten Belege hochzuladen.
    • Du betreust Kunden-Newsletter und Bewertungskampagnen (Trustpilot) und unterstützt das Co-Marketing mit unseren Vertriebspartnern.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Berufserfahrung im Online-Marketing, idealerweise im SaaS- oder B2B-Umfend

  • Fundierter Umgang mit KI-Tools zur Automatisierung von Marketingprozessen und Content-Erstellung - GitHub Repository (Must Have)

  • Analytische Stärke und sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Marketing- und Analysetools

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Leistungen

Du wirst die 7te Vollzeitkraft bei boring.tax sein und kannst dementsprechend die Firma mitgestalten.

Regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern stärken den Zusammenhalt im Kollegium.

Für die Arbeit von zu Hause stellen wir dir eine vollständige Homeoffice-Ausstattung bereit.

jobs.title: Vil du være med og bygge opp et renholds- og husholdningstjenestefirma?
jobs.description:
Planen var å ansette en kollega fra januar 2027. Men etterspørselen og kundeveksten har gått over all forventning. Derfor ser jeg, Dovile i Dahls Husholdningstjenester i Holmestrand, etter min neste kollega allerede nå.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Kvalitet først. Jeg ser etter en som selv tar ansvar for å gjøre kundene fornøyde, som er glad i faget og som liker å gjøre rent. Hvis du ikke finner noen glede i å gjøre rent, er nok ikke dette jobben for deg.

  • Du har en pluss-én-mentalitet. Vi søker en person som på eget initiativ gjør det lille ekstra for kunden, og som er stolt av yrket sitt og arbeidet som blir gjort. Vi søker ikke en som ser etter den letteste måten å bli ferdig på.

  • Du ser muligheter. Firmaet heter husholdningstjenester av en grunn: det vi egentlig selger, er tid. Ser du en mulighet til å tilby kundene flere tjenester eller utvikle det vi driver med, er vi mer enn åpne for å diskutere det. Eksempler kan være matinnkjøp, klesvask og skift av sengetøy, eller helt nye tjenesteområder der du kommer på en god idé.

  • Du er glad i mennesker, ikke bare i renhold. Mange av kundene våre er eldre, og for noen er en hyggelig prat like viktig som rene gulv. Å ta vare på kundene er den aller viktigste delen av jobben.

  • Du forstår hvem du jobber for. Det er kundene som betaler lønna vår. Den holdningen må sitte.

  • Høy integritet. Vi blir invitert inn i andre menneskers hjem. For kundene kan det være en personlig og intim opplevelse, og det tar tid å bygge tillit. Dette må du utvise respekt for.

  • Norsk som fungerer i hverdagen. Dersom du har innvandrerbakgrunn, trenger ikke norsken din å være perfekt. Men den må være god nok til at kommunikasjonen med kundene er problemfri.

  • Førerkort. Du må ha førerkort for bil, eller være på vei til å få det.

Profesjonell erfaring fra renhold er en stor fordel, men de riktige verdiene og holdningene er det viktigste. Alt det andre kan jeg lære deg.

Slik foregår prosessen: Alle som søker får tilbakemelding, uansett utfall. Først går vi gjennom søknader og CV-er og plukker ut de som virker mest aktuelle. De utvalgte inviteres til intervju, og vi gjennomfører to runder. Den som får jobben, ansettes med én måneds prøvetid. Da ser vi først og fremst på faglig dyktighet, personlig egnethet og kundehåndtering.

Du trenger ikke en perfekt søknad eller CV. Fortell meg heller hvorfor du passer til dette. Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Jeg kommer fortsatt til å gjøre rent selv fremover. Men jeg må også bruke tid på administrasjon og markedsføring for å utvikle firmaet videre, og derfor trenger jeg deg!

Målet vårt er å gjøre hverdagen enklere for kundene, slik at de får mer tid til det de selv ønsker. Mesteparten av jobben er renhold, men vi gjør også andre ting: vi handler mat, vasker klær, skifter sengetøy, organiserer og hjelper til ved selskaper. Vi ønsker å være en komplett leverandør av alle husholdningstjenester.

Dette er ikke en stoppeklokkejobb. Dahls Husholdningstjenester er ikke det rimeligste vaskefirmaet. Vi lever av å selge tid til kundene våre, så de slipper å gjøre rent selv. Vi ligger i det øvre prissegmentet, noe som gjenspeiles i kvaliteten vi leverer.

Kundene våre får alltid 100 % fornøydgaranti. Derfor setter vi av nok tid til at jobben gjøres skikkelig på første forsøk. Hvis ikke må vi uansett reise tilbake og utbedre i etterkant, noe vi ønsker å unngå. Vi jobber effektivt, men aldri på bekostning av kvaliteten. Kvalitet er derfor topp prioritet.

Vi tilbyr

Menneskene i firmaet er våre viktigste ressurser. Dette viser vi på denne måten:

  • Timelønn over minstelønn, tilpasset kompetanse og ansiennitet.

  • Bonusordning. Når bedriften går bra, skal de ansatte også gjøre det bra. Vi innfører en bonusordning der de ansatte får beholde en andel av overskuddet. Bonusordningen avtales skriftlig når prøvetiden er over.

  • 50% stilling fra start, tilpasset det du selv ønsker. For oss er det viktigste å finne riktig menneske, ikke først og fremst noen som kan dekke flest mulig timer. Ønsker du full stilling, er målet å komme dit så fort som mulig: alle nye kunder legges til deg, så stillingen vokser med deg i løpet av noen uker eller måneder. Ser du etter en ekstrainntekt, eller går du på skole ved siden av, prøver vi å være fleksible og finne løsninger som passer med tiden din.

  • Ryddige arbeidsforhold hos en stabil arbeidsgiver som kjenner norske lover og regler godt. Arbeidsplanen sendes ut i god tid.

  • Grundig opplæring. Du jobber sammen med meg til du er trygg på rutinene.

  • Mulighet til å være med fra starten i et firma med høy vekst, og reell påvirkningskraft over din egen hverdag.

En vei inn i norsk arbeidsliv: Har du innvandrerbakgrunn, er integrering et av formålene med denne jobben. Jeg vet selv hvordan det er å være ny i Norge. Jeg snakker fire språk, litauisk, norsk, engelsk og russisk, og du får uformell og praktisk språkopplæring underveis, rettet mot det du trenger i jobben.

Aktuelle kandidater som søker vil bli kontaktet fortløpende for intervju.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jeg kom til Norge fra Litauen, tok to utdanninger og en mastergrad i IT, og jobbet med renhold og service ved siden av studiene. Etter nesten to år med jobbsøking uten resultat bestemte jeg meg for å skape min egen arbeidsplass.

Firmaet er ganske nytt. Vi startet i februar 2026, vi er i sterk vekst, og vi har ikke funnet vår endelige form ennå. Men lønnsomheten er på plass, og veksten er håndterbar. Vi vil heller vokse på riktig måte enn raskest mulig. I dag hjelper vi privatpersoner, bedrifter, sameier og borettslag i Holmestrand og omegn og i Oslo, og vi ser store vekstmuligheter i resten av Vestfold også.

jobs.title: Senior Fundraiser*in – Stiftungen & Unternehmensförderung
jobs.description:
Du gewinnst Förderpartner. Wir bringen Finanzbildung an Deutschlands Schulen.

Du bist erfahren im Fundraising und weißt, wie man Stiftungen und Unternehmen als Förderpartner gewinnt? Du hast bereits erfolgreich Fördermittel für eine gemeinnützige Organisation eingeworben und möchtest deine Erfahrung nutzen, um noch mehr gesellschaftliche Wirkung zu erzielen?

Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Mit unserem Bildungsprojekt Zukunftstag – Dein Crashkurs fürs Leben vermitteln wir jungen Menschen an Schulen wichtige Alltagskompetenzen rund um Finanzen, Steuern, Wohnen und Versicherungen.

Damit wir noch mehr Jugendliche erreichen können, suchen wir eine erfahrene Fundraising-Persönlichkeit, die eigenständig neue Förderpartner gewinnt und unser Fördernetzwerk deutschlandweit ausbaut.

Wichtig: Wir suchen ausdrücklich jemanden mit praktischer Erfahrung in der aktiven Fördermittelakquise. Du solltest bereits erfolgreich Stiftungen oder Unternehmen als Förderpartner für eine gemeinnützige Organisation gewonnen haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aktive Fördermittelakquise: Du identifizierst und kontaktierst gezielt Stiftungen, Unternehmen und weitere potenzielle Förderpartner, insbesondere auf regionaler und lokaler Ebene.

  • Gewinnung neuer Förderpartner: Du überzeugst potenzielle Förderer von unserer Bildungsmission und gewinnst sie für die Finanzierung konkreter Zukunftstage.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Fundraising: Du begleitest den gesamten Akquiseprozess von der Recherche und Erstansprache über persönliche Gespräche bis zur erfolgreichen Förderzusage.

  • Aufbau langfristiger Förderbeziehungen: Du entwickelst bestehende Förderpartnerschaften weiter und gewinnst Förderer für eine dauerhafte Zusammenarbeit.

  • Entwicklung überzeugender Förderangebote: Du erstellst individuelle Förderanfragen, Kooperationskonzepte und Förderanträge.

  • Systematischer Ausbau unseres Fördernetzwerks: Du entwickelst eine kontinuierliche Akquise-Pipeline und arbeitest zielgerichtet daran, unser Fördervolumen nachhaltig zu steigern.

Das bringst du mit

Diese Voraussetzungen sind uns besonders wichtig:

  • Mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung im Fundraising einer NGO, Stiftung oder anderen gemeinnützigen Organisation.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der aktiven Gewinnung von Fördermitteln, insbesondere durch die Ansprache von Stiftungen und Unternehmen.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Identifikation, Ansprache und Gewinnung neuer Förderpartner.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein überzeugendes, professionelles Auftreten gegenüber potenziellen Förderern.

  • Freude an der aktiven Akquise und die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig auf neue potenzielle Förderpartner zuzugehen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Identifikation mit unserer Mission und unseren Werten: Entschlossenheit, Respekt, Verantwortung und Kooperation.

Du passt besonders gut zu uns, wenn du nicht nur Förderanträge verwaltet, sondern selbst aktiv neue Förderpartner gewonnen hast.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Echte gesellschaftliche Wirkung: Deine Fundraising-Erfolge ermöglichen unmittelbar neue Zukunftstage und damit Finanzbildung für Tausende Jugendliche.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Erfolg sind 45.000 bis 100.000 € Jahresgehalt möglich.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Ausbau unseres Fundraisings und gestaltest unsere weitere Entwicklung aktiv mit.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Modernes Büro in Frankfurt am Main und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten.

  • Dynamisches Team: Motivierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.

  • Überzeugendes Förderprodukt: Mit dem Zukunftstag bietest du potenziellen Förderpartnern eine konkrete und wirkungsvolle Möglichkeit, Jugendliche in ihrer Region zu unterstützen.

Über uns

Mit dem Zukunftstag – Dein Crashkurs fürs Leben bringen wir essenzielles Finanz- und Wirtschaftswissen an Deutschlands Schulen und schließen damit eine wichtige Lücke im Lehrplan.

Seit 2019 haben wir uns zu einer der am schnellsten wachsenden gemeinnützigen Bildungsinitiativen Deutschlands entwickelt. Bereits mehr als 200.000 Schülerinnen und Schüler haben an unseren Zukunftstagen teilgenommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, dass möglichst viele Jugendliche unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft Zugang zu lebenspraktischer Finanzbildung erhalten.

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben.

Besonders interessiert uns dabei: Welche Förderpartner hast du in deiner bisherigen Tätigkeit selbst gewonnen und welche Fundraising-Erfolge konntest du erzielen?

jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij een echte vakman (of vakvrouw) en hou je van de variatie die komt kijken bij grond- en wegenwerken? 

Wij zijn op zoek naar een grondwerker voor onze klant, een toonaangevend bedrijf in de sector. Heb jij ervaring met het uitvoeren van grondwerken en wil je deel uitmaken van een gepassioneerd team? Dan is dit de kans voor jou!

Wat ga je doen?

In deze functie krijg je een breed takenpakket waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.

Jouw werkzaamheden zullen onder andere bestaan uit:

  • Nivelleren en graven van terreinen
  • Het plaatsen van boordstenen en klinkers
  • Het uitvoeren van huisaansluitingen (water, gas, elektriciteit)
  • Het plaatsen van rioleringen en het aanleggen van funderingen

jobs.title: Monteur Industriebouw
jobs.description:
Spanbo, gevestigd in Moorslede en onderdeel van VT-Invest Construction Group, is al meer dan 60 jaar een gevestigde waarde in de industriebouw. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen, produceren en monteren van industriële gebouwen op maat, van magazijnen en bedrijfshallen tot kantoor- en retailgebouwen.

Met een sterke focus op vakmanschap, kwaliteit en teamwork realiseren we uiteenlopende bouwprojecten in heel Vlaanderen.

Om ons montageteam te versterken, zoeken we een Monteur Industriebouw die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en houdt van afwisseling. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de montage van staal-, beton- en houtconstructies en zie je elke dag het resultaat van je werk groeien.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team van vier collega's, waar veiligheid, samenwerking en technisch vakmanschap centraal staan.

Bouw jij graag mee aan indrukwekkende projecten? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

Je start je dag in ons modern machinepark in Moorslede, waar je samen met je vaste ploeg de planning overlopen. Na de briefing laad je het materiaal in en vertrek je naar één van onze industriebouwprojecten verspreid over Vlaanderen.

Op de werf ben jij mee verantwoordelijk voor de volledige montage van industriële gebouwen. Elke dag ziet er anders uit, maar je kan rekenen op een mix van deze taken:

  • Monteren van dragende structuren in staal, beton en hout.

  • Plaatsen van gevelpanelen: beton, cellenbeton en sandwichpanelen.

  • Monteren van tussenvloeren zoals predallen en gewelven.

  • Meewerken aan ambitieuze, technisch uitdagende industriebouwprojecten.

Je werkt altijd in een vast team van 4 personen. Samen zorg je voor veilige, kwaliteitsvolle realisaties. Dankzij de variatie in projecten bouw je continu nieuwe ervaring op.

  • Je hebt een beroeps- of technische opleiding binnen bouw of techniek gevolgd, of gelijkwaardige praktijkervaring.

  • Je werkt graag fysiek en hebt een passie voor industriebouw.

  • Hoogtes schrikken je niet af — je hebt geen hoogtevrees.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, met oog voor detail.

  • Je bent sociaal, gedreven en communiceert vlot met je collega’s.

  • Ervaring in montage is een plus, maar zeker geen vereiste — motivatie telt voor ons evenveel.

jobs.title: Grondwerker Rail

jobs.title: Administratief & Logistiek Medewerker (Voltijds – 38u) – Lommel
jobs.description:
Ben jij sterk in plannen en organiseren, en sta je klanten graag professioneel te woord in het Nederlands en het Frans? Wil jij de onmisbare schakel zijn tussen onze klanten, techniekers en chauffeurs? Kom dan ons team versterken bij Practigas in Lommel!

Jouw rol bij PractigasSamen met drie enthousiaste collega’s vorm je het kloppende hart van onze logistieke planning en administratie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze gasleveringen en het onderhoud aan gastanks op rolletjes lopen. Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde!

Jouw takenpakket in een notendop:

  • Slimme planning & coördinatie: Je plant gasleveringen, plaatsingen, herstellingen en periodieke keuringen in. Je houdt daarbij slim rekening met de regio’s en de beschikbaarheid van onze chauffeurs.
  • Klantgericht onthaal: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten via telefoon en e-mail. Daarnaast help je klanten aan de balie en kassa bij afhalingen ter plaatse.
  • Nauwkeurige administratie: Je maakt bestelbons en facturen op, volgt betalingen op en verwerkt meldingen uit ons automatische leveringssysteem.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Talenkennis: Je spreekt en schrijft zeer goed Nederlands en je kunt je vlot uitdrukken in het Frans om onze Franstalige klanten te helpen.
  • Ervaring & achtergrond: Heb je een diploma in een economische of administratieve richting, of heb je al wat eerste ervaring (< 2 jaar) in bedrijfsadministratie? Top! Heb je niet het juiste diploma, maar wel de juiste werkmentaliteit en relevante ervaring? Dan kom je zeker ook in aanmerking.
  • Jouw troeven: Je werkt nauwkeurig, houdt het hoofd koel op drukke momenten en schakelt vlot tussen verschillende taken. Je bent een echte teamspeler die ook zelfstandig zijn plan trekt.

Je bent een nauwkeurig en gedreven iemand, je kan goed in een team werken maar ook zelfstandig.

Je hebt ervaring met bedrijfsadministratie.

Tweetaligheid is noodzakelijk.

jobs.title: Arbeider onderhoud wegenwerken - BOUW
jobs.description:
Heb je ervaring als wegenwerker of grondwerker en zoek je een nieuwe uitdagende job?Vind je het niet erg om overuren te doen die mooi verloond worden?

Wij zijn opzoek naar arbeiders voor het onderhoud van wegen en rioleringen.Als familiebedrijf zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een grote speler binnen de bouwsector met focus binnen infrawerken. 

Indien er een herstelling dient te gebeuren, wordt jouw ploeg ingezet om deze te gaan uitvoeren.

Korte beschrijving van het takenpakket:

  • Herstelling van asfalt
  • Werken aan riolering
  • Funderingswerken
  • Plaatsen van borduren, klinkers, enz.
  • ...

Een functie met veel afwisseling: je staat in de loop van één week op verschillende werven, voornamelijk in de ruime regio Antwerpen.Met je ploeg spreek je een centraal verzamelpunt af waar iedereen ’s ochtends naartoe komt met eigen vervoer.Van daaruit vertrekken jullie samen met één camionette richting de werf, waar de werkdag om 7 uur start.

Is de werkdag voorbij (8 uur gewerkt) maar is het werk nog niet afgerond, dan sta jij ervoor open om overuren te presteren.Uiteraard hangt hier een mooie verloning aan vast.

Onze lonen vallen binnen PC 124, aangevuld met extra’s zoals maaltijdcheques, een gsm met abonnement.Bij een vaste indiensttreding komen daar ook een groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering bij, evenals de mogelijkheid tot een fietsleaseplan.Daarnaast profiteer je van kortingen via Benefits at Work en voorzien wij werkkledij.

Als extra organiseren we ook tal van activiteiten zoals afterworks, teambuildings, enz.

 

Heb je altijd al in de wegenbouw gewerkt en zie je deze job als een nieuwe stap die je graag wil zetten?

 

  • 1ste ervaring binnen grond / wegenwerken
  • Rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer
  • VCA attest
  • Kennis van de Nederlandse taal

jobs.title: Quality Coordinator
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Boekhouder

jobs.title: Technical sales engineer
jobs.description:

Daarbij combineer je jouw technische achtergrond met klantencontact en werk je nauw samen met het ontwerpteam. Jouw rol:

jobs.title: Myyjä
jobs.description: **Vallan Maukas hakee myyjää yritysmyyntiin**Etsimme tekijää, joka tykkää myynnistä ja haluaa tavata asiakkaita myös kasvotusten. Työn pääpaino on yritysmyynnissä. Etsit uusia asiakkaita, otat heihin yhteyttä ja käyt heidän luonaan. Pidät huolta myös nykyisistä asiakkaista, teet tarjouksia ja hoidat sovitut asiat loppuun.Myyt Vallan Maukkaan omia raakalihatuotteita ja lihajalosteita. Vehmaalla meillä on oma tilateurastamo, leikkaamo ja pakkaamo. Makkarat, nakit ja palvituotteet teemme omalla lihanjalostamollamme Raaseporin Pohjassa.Myynnin lisäksi voit tehdä markkinointia ja somea, hoitaa verkkokauppaa ja nettisivuja tai kehittää muuta tekemistämme sen mukaan, mikä sinua kiinnostaa ja missä olet hyvä. Sesonkien aikana pääset auttamaan myös tilausten käsittelyssä ja pakkaamisessa.Mitä toivomme sinulta?- Kokemusta myyntityöstä. Kokemus yritysmyynnistä ja uusien asiakkaiden hankinnasta on iso plussa. - Oma-aloitteisuutta ja rohkeutta lähestyä uusia asiakkaita. Arvostamme sitä, että tuot omia ideoitasi esiin ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun. - Elintarvike- tai liha-alan kokemuksesta on hyötyä. Tuotteet ja alan opit myös meillä. - Valmiutta tarttua ennakkoluulottomasti myös muihin töihin myynnin rinnalla. Meillä autetaan toisiamme siellä, missä apua tarvitaan. - Työ edellyttää ajokorttia ja omaa autoa. Mitä me tarjoamme?Perehdytämme sinut tuotteisiimme ja siihen, miten ne tehdään. Saat vastuuta myynnistä ja tilaa kokeilla omia ideoitasi. Pääset myös tutustumaan käytännössä tilateurastamon, maatilan sekä jalostamon työhön ja ennen kaikkea näkemään lihatuotteiden koko ketjun aina alkutuotannosta valmiiseen tuotteeseen.Työaika sovitaan yhdessä noin 10 tunnista viikossa kokoaikaiseen työhön asti. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Merlin bringt KI in die öffentliche Verwaltung. Mit unserer Telefon-KI, unserem Chatbot und unserem KI-Assistenten entlasten wir Rathäuser, Landratsämter und Behörden. So haben die Mitarbeitenden wieder mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt, und Bürgerinnen bekommen schneller Hilfe. Nach nur 1 Jahr am Markt arbeiten bereits über 120 Kommunen in ganz Deutschland mit Merlin. Wir werden unterstützt durch erfahrene Investoren, GovTech Gründerinnen und ehemalige Spitzenpolitiker*innen.

Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) begleitest du unsere Kundinnen von der Vertragsphase über das Onboarding bis in den Alltag und bleibst dauerhaft ihre feste Ansprechperson. Dabei geht es um mehr als zufriedene Kundinnen: Du sorgst dafür, dass Merlin in den Verwaltungen wirklich genutzt wird. Du findest Wege, wie mehr Mitarbeitende und Ämter davon profitieren, und erkennst, wo wir noch mehr helfen können. Als erste Person im Customer Success legst du außerdem den Grundstein dafür, wie Merlin seine Kund*innen in Zukunft betreut.

Das sagt dir dein zukünftiger Manager:

Wenn es unseren Kundinnen gut geht, geht es auch uns gut. Sie sind das Wichtigste, was wir haben, und genau so behandeln wir sie auch. Mit dieser Haltung haben wir uns in kurzer Zeit einen Namen gemacht: In der kommunalen Welt kennt man Merlin inzwischen als Anbieter, der sich wirklich um seine Kundinnen kümmert. Mit dir möchte ich ein professionelles Customer-Success-Team aufbauen, das dafür sorgt, dass es so bleibt.

Tobias, Gründer & Geschäftsführer

🪴 Das wird dein Job

  • Dein eigenes Kundenportfolio: Schon ab der Vertragsphase übernimmst du die Verantwortung für deine Kund*innen und bist ab dann ihre persönliche Ansprechperson. Du begleitest sie von Tag 1 und baust in regelmäßigen Terminen langfristige Beziehungen zu ihnen auf.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Kund*innen bleiben: Im regelmäßigen Austausch merkst du früh, wenn etwas hakt, und steuerst gegen, bevor es zum Problem wird. Dein Ziel sind Kund*innen, die gern verlängern und uns weiterempfehlen.
  • Du erkennst, wo Merlin noch mehr helfen kann: Ob weitere Ämter, mehr Nutzer*innen oder ein weiteres Produkt, du entdeckst Potenziale und bringst Up- und Crosssells gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb voran.
  • Bei dir laufen die Fäden zusammen: Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen deinen Kund*innen und unseren Teams aus Produkt, Vertrieb und Marketing. Du koordinierst, was gebraucht wird und bringst damit Merlin als Ganzes weiter.
  • Customer Success aufbauen: Du legst das Fundament für diesen Bereich: Playbook, Onboarding-Standards und Kennzahlen wie Nutzung und Verlängerungsquote. Mit unserer Kundenzahl wird auch das Team stetig wachsen, und du prägst, wie es aussieht und arbeitet.

🤗 Damit passt du zu uns

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit viel Kundenkontakt, zum Beispiel im Customer Success, im Account Management, in der Beratung, im Projektmanagement oder in der öffentlichen Verwaltung.
  • Du kümmerst dich gern: Du bist offen und herzlich, Menschen vertrauen dir schnell, und es macht dir Freude, für andere da zu sein. Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind außergewöhnlich.
  • Du bringst technisches Verständnis mit: Du hast bereits mit erklärungsbedürftiger Software gearbeitet und kannst technische Fragen von Kund*innen verständlich beantworten. Neue Produkte verstehst du schnell bis ins Detail und denkst kreativ darüber nach, wie Verwaltungen noch mehr aus Merlin herausholen.
  • Du hast ein Gespür fürs Kaufmännische: Du erkennst Chancen und weißt, was eine gute Kundenbeziehung wert ist, ganz ohne Verkäufer-Ego.
  • Du bist strukturiert und bleibst dran: Auch bei vielen Kund*innen und Themen behältst du den Überblick und hältst, was du zusagst. Gute Abläufe aufzubauen macht dir Spaß.
  • Du gestaltest deine Arbeit mit KI: Du nutzt KI nicht nur ab und zu, sondern hast schon eigene Workflows oder Agenten gebaut und wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisiert.

💜 Warum du zu Merlin solltest

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: Mit GovTech tun wir unserem Land etwas Gutes. Jede Kommune, die du begleitest, wird ein Stück einfacher, für die Menschen, die dort arbeiten, und für alle, die auf sie angewiesen sind.
  • Du gestaltest von Anfang an: Du baust Customer Success bei Merlin auf und prägst, wohin sich der Bereich entwickelt, mit echter Verantwortung und berichtest direkt an unseren Geschäftsführer.
  • Du entwickelst dich schneller als anderswo: Du bekommst regelmäßig ehrliches Feedback und übernimmst früh echte Verantwortung. In einem ehrgeizigen Team, das Spaß an der Arbeit hat, wächst du fachlich und persönlich über dich hinaus.
  • Transparente Vergütung: 50.000–80.000 € je nach Erfahrung. Der Großteil ist fix, dazu kommt ein Bonus, der daran hängt, dass unsere Kund*innen bleiben und mit uns wachsen.
  • Hybrid in München: Unser Büro liegt im WERK1 im Werksviertel am Ostbahnhof, einem lebendigen Tech- und Startup-Hub. Einen Teil der Woche kannst du von zuhause arbeiten.
  • Corporate Benefits: Regelmäßige Team-Events, Wellpass und Offsites.

🌱 Kein perfektes Profil? Bewirb dich trotzdem!

Viele großartige Menschen bewerben sich nur, wenn sie jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Das musst du nicht. Wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Ein Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil reicht, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder sexueller Identität.
