jobs.title: Operatør til vår metallavdeling i Oslo.
jobs.description:
Liker du praktisk arbeid, store maskiner og en arbeidshverdag der du ser resultatet av jobben du gjør?

Vi søker nå en operatør til metallavdelingen vår på H40. Hos oss blir du en del av et operativt miljø hvor sikkerhet, samarbeid og effektiv drift står sentralt.

Arbeidshverdagen er praktisk og variert, og passer for deg som liker å være i aktivitet, ta ansvar og bidra der det trengs. Arbeidet foregår i hovedsak ute på anlegget, gjennom hele året.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som operatør vil du blant annet jobbe med:

  • mottak, sortering og håndtering av jern, metaller og andre fraksjoner
  • lasting, lossing og intern flytting av materialer
  • kjøring av truck og andre maskiner
  • kontroll av mottatte varer og håndtering av avvik
  • daglig kontroll, enklere vedlikehold og renhold av maskiner, utstyr og arbeidsområder
  • rapportering av avvik og nestenulykker
  • deltakelse på tavlemøter, vernerunder og andre aktiviteter knyttet til sikker og effektiv drift
  • andre produksjons- og driftsoppgaver ved behov

For riktig kandidat kan arbeid med biloppsamling også bli en del av stillingen. Dette kan blant annet innebære miljøsanering av kjøretøy i henhold til gjeldende lover, regelverk og bransjestandarder.

Nødvendig opplæring og kursing knyttet til disse arbeidsoppgavene vil bli gitt. Dette kan eksempelvis være F-gasskurs, kurs knyttet til farlig avfall ved bilsanering og sikker sanering av EV/HEV-kjøretøy.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • har truckførerbevis T1–T4
  • er praktisk anlagt og trives med fysisk arbeid
  • jobber sikkert, strukturert og effektivt
  • er pålitelig og tar ansvar for egne arbeidsoppgaver
  • samarbeider godt med andre og bidrar positivt i arbeidsmiljøet
  • følger instrukser, prosedyrer og etablerte HMS-rutiner
  • behersker norsk muntlig og gjerne også skriftlig
  • kan bruke enkle digitale verktøy
  • trives med utendørs arbeid gjennom hele året
Det er en fordel om du har:
  • maskinførerbevis M2 og/eller M4
  • erfaring fra gjenvinning, industri, produksjon, lager eller lignende arbeid
  • teknisk bakgrunn eller bilfaglig interesse, særlig dersom arbeid med biloppsamling er aktuelt

Fagbrev er ikke et krav, men du må være positiv til å ta relevant fagbrev dersom dette blir aktuelt.

Vi er først og fremst opptatt av å finne en person som tar sikkerhet på alvor, liker praktisk arbeid og bidrar godt sammen med resten av laget.

Vi tilbyr
  • en variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag i en fremtidsrettet bransje
  • et aktivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger
  • god opplæring i arbeidsoppgavene
  • relevant kursing der dette er nødvendig for oppgavene du skal utføre
  • ordnede arbeidsforhold og konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • en arbeidsplass med høyt fokus på sikkerhet, kvalitet og samarbeid
  • en jobb hvor du bidrar til at verdifulle ressurser blir tatt vare på og brukt på nytt
Bli en del av laget

Hos oss får du en jobb hvor du ser resultatet av innsatsen din hver dag. Sammen sørger vi for at jern, metaller og andre ressurser blir håndtert på en sikker og effektiv måte og får nytt liv.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Vi ønsker at rekrutteringsprosessen vår skal være rettferdig og inkluderende. Derfor ber vi ikke søkere om å sende inn bilder eller lange søknadsbrev. I stedet bruker vi screeningsspørsmål for å sikre at informasjonen er sammenlignbar. Vi ber likevel om informasjon om kjønn for å kunne fremme en god kjønnsbalanse i vår rekrutteringsprosess.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NG Nordic er en ledende nordisk leverandør av sirkulære løsninger og miljøtjenester. Ved å omdanne avfall til verdifulle ressurser og fjerne farlige stoffer fra sirkulasjon, unngår vi utslipp, beskytter naturlige økosystemer og øker tilgangen til sirkulære materialer. NG Nordic er en viktig del av den nordiske industrielle infrastrukturen, med en omsetning på 1,3 milliarder euro og et team på omtrent 3 400 ansatte og 90 lokasjoner.

jobs.title: Vi søker motivert og effektiv Renholder
jobs.description:
Bli en del av Burger King sin flammende vekst!

Gode gjesteopplevelser i Burger King begynner med rene restauranter og et rent kjøkken. Derfor er stillingen som renholder en av de viktigste rollene i restaurantene våre. Som renholder i Burger King arbeider du i hovedsak utenom restaurantens åpningstid. Du har ansvar for å rengjøre gjesteareal, kjøkken og kjøkkenutstyr.

For å lykkes i jobben er det viktig at du er selvstendig, grundig i din arbeidsutførelse og effektiv.

Vi ser etter deg som er pålitelig, nøyaktig og som har et øye for detaljer. Har du også godt humør og stor ansvarsfølelse, vil du med stor sannsynlighet passe inn hos oss.

Det er en fordel å snakke godt norsk, men engelsk går også bra. Du må gjerne ha erfaring fra renholdsarbeid fra før, men dette er ikke et krav da du vil få full opplæring og kontinuerlig oppfølging hos oss.

Hvem er du?

I våre restauranter er vi ikke opptatt en fancy CV, men hvem du er og hva du kan tilføre, og (viktigst av alt) at du vil gi 100% hver dag for å behandle hver eneste gjest som en konge gjemmom ditt bidrag til renslighet! 

Vil du bli en del av vårt team? Ta kontakt med oss i dag!

jobs.title: Rørleggere
jobs.description:
I forbindelse med økende oppdragsmengde søker vi etter rørleggere til vår avdeling. Avdelingen har 30 medarbeidere og utfører i hovedsak oppdrag for nærings- og privatkunder i Ålesund og omegn.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som rørlegger i Bravida arbeider du selvstendig i mange ulike typer oppdrag for bedrifts- og privatmarkedet.

I jobben får du både planlegge, samordne og utføre oppdrag. Arbeidet innebærer både teknisk problemløsning og kontakt med kunder. Du vil bli en del av et fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og stort fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og gode kundeopplevelser.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere avhengig av rolle og kompetanse, men kan blant annet omfatte:

  • Serviceoppdrag, vedlikehold og rørinstallasjon av alle typer røranlegg
  • Gjennomføring av større og mindre prosjekter
  • Utføre alle typer oppdrag faglig- og forskriftsmessig riktig
  • Allsidig arbeid med kjøling, varme, sprinkler og sanitæranlegg
  • Vedlikehold av sprinkleranlegg, evt FG kontroll av sprinkleranlegg
  • Dokumentasjon av oppdragene
  • Mersalg mot kunde
  • Kommunikasjon med kunder og ledelse

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant utdanning eller erfaring innen VVS-faget. Du kan for eksempel ha:

  • Svennebrev som rørlegger eller fagbrev industrirørlegger
  • Sveisekunnskaper
  • FG-900-godkjenning for automatiske slokkesystemer
  • Fagskole, ingeniørutdanning eller annen teknisk utdanning
  • Erfaring fra servicearbeid eller prosjektgjennomføring
  • God norsk muntlig og skriftlig formuleringsevne
  • Førerkort klasse B

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du har faglig stolthet og holder kunnskap og evnene dine ved like
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk
  • Du er selvstendig, jobber strukturert og er løsningsorientert.
  • Du er pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Du samarbeider godt og er en lagspiller

Bravida tilbyr

  • En stilling i et solid selskap med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig videreutvikling
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser
  • Meget gunstige pensjons- og forsikringsordninger (AFP)
  • Gode systemer som hjelper deg i arbeidshverdagen
  • Et uformelt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø

Interessert?

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad! Søknadsfrist er satt til 15.12.2026. Vil du vite mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss, kan du følge oss på sosiale medier og besøke vår hjemmeside.

jobs.title: Data Scientist 100%
jobs.description: The STRING database is a world-leading life science data resource in the field of protein networks, integrating known and predicted protein-protein links for a quickly growing user community. STRING is being developed by an international team at the following three locations: EMBL (Heidelberg), University of Zurich, and University of Turku. The Zurich team (headed by Prof. Christian von Mering) is looking for a skilled and motivated individual to help grow STRING and its associated data resources with new algorithms and analysis tools. The person will help develop these ideas and design the data flow and analysis toolsets. We are looking for a scientific developer with a good understanding of data, able to contribute to all steps from the primary data, through machine learning and statistical scoring, to the end user. Applicants should be able to build pipelines and critically review code, and can choose their own preferred languages and tools, as long as their approach is compatible with a strong focus on scientific accuracy and user experience.Profile requirements:A solid background in either the Life Sciences or Statistics is essential; experience in machine learning is a strong plus.The position will be available as of February 1st, 2027. It is offered for a period of two years initially, with the possibility of extensions towards an open-ended contract. For any further information, please contact the group directly, at damian.szklarzcyk@uzh.ch or mering@mls.uzh.chFor more information about the database and the team, click on the following links:STRING database: https://string-db.org/The Zurich Team: https://www.mls.uzh.ch/en/research/von-mering

jobs.title: Manager - US Accounting and Reporting Group - USARG
jobs.description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100-100%
**Start Date:** 1. April 2027

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead and conduct PCAOB integrated audits of Swiss based multinational companies or Swiss subsidiaries of U.S. companies
* Audit spin-offs, disposals, opening balance sheets and acquired businesses in connection with various business combinations
* Lead and support other transaction-based projects that require IFRS / US GAAP / PCAOB / SEC reporting expertise (comfort letters, agreed-upon procedures and reviews of registration statements)
* Lead and deliver accounting advisory and SOX advisory services to non-audit clients
* Coach Swiss-based audit teams on technical US accounting, auditing and reporting inquiries
* Conduct internal and external PCAOB / US GAAS trainings



**This is what makes you successful**



* Strong knowledge of US GAAS/PCAOB and SEC requirements and US audit methodology. Knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing (ISA) is a plus
* Highly motivated, curious and proactive team player with a positive attitude, client service oriented and excellent oral and written communication skills
* 5-10 years of recent integrated (PCAOB and US GAAP or PCAOB and IFRS) audit experience with a Big 4 firm and proficiency in researching accounting and auditing issues.
* U.S. CPA license
* Technology skills including Alteryx, AI tools and data analytics
* Strong project management and team leadership skills
* Ability to deliver high-quality services under tight deadlines
* Proficient English skills. Other languages are a plus.



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Health \& Wellbeing**

We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**

We offer above-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

jobs.title: Doctorant·e en science politique, avec spécialisation en politiques et administration publiques
jobs.employer: Faculté des sciences sociales et politiques, Université de Lausanne
jobs.description: Postulation via: https://career5.successfactors.eu/portalcareer?career%5fns=job%5flisting&company=universitdP&navBarLevel=JOB%5fSEARCH&rcm%5fsite%5flocale=en%5fUS&site=VjItQWt5MjVDbnNGNGlkV21MMFpPZDkrdz09&career_job_req_id=23032&selected_lang=fr_FR&jobAlertController_jobA(L'annonce complète se trouve sur unil.ch/travailler )Afin de compléter le laboratoire d’analyse de la gouvernance et de l’action publique en Europe (LAGAPE) de l’Institut d’études politiques (IEP), la Faculté des Sciences Sociales et Politiques est à la recherche d’une doctorante ou d'un doctorant en science politique, avec spécialisation en politiques publiques et/ou en administration publique.La personne engagée rejoindra l’équipe du projet de recherche international The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin Transitions, financé par le Fonds national suisse (FNS) dans le cadre du programme Weave et mené en collaboration avec la Kozminski University (Varsovie) et l’Université d’Anvers (Belgique).Informations liées au posteEntrée en fonction : 01.03.2027 (ou à convenir)Durée du contrat : 1 an, renouvelable 3 x 1 an, maximum 4 ans selon financementTaux d'activité : 100 %Lieu de travail : Lausanne-Dorigny, UNIL-MoulineRémunération : Barème salarialVos activitésDans vos fonctions, vous serez notamment amené·e à :80 % du taux d’activité seront consacrés à la réalisation d’une thèse de doctorat sous la direction du Professeur Martino Maggetti, dans le cadre du projet « The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin Transitions », ainsi qu’à des activités de recherche partagées au sein de l’équipe du projet (études de cas d’initiatives locales dans les domaines de la transition écologique et numérique, enquêtes auprès de responsables administratifs et de citoyen·ne·s, expériences par vignettes, publications communes).20 % du taux d’activité au maximum sera consacré au soutien à l’enseignement (animation et encadrement de séminaires, appui au cours, à la surveillance, aux examens oraux, et à la correction d’examens d’autres enseignements de la filière, etc.). D’autres tâches institutionnelles mineures pourront également être confiées.Description de poste : Cahier des chargesVotre profilNous souhaitons engager, afin de compléter notre équipe, une personne avec le profil suivant :     Maîtrise universitaire en science politique, administration publique, politiques publiques, ou titre jugé équivalent ;    Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais; la connaissance de l’allemand ou d’autres langues est un atout ;    Excellente maîtrise des méthodes et des processus de recherche en sciences sociales (qualitatives et/ou quantitatives) ; une expérience des études de cas, des enquêtes par questionnaire ou des méthodes expérimentales est un atout ;    Excellente connaissance du domaine de l’analyse des politiques publiques et/ou de l’administration publique ; un intérêt pour les questions de confiance, de participation citoyenne, d’intégration des politiques publiques ou de transition écologique et numérique est un atout ;    Forte motivation à accomplir une thèse de doctorat dans le domaine des politiques publiques et de l’administration publique ;    Aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante ainsi qu’en équipe, au sein d’un projet international, et à prendre en charge des activités de recherche en respectant les délais.    L'intérêt pour une carrière scientifique à long terme est un atout.Vos avantagesUn cadre de travail agréable dans un environnement académique multiculturel et diversifié.Des possibilités de formation continue, une multitude d'activités et d'autres avantages à découvrir.Davantage d'informations sur unil.ch/travaillerPour tout renseignement complémentaireProf. Martino Maggetti (martino.maggetti@unil.ch)Votre dossier de candidatureDélai de candidature : 18 décembre 2026Nous vous prions de bien vouloir nous transmettre votre dossier complet en format PDF. Ce dossier comprendra les éléments suivants :1) lettre de motivation ;2) CV détaillé avec liste de publications ;3) relevé de notes officiel et copie des diplômes universitaires ;4) un exemplaire du mémoire de master et/ou d’un travail de recherche (travail de séminaire, papier de colloque, ou autre publication scientifique) ;5) présentation succincte d’un projet de thèse (1 page) qui a un lien avec le projet décrit ci-dessous :The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin TransitionsLa participation citoyenne et la conception intégrée des politiques publiques sont souvent présentées comme des moyens de renforcer la confiance dans les politiques de transition écologique et numérique (les transitions jumelles). En pratique, leurs effets sont incertains et parfois contre-productifs. Le projet explore le chaînon manquant de cette relation : ce qui se passe au sein de l’administration publique. Comment les responsables administratifs utilisent-ils les contributions des citoyen·ne·s ? Les unités administratives collaborent-elles ou se font-elles concurrence ? Comment la confiance et la méfiance façonnent-elles les relations entre les acteurs politico-administratifs, ainsi qu’avec les citoyen·ne·s ?Le projet étudie 24 initiatives locales dans les domaines de la transition écologique et numérique en Suisse, en Belgique et en Pologne, en combinant des études de cas, des enquêtes auprès de responsables administratifs et de citoyen·ne·s, et des expériences par vignettes. D’une durée de quatre ans, il est financé par le FNS, le NCN (Pologne) et le FWO (Flandre) dans le cadre du programme Weave, et dirigé par Martino Maggetti (Université de Lausanne), Dominika Latusek-Jurczak (Kozminski University) et Koen Verhoest (Université d’Anvers). La thèse portera sur le volet suisse du projet, dans une perspective comparative.Il ne sera pris en compte que les candidatures adressées par le biais de ce site. Nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.Les entretiens auront lieu courant janvier 2027.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Commercial (100%)
jobs.description: Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions. Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment. By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society. Your mission: Build the commercial operating engine that enables Climeworks Solutions to scale and become the #1 portfolio manager in the carbon market.  You will turn complexity into simple, effective ways of working, connect processes, systems and data, and create the transparency teams need to make better decisions. By shaping scalable operations and digital customer solutions, you will enable Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to work seamlessly together, serve a growing customer base, and deliver greater value to our customers.  Your work will create the foundation for Climeworks Solutions to grow its customer base, become the most customer-centric CDR portfolio provider, and ultimately help build a mature global carbon removal market. Business analysis & solution design: You structure complex business problems, uncover root causes, and turn them into practical solutions. You align stakeholders, translate business needs into clear requirements, and prioritise improvements based on business impact and feasibility. Process & operational excellence: You continuously improve commercial processes, using AI, automation, and digital solutions to remove complexity and inefficiencies, and to scale how we work. You partner with commercial teams to ensure improvements are adopted and continuously refined. Analytics, reporting & data quality: You turn commercial data into actionable insights, developing reports and dashboards (in Salesforce, Power BI, or Microsoft tools) that help teams understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement. You conduct business analyses and drive data quality and reliability through effective controls and improvement measures. CRM & commercial tools: You drive improvements to Salesforce and our broader commercial toolset, working closely with our technical teams and external implementation partners to bring solutions to life. You remain close to the systems and users, ensuring that technology effectively supports our processes across marketing, sales, and customer success and evolves with the business needs. Project & change management: You lead operational improvement initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and communicate outcomes through clear project updates and presentations. Knowledge management: You develop and maintain an internal knowledge base of processes, tools and enablement materials, making it easy for teams to access and apply best practices. Your story: Education & experience: You hold a university degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Sustainability, or a related field and bring 4-10 years of experience in commercial operations or business transformation, ideally across both consulting and in-house environments. Commercial operations & business analysis: You bring strong experience in business analysis, revenue operations, commercial excellence, or business transformation, ideally across marketing, sales, and customer success. You are skilled at unpacking ambiguous business problems, identifying root causes, mapping processes, and translating business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions. CRM & business systems: You have experience enhancing Salesforce or another CRM, bridging between business and technical teams. You understand how commercial systems, data, and processes fit together, and are comfortable shaping solution designs and steering technical partners through implementation, testing, and roll-out. Experience with Salesforce administration is a plus, as is exposure to marketing automation tools and ERPs such as SAP. Analytics: You are comfortable working with imperfect data, structuring analyses, creating reports and dashboards in Salesforce, and extracting business insights. Experience with Power BI, or comparable analytics tools is a plus. Stakeholder management: You build credibility with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels and enjoy partnering with others to solve business problems. Organisation & execution: You turn ambiguous challenges into actionable work packages, prioritise effectively, and drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption. Mindset & ownership: You bring strong business judgement and a high degree of ownership. You do what it takes to move things forward, whether that means shaping the bigger picture or getting into the details and tackling the work yourself. You are pragmatic, with a bias for action and continuous improvement. You know how to balance scalability and speed in a fast-changing environment. Language: You have excellent written and spoken English skills. Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. What we offer: Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays. Location: This position is based in Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week. We offer up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country. Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter. Family Support: Inclusive parental leave. Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth. Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team. We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

jobs.description:
Vi leter etter en engasjert forsikringsrådgiver som liker å ta initiativ, skape kundekontakt og bygge en egen kundeportefølje. Hos oss blir du en del av et bankmiljø der forsikringsrådgivere og øvrige rådgivere samarbeider om gode løsninger for kundene. Du får bruke både fagkunnskap og salgsdriv til å hjelpe kundene med å sikre det som betyr mest for dem.

 

Navnebytte og bankens ambisjonI november ble Sparebanken Narvik til Sparebanken Nordafor. Det nye navnet gir rom for å vokse videre i Nord-Norge, samtidig som vi beholder den lokale forankringen og nærheten til kundene.

 

Målet vårt er å bli den beste lokalbanken i Nord-Norge. Vi skal være et alternativ til storbankene for alle som vil ha mindre byråkrati og mer direkte kontakt med banken sin. Vi vil gjøre det enklere å være kunde og strekke oss litt lenger enn forventet. Det kaller vi «Nordafor normalen».

 

Nå styrker vi forsikringsmiljøet vårt og ser etter deg som vil være med på denne satsingen. Vi ønsker oss en rådgiver som kombinerer faglig interesse med salgsdriv og evnen til å skape tillit. Du vil jobbe aktivt med kundedialog, rådgivning og salg, og samarbeide med kolleger på tvers av bankens fagområder.

 

Ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver

  • oppsøke og følge opp kunder, blant annet gjennom aktivt telefonarbeid
  • kartlegge kundenes behov og gi relevant forsikringsrådgivning
  • selge forsikringsløsninger og bygge og utvikle egen kundeportefølje
  • skape kundemuligheter sammen med bankens finans- og bredderådgivere
  • holde deg faglig oppdatert og bidra til kompetansedeling i forsikringsmiljøet

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • erfaring med forsikringsrådgivning og salg
  • relevante forsikringsautorisasjoner, gjerne mot både privat- og bedriftsmarkedet
  • erfaring med aktiv kundebearbeiding og porteføljebygging
  • evne til å arbeide selvstendig og samarbeide godt med andre rådgivere

 Har du relevant erfaring, men mangler deler av autorisasjonsbredden, håper vi likevel du tar kontakt for å drøfte ditt kandidatur.

 

Personlige egenskaper

 

Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ og trives med å ta den første telefonen. Du bygger tillit, lytter til kundene og følger opp muligheter på en strukturert måte. Du beholder motivasjonen når du møter avslag, og kombinerer utholdenhet og salgsdriv med omtanke for kundens behov. Du tar ansvar for egen aktivitet og deler gjerne erfaringer med kollegene dine.

 

Vi tilbyr

  • en rådgiverrolle med mulighet til å bygge kunderelasjoner og egen portefølje
  • et bredt bankmiljø med samarbeid på tvers av fagområder
  • korte beslutningsveier og nærhet til bankens ledelse
  • et arbeidsmiljø preget av engasjement, samarbeid og kompetansedeling
  • muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • arbeidssted er Narvik, men for den rette kandidaten kan vi også vurdere kontorsted annet sted i Nord-Norge, for eksempel Tromsø.

Klar for å bli med på laget?

 

Vil du skape gode kundeopplevelser og være med på å styrke forsikringsmiljøet i Sparebanken Nordafor? Da håper vi å høre fra deg. Ta gjerne kontakt med Hyr for en uforpliktende og fortrolig samtale.

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Manipulation) H/F
jobs.description:
At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on manipulation, you will develop the models that let the Marso robot pick, handle and place real-world loads reliably in customer warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of manipulation models from data collection and training to on-robot evaluation and production deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot.

  • Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models.

  • Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs.

  • Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams.

  • Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments.

  • Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints).

  • Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap.

  • Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation.

  • Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent).

  • Practical experience with at least one of: imitation learning, reinforcement learning or vision-language-action models for manipulation.

  • Experience deploying models on real robots, including under hardware constraints.

  • Solid understanding of manipulation fundamentals: kinematics, grasping, motion planning and control.

  • Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, C++, physics simulators, teleoperation setups, force/torque sensing or logistics applications such as palletization or depalletization.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant qu'AI Engineer spécialisé en manipulation, vous développerez les modèles qui permettent au robot Marso de saisir, manipuler et déposer de manière fiable des charges réelles dans les entrepôts de nos clients. Vous serez owner de tout le cycle de vie des modèles de manipulation, de la data collection et du training jusqu'à l'évaluation on-robot et au déploiement en production.

Responsabilités

  • Développer, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de manipulation learning-based (pick and place, palettisation) qui tournent sur le robot Marso.

  • Explorer et appliquer des approches comme l'imitation learning, le reinforcement learning et les modèles vision-language-action.

  • Construire la data loop de la manipulation : collecte par téléopération ou démonstration, curation, labeling et extraction de datasets à partir des logs terrain.

  • Intégrer les modèles avec la perception, le motion planning et le contrôle, en collaboration avec les équipes Intelligent Robotics et Embedded Software.

  • Garantir la fiabilité des modèles sur le robot et sur le terrain : évaluation standardisée, analyse des échecs et robustesse face à de nouvelles charges et de nouveaux environnements.

  • Optimiser les modèles pour le déploiement embarqué (latence, quantization, contraintes hardware).

  • Combiner simulation et tests en conditions réelles pour accélérer les itérations et réduire le sim-to-real gap.

  • Développer des outils internes pour visualiser, rejouer et débugger le comportement de manipulation et les performances des modèles.

Profil

  • Excellente maîtrise de Python et des frameworks de deep learning (PyTorch ou équivalent).

  • Nice to have : expérience avec ROS/ROS2, C++, simulateurs physiques, setups de téléopération, capteurs d'effort/couple (force/torque) ou applications logistiques comme la palettisation ou la dépalettisation.

jobs.title: Founding Product Builder, Operations
jobs.description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

What we're looking for

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV.

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty
    If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

  • Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

  • Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

  • Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

  • Help Paddle grow our adoption of AI securely by designing guardrails, access models and monitoring for AI tools and agents, including the non-human identities and integrations they rely on.

  • Use automation and AI to speed up detection, investigation and response, so the team can handle a growing threat volume without growing headcount at the same rate.

  • Contribute to the secure configuration, posture management and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure, working with the Platform team so security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

  • Strengthen identity and access security as capabilities evolve, including our approach to MFA, device trust and conditional access.

  • Support GRC initiatives on technical control implementation and audit evidence automation, in line with SOC 2, PCI DSS and CIS Benchmarks.

  • Partner with InfoSec, IT and Engineering leadership to set technical direction and deliver the department’s key security programmes, making design decisions and driving work across multiple business functions.

  • Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, building a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Have extensive experience as a security engineer or in a similar role, with breadth across incident response, security operations, security engineering and cloud security, and a strong track record of hands-on delivery.

  • Have led or played a senior role in responding to real security incidents, from investigation and containment through to recovery and lessons learned.

  • Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity, resource configuration, logging and monitoring. Hands-on experience securing AWS, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployments, is highly desirable.

  • Have experience with detection and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR and cloud security posture management platforms, and know how to make them effective rather than noisy.

  • Understand how AI is changing the threat landscape, and are excited about using automation and AI to improve how security teams detect, investigate and respond.

  • Are familiar with modern identity, device management and endpoint security solutions (e.g. Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

  • Can script or program to automate workflows and integrate systems. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) is desirable.

  • Have experience implementing technical controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or CIS Benchmarks (nice to have).

  • Are comfortable operating autonomously on high-impact, wide-reaching work, and working collaboratively across multiple business functions.

  • Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business, including during high-pressure incidents.

  • Are passionate about security and want to make a real impact at scale.

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Head of Product to lead the evolution of our optimisation and orchestration products, scaling them to the next level.

You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams, translating analytical insights into measurable business outcomes for our customers and for APEXX. Customer Value, Growth & Commercial Enablement

  • You think big picture: Strategic yet hands-on, capable of operating at both portfolio and execution level in a fast-moving environment.

WHY JOIN US:

You’ll help shape the future of payments optimisation at APEXX building products that directly impact merchant performance and profitability. You’ll work with talented teams across product, data, and engineering, driving measurable improvements in one of the most dynamic spaces in FinTech.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of optimisation products and influence product management practices across the team.

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

jobs.title: INTESCIA - DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) - Stage MASTER II (6 mois)
jobs.description:
DATA SCIENTIST (H/F)

STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Contexte du stage

Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».

Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.

Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.

Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.

Votre mission :

L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.

Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.

Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.

Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :

• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore

• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise

• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.

 

Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel.

Informations importantes

ð  Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ;

ð  Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.

 

Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.

 

Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty.

Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (DACH)
jobs.description:
ChurchDesk ist die All-in-One-Plattform für die digitale Arbeit von Kirchen. Unsere Vision: Kirchen die Freiheit zu geben, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren – auf Menschen und Gemeinschaft statt auf Verwaltung. Dafür bündeln wir in einer Lösung, die speziell für kirchliche Strukturen entwickelt wurde, alles, was Kirchen in ganz Europa für ihre tägliche Arbeit brauchen: von CRM, Mitgliederverwaltung und Kalender über Spendenmanagement und Website-Verwaltung bis hin zu einer eigenen Social App und mehr als zehn weiteren Modulen.

Mit Büros in Berlin, Kopenhagen, Oslo und Groningen sind wir ein internationales Team, das Technologie und gesellschaftliche Wirkung verbindet. Bereits über 10.000 Kirchengemeinden in Europa vertrauen auf ChurchDesk.

Warum Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden solltest?

Kirchen stehen mitten in einem tiefgreifenden Wandel – und immer mehr große kirchliche Organisationen setzen dabei auf ChurchDesk. Unser Enterprise-Geschäft im DACH-Raum steht auf einem starken Fundament. Als Enterprise Account Executive sorgst Du dafür, dass es weiter wächst: Du überzeugst (Erz-)Bistümer, Diözesen, Landeskirchen und kirchliche Verbände von ChurchDesk und führst sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Unterschrift. Eine Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, echter Verantwortung und einer Wirkung, die weit über Zahlen hinausgeht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden im DACH-Raum durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten, die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads und den Aufbau eines starken Netzwerks in der kirchlichen Landschaft.

  • Du führst komplexe Sales-Zyklen eigenständig – von Prospecting und Bedarfsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

  • Du verstehst die Strukturen und Herausforderungen großer kirchlicher Organisationen und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Du navigierst souverän durch Organisationen mit vielen Beteiligten – von Leitungsebenen über Fachabteilungen bis zu Gremien.

  • Du pflegst eine gesunde Pipeline, erstellst verlässliche Forecasts und übernimmst Verantwortung für Dein eigenes Umsatzziel.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Produkt und Marketing zusammen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe neuer Kunden.

  • Du vertrittst ChurchDesk professionell bei Kundenterminen vor Ort, auf Fachkonferenzen und gegenüber hochrangigen kirchlichen Entscheidungsträgern.


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise als Account Executive mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Du hast bereits erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und weißt, wie man auch in längeren, komplexen Sales-Zyklen ans Ziel kommt.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb an stakeholder-getriebene Organisationen, idealerweise im kirchlichen, NGO- oder öffentlichen Umfeld.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungskompetenz – auch auf Führungs- und Leitungsebene.

  • Du fühlst Dich in HubSpot zu Hause und nutzt es, um Deine Pipeline strukturiert im Blick zu behalten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des DACH-Raums.

  • Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Interesse an der Mission von ChurchDesk und der Rolle der Kirche in einer sich wandelnden Gesellschaft.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Eine Rolle in einem wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen, in der du echte Verantwortung übernimmst, deine Arbeit aktiv mitgestaltest und dabei viel dazulernst.

  • Wachse mit uns: Ein dedizierter Sales Coach an deiner Seite sowie die Möglichkeit, dich durch Kurse und Webinare technisch und im Pre-Sales stetig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Zukunft im Blick – Wir bezuschussen deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 %, damit du heute gut arbeitest und morgen gut abgesichert bist.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub – weil ausreichend Erholung wichtig ist.

  • 37 Stunden Arbeitswoche – mehr Balance, mehr Zeit für dich.

  • Eine offene und ehrliche Feedbackkultur – gemeinsam wachsen, voneinander lernen, transparent kommunizieren.

  • Ein wunderschönes, modernes Altbau-Office im Herzen Neukölln – zentral, lebendig und perfekt angebunden. 

  • Lust auf einen Tapetenwechsel? Besuche uns in Kopenhagen, Oslo oder Groningen! Wir übernehmen deine Reise- und Spesenkosten.

  • Unvergessliche Team-Erlebnisse – von Company Events bis zu gemeinsamen Reisen nach Kroatien & Prag.

Über ChurchDesk

Bei ChurchDesk sind wir der Meinung, dass die Kirche eine wichtige Rolle in der Gesellschaft spielt. Unsere Plattform wird von Tausenden von Gemeinden genutzt, um ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die Kommunikation mit Mitgliedern zu verbessern, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und neue Möglichkeiten der Mittelbeschaffung zu erschließen.
Unsere Kunden sind Teil einer der größten und ältesten Institutionen der Welt: der Kirche. Sie befindet sich in einem erheblichen Wandel, um sich auf die Zukunft vorzubereiten – und wir sind hier, um diese Transformation zu unterstützen. Für Kirchen in ganz Europa ist es entscheidend, effizienter zu arbeiten und mit ihren Mitgliedern und Gemeinden in Verbindung zu bleiben.

ChurchDesk gibt es seit mehr als 15 Jahren – von einem Startup zu einem internationalen Unternehmen, das Kunden in ganz Europa bedient. Und wir fangen gerade erst an!

Wir leben unsere Werte aktiv in unserer täglichen Arbeit:

#challenge: Wir fordern uns selbst – und unsere Kunden – kontinuierlich heraus, uns zu verbessern. Wir arbeiten wie ein professionelles Sportteam: mit Ehrgeiz, Disziplin und starkem Teamgeist.

#dogoodbusiness: Gutes Geschäft zu machen ist ein Marathon, kein Sprint. Es erfordert Ausdauer, Qualität und Integrität – jeden einzelnen Tag.

#jointheride: Die Reise ist genauso wichtig wie das Ziel. Seien Sie ein Teil davon, feiern Sie Erfolge – und haben Sie Spaß! Wir schätzen es, zusammen zu sein, besonders im Büro.

Werk je graag in een zaak waar het eten écht goed is, de sfeer warm blijft en je avonden toch op een redelijk uur gedaan zijn? Dan zoeken we jou.

L'Amitié is een gastronomische bistro op 't Zuid in Antwerpen, bekroond met 13/20 bij Gault&Millau. We brengen verfijnde gerechten in een toegankelijke, gezellige setting, met oog voor product, detail en beleving. Ons team is klein en hecht, en we zoeken een kelner die daar met plezier deel van wil uitmaken.

jobs.title: Puoliperävaunun kuljettaja
jobs.description: Olemme vahvasti kasvava, mutta työntekijöistämme huolehtiva henkilöstöalan yritys. Missionamme on rakentaa kestävää työelämää sekä työntekijöille että työnantajille. Toimimme usealla alueella Suomessa ja pääkonttorimme sijaitsee Tampereella.Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme:Puoliperävaunun kuljettajaaEtsimme rekkakuskia kippipuolikkaan ajoon Kouvolaan. Työssä kuljetetaan savea, ja kuljettaja tekee kuormat itse kaivinkoneella. Olethan siis tekijä, jolla pysyy hallussa sekä raskas yhdistelmä että kaivinkone. Työpäiväsi koostuu saven kuljettamisesta kippipuolikkaalla sekä kuormien tekemisestä. Tässä tehtävässä kuljettaja ei siis pelkästään aja valmista kuormaa, vaan kuormaat saven itse kaivinkoneella, minkä jälkeen kuljetat kuorman sovittuun kohteeseen ja hoidat kuorman purun kippipuolikkaalla.Työ on käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä, joten päivän aikana vaihdat sujuvasti kuorma-auton ratista kaivinkoneen puikkoihin. Tehtävässä on tärkeää osata käsitellä kalustoa turvallisesti ja huolellisesti sekä pitää työ sujuvana kuormauksesta kuljetukseen ja purkuun asti. Työssä pärjää kuljettaja, jolla on varma ote raskaan kaluston käsittelyyn ja riittävä osaaminen kaivinkoneen käyttöön.Työtehtäviisi kuuluu * saven kuljettaminen kippipuolikkaalla * kuormien tekeminen itse kaivinkoneella * kuormien purkaminen * kaluston asianmukaisesta ja turvallisesta käytöstä huolehtiminenEdellytämme: * tehtävään soveltuvaa ajo-oikeutta * voimassa olevaa kuljettajan ammattipätevyyttä * osaamista kaivinkoneen käyttöön * oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta.Työ alkaa alustavasti ensin parin viikon mittaisella keikalla, mutta pätevällä kuskilla on mahdollisuus pitempiaikaiseen työllistymiseen. Aikaisempi kokemus kippipuolikkaan ajamisesta ja vastaavista kuljetustehtävistä on ehdoton edellytys tässä tehtävässä. Palkka 17–19 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, laita hakemuksesi meille CV:n kera ilmoituksen linkin kautta. Hakemukset otetaan vastaan ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta, jotta voimme käsitellä henkilötietoja turvallisesti ja tietosuojakäytäntömme mukaisesti. Lisätietoja puhelimitse tai sähköpostilla:Mikko Tuomi: 044 4455 210 / mikko.tuomi@armstrong.fiArmstrong on valtakunnallinen henkilöstöalanyritys, joka yhdistää osaavat tekijät ja hyvät työnantajat. Toimimme ihmisläheisesti ja uskomme, että onnistuneet työsuhteet syntyvät avoimesta vuorovaikutuksesta, luottamuksesta ja aidosta välittämisestä. Tukenasi on kokenut henkilöstöalan ammattilaisten tiimi koko työsuhteesi ajan. Huolehdimme työntekijöistämme tarjoamalla yksityisen työterveyshuollon sekä laadukkaat ja turvalliset työvarusteet työtehtävien vaatimusten mukaisesti.Yhdellä hakemuksella voit avata oven useisiin työmahdollisuuksiin. Meille tärkeintä on löytää juuri sinulle sopiva työ ja varmistaa, että työsuhteesi sujuu alusta alkaen mutkattomasti ja luotettavasti.

About us

Rufino Osteria is a well-established Italian restaurant located in the heart of Christianshavn, Copenhagen. Our culinary philosophy is rooted in traditional Italian cuisine, homemade fresh pasta, seasonal ingredients and high-quality products sourced from small artisan producers.

We are a busy, fast-paced restaurant with an open kitchen and a strong commitment to authenticity, quality and consistency.

Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing — giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.

The Cards squad owns the systems that power card issuing, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe, handling millions of transactions every day. We're scaling these systems to support new product capabilities and lay the foundations for a more global, resilient platform, and we're looking for a senior backend engineer who can take real ownership of this complex, high-throughput work while raising the technical bar for the rest of the squad.

It's a chance to shape distributed systems architecture at scale, mentor engineers around you, and build infrastructure that genuinely matters to small businesses.

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, data modelling, and working with relational databases
  • Hands on experience in containerisation, orchestration, and CI/CD practices
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Comfort working across teams and communicating clearly in written and spoken English in a professional setting
  • Genuine curiosity about the product domain - comfortable applying a backend lens during feature refinement and thinking beyond the code to understand how your work shapes the user experience

jobs.title: Quality Inspector
jobs.description:
About The Role

Imagine this - As a Quality Inspector, you’re on the production floor, surrounded by state-of-the-art defense aerospace technology — components built to dominate the skies, withstand extreme environments, and empower next-generation defense systems. You’re the last line of defense between cutting-edge innovation and uncompromising reliability. 🚀 

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

  • Be the Guardian of Quality: Inspect aerospace components, assemblies, and processes to ensure everything is up to spec — no compromises. 
  • Find and Fix: Identify defects, troubleshoot root causes, and work hand-in-hand with production and engineering teams to solve problems before they take flight. 
  • Raise the Bar: Help us improve our inspection processes, finding smarter, faster ways to maintain top-tier quality without slowing down progress. 
  • Document the Journey: Record inspection results and generate reports — because quality isn’t just what we do, it’s what we prove. 

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Must-Have

  • Proven experience as a Quality Inspector in aerospace, automotive, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of technical drawings, blueprints, and inspection methods.
  • Sharp attention to detail — you spot imperfections others miss.
  • Knowledge of ISO standards, quality systems, and reporting procedures.
  • English and Dutch

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with non-destructive testing (NDT).
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma principles.
  • Basic understanding of composite materials or advanced alloys.

Who You Are

You’re not just an inspector — you’re a perfectionist with purpose. You thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments where every detail matters, driven by curiosity to constantly question how things can be done better, faster, and smarter. You’re a problem solver who doesn’t just spot issues — you dive in, figure out what went wrong, and help make it right. Most importantly, you take ownership, knowing that when you’re part of a team reshaping aerospace defense, you don’t wait for someone else to lead the way — you set the standard.

jobs.title: Scania søker Tungbilmekaniker!
jobs.description:
Lyst til å bli tungbilmekaniker? Scania søker deg!

 

Er du tungbilmekaniker i dag? Flott.

Hvis du er bilmekaniker, industrimekaniker, landbruksmekaniker eller bare en person som liker å skru og har lyst til å lære mer? Da vil vi også høre fra deg.

 

Hos Scania er vi mer opptatt av mennesket bak CV-en enn av den perfekte bakgrunnen. Vi vet at flinke mekanikere kommer fra mange forskjellige fag. Det viktigste for oss er at du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og har lyst til å utvikle deg i et av bransjens sterkeste fagmiljøer.

 

Noen kommer til oss med mange års erfaring. Andre kommer med interesse, arbeidsvilje og et ønske om å bli skikkelig gode. Begge deler har verdi hos oss.

 

Nå ønsker vi å styrke laget i Stavanger med flere mekanikere. Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne teknologi, spennende feilsøking og kjøretøy som holder store deler av samfunnet i gang. Samtidig får du kollegaer som deler kunnskap, stiller opp for hverandre og hjelper deg med å lykkes.

 

Her får du jobbe med noen av de mest avanserte kjøretøyene på veien. Den ene dagen utfører du service på en lastebil. Den neste dagen feilsøker du elektronikk, reparerer mekaniske komponenter eller finner løsningen på et problem kunden ikke klarte å løse selv.

 

Du blir en del av et verksted med rundt 30 mekanikere og totalt 50 ansatte. Her finner du folk med ulik erfaring og bakgrunn, men med én ting til felles: De liker faget sitt.

 

Det er kort vei til hjelp når du står fast. Samtidig får du ansvar og muligheten til å utvikle deg. Scania investerer mye i opplæring, kurs og kompetansebygging. Hvis du har lyst til å bli bedre, finnes det mange muligheter.

 

Mange forbinder Scania med lastebiler. Det stemmer. Men vi jobber også med motorer, maskiner og tekniske løsninger som brukes innen transport, industri, anlegg og sjø.

 

Arbeidsmiljøet er kanskje det folk trekker frem oftest. Her stiller kollegaene opp for hverandre. Det arrangeres sosiale aktiviteter gjennom året, og det er like lett å få et faglig råd som å høre en god historie i lunsjen.

 

 Du trenger ikke ha alle svarene på forhånd. Det holder at du har lyst til å lære.

 

Ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Scania er en av verdens ledende leverandører av lastebiler, busser, motorer og transportløsninger. Med 50 ansatte, hvorav 30 mekanikere er det et solid fagmiljø med stor takhøyde, godt samhold og en kultur hvor vi spiller hverandre gode. Som en del av et internasjonalt konsern har vi tilgang til omfattende kompetanse, moderne utstyr og gode utviklingsmuligheter.

jobs.title: Vikariat Barne- og ungdomsarbeider/ Assistent
jobs.description:
Vi i Rennesøy-barnehagene har ledig vikariat fra 04.01.2027 til 14.08.2027, og søker deg som ønsker å bidra til å virkeliggjøre vår visjon: «Gjennom lek, engasjement og kvalitet bygger vi fellesskap». Hos oss skal barna møte trygge, varme og engasjerte voksne som ser hvert enkelt barn. Vi er opptatt av voksne som er tydelige, omsorgsfulle og aktive deltakere i barnas lek og utvikling. Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig på barns utvikling, som trives med å bygge gode relasjoner, og som ønsker å bidra i utviklings- og endringsarbeid. Rennesøy-barnehagene består av Vikevåg, Rennesøy og Østhusvik barnehager. Vi har flotte omgivelser med gode turmuligheter og romslige uteområder, og ligger kun ca. 30 minutter fra Stavanger sentrum med gode bussforbindelser. Vi ønsker deg velkommen som søker hos oss og du er hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt dersom du har spørsmål om vikariatet. Det kan være muligheter for fast ansettelse i etterkant.Intervjuer gjennomføres fortløpende. Arbeidsoppgaver

 

  • Du tilrettelegger for lek og læring
  • Samarbeider med foresatte, kollegaer og ledelse
  • Du er aktiv deltakende sammen med barna
  • Du deltar aktivt på avdelingsmøter, personalmøter og planleggingsdager
  • Du jobber i tråd med barnehagens verdier, årsplan, rammeplan, barnehagelov og andre styrende dokumenter
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev som barne- og ungdomsarbeider er ønskelig. Relevant erfaring fra arbeid i barnehage kan kompensere.
  • Du har grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og bruker disse aktivt i hverdagen
  • Du omsetter faglig kunnskap til god praksis i arbeidet med barna
  • Du er trygg, engasjert og inkluderende i møte med barn, foresatte og kollegaer
  • Du legger til rette for lek, læring og utvikling i barnehagehverdagen
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt
  • Norsk er arbeidsspråket i Stavanger kommune. Du må kunne uttrykke deg godt muntlig og skriftlig. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må språknivå B1 dokumenteres
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du trives med å samarbeide i team, samtidig som du tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig
  • Du er fleksibel og møter endringer med en positiv og løsningsorientert holdning
  • Du bygger gode relasjoner til barn, foresatte og kollegaer
  • Du er leken og bidrar til et inkluderende miljø med glede, humor og engasjement
Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull og spennende jobb der du får bidra til barns trivsel, utvikling og fellesskap
  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Lønn etter ansiennitet og kvalifikasjoner i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale
KontaktinformasjonHenrik Rivedal Hellevik, Virksomhetsleder, 95247371, henrik.rivedal.hellevik@stavanger.kommune.no ArbeidsstedSørbøveien 8 4150 Rennesøy Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Stavanger kommune Referansenr.: 5216948997 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 04.01.2027 Sluttdato: 13.08.2027 Søknadsfrist: 14.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere. Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke.

Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 

Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest: Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Nære relasjoner: For å ivareta tillit, habilitet og en hensiktsmessig organisering av arbeidet, ber vi søkere opplyse om eventuelle nære relasjoner til ansatte eller ledere i virksomheten. Slike forhold kan i enkelte tilfeller få betydning i ansettelsesprosessen.

Vedlegg: Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres. Helsepersonell skal ha godkjenning fra Helsedirektoratet.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) – SaaS Healthcare
jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Schichtplanung im Gesundheitswesen 
Du möchtest mit deiner Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegen? 
Bei Swisio entwickeln wir eine der führenden SaaS-Cloud-Lösungen für Workforce Management, Dienst- und Personalplanung – und helfen Krankenhäusern und Pflegeeinrichtungen dabei, den Arbeitsalltag für tausende Menschen zu verbessern. 

Das Beste aus zwei Welten 
Bei uns erlebst du die Dynamik, Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswege eines Start-ups – kombiniert mit der Sicherheit einer profitablen Muttergesellschaft aus den Niederlanden, die seit über 20 Jahren nachhaltig erfolgreich am Markt ist. 
So können wir uns voll auf Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum konzentrieren – ohne Abhängigkeit von externen Investoren. 

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt einzusteigen 
Wir befinden uns in einer starken Expansionsphase in Deutschland und der Schweiz. Bereits heute arbeiten renommierte Einrichtungen wie große Universitätskliniken und Krankenhausverbände mit uns – und das Wachstumspotenzial allein im DACH-Gesundheitsmarkt ist enorm.

Mittelfristig werden wir unsere bewährten Lösungen auch in andere Branchen bringen – in den Niederlanden setzen bereits Unternehmen wie Mars, DHL, der Holländische Staat und Tata Steel auf unsere Technologie. Als Teil unseres Teams gestaltest du diese Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mit.

Deine Rolle bei uns 
Als Project Manager:in übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle bei der erfolgreichen Einführung unserer Lösung und gestaltest aktiv die Skalierung von Swisio in der DACH-Region mit. 
 

Dein Impact 

  • Projekte steuern: Du leitest anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung. 

  • Teams koordinieren: Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, steuerst interdisziplinäre Projektteams und sorgst für effiziente Abläufe. 

  • Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest Zeitpläne, Budgets und Qualitätsstandards und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte nachhaltig erfolgreich abgeschlossen werden. 

  • Kommunikation gestalten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, moderierst Abstimmungen und begleitest sie partnerschaftlich durch alle Projektphasen. 

  • Strukturen aufbauen: Als Teil des Implementierungsteams trägst du dazu bei, unsere Projektmethodik zu standardisieren und skalierbare Prozesse für zukünftige Projekte zu schaffen.
