jobs.title: Software Engineer - Creatives Team
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you (to start with):

  • Gross monthly salary ranging from € 3.600 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!


Your challenges:

The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features.
You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust.

In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day.

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

  • Design, develop, and test new product features

  • Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool.

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

Who are you?

  • You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language)

  • You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well

  • You have at least 1 year of professional software engineering experience 

  • You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres

  • Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful

  • Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem

  • Prior experience in image processing

  • Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor

  • A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'.

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.


The team:

You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. 

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

More benefits: 

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner)  will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes)

  2. Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h)

  3. For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h)

  4. After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h)

When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview.
Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.


Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the first screening,  so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact from job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 to Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR:
We’re looking for a full-stack engineer obsessed with Lovable’s growth engine - turning first touches into daily habits, and daily habits into a thriving ecosystem and real revenue. One sprint you’re shipping onboarding and activation flows; the next you’re crafting distribution rails and monetization features that help builders reach more users and keep them around. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: does this make users more successful, more often?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + product obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

  • Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

  • Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

  • Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems “right” from the start.

  • Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

  • Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

  • Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You will build the growth, ecosystem, and monetization systems that make Lovable - and the apps built on it - sticky, discoverable, and revenue-generating.

  • Ship and iterate activation, monetization and retention experiences that create fast, repeatable value and turn first-time users into long-term fans.

  • Build distribution rails for user apps: SEO and performance, shareable moments, social previews, email and lifecycle journeys, and other growth hooks.

  • Ship marketplace and ecosystem features for publishing, discovering, and reusing apps, templates, components, and services - plus profiles, reviews, and matching between builders and customers.

  • Design and implement monetization and pricing flows: payments, subscriptions, access control, plans, paywalls, billing integration, and revenue-share models that work for creators, customers, and Lovable.

  • Build the analytics and experimentation foundations - events, funnels, attribution, and A/B tests - so the team can understand what works and double down on it.

  • Collaborate closely with design, marketing, partnerships, and support to launch and grow new surfaces across the product and ecosystem.

  • Keep the experience relentlessly Lovable while making growth the engine, not the afterthought.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM providers

  • DevOps and tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.title: Performance Marketer, Paid Social
jobs.description:
TL;DR - We're looking for a hands-on paid social marketer to run Meta as our core channel and test other social platforms. You'll build agents with Lovable that read performance, move budgets, catch issues, and make changes. This is an IC role for someone senior who likes being in the detail and building the machine, not just operating it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years running paid social. You've owned significant budgets on Meta, and you've run or tested at least one other social channel, such as TikTok, Snap, Reddit.

  • Automation-led. You don't do by hand what a script or an agent could do. You've built automations for reporting, budget pacing, or optimisation, and you're comfortable with platform APIs and pulling your own data.

  • Creative-obsessed. On social, the creative does most of the targeting. You know what makes a thumb stop, you can brief and iterate with the creative team, and you keep a high-volume, diversified pipeline moving: UGC, creator content, static, video. You've taken a paid social channel from small to large and kept it efficient on the way up.

  • Efficiency-minded. You think in CAC and payback, and you can tell efficient growth from spend that just looks like growth.

  • A disciplined tester. You know how to stand up a new channel properly: clean test design, enough budget to read a result, and the judgement to call it quickly either way.

  • Hands-on by choice. You'd rather be driving impact than in a deck. You like the detail, and you build things yourself.

  • Already building with AI. You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.

  • Technical spike. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.

What you’ll do

  • Run paid social end to end. Own Meta as a core channel. You set the account structure, the audiences, the bids, the budgets, and the targets, and you know when to lean on Advantage+ and when to take back control.

  • Open new channels. Test TikTok, Snap, Reddit and other social platforms with a clear hypothesis and a clear kill or scale call. Grow the ones that earn it, and hold them to the same efficiency bar as Meta.

  • Automate the day-to-day. Build agents and automations with Lovable that read performance, pace and shift budgets, flag issues like creative fatigue before they cost us, and make the changes. The goal is a paid program that mostly runs itself, with you steering.

  • Scale through creative. Keep a steady supply of fresh, diversified assets in market, work with the creative team and creative strategist, and know which concepts to push, iterate, or retire. Volume and variety are what keep social working.

  • Protect the signal. This is where your technical depth shows up, and you deliver it yourself rather than handing it to a data team. Build and debug the tracking (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API, pixels, consent, and deduplication), and write the queries that judge channels on incrementality, using lift tests and holdouts, not just platform-reported ROAS.

  • Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, placements, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

About the Role

Hi, I’m Oleksandra, Head of Localization and Content at Progress Partners, and I’m hiring a Content Production Manager to join my team. We build consumer products ranging from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, and many of them rely on rich in-app content, such as lessons, quizzes, stories, videos, and other formats, produced through a mix of AI workflows, in-house content specialists, and a network of freelancers. We’re now scaling that output across several products at once, and we need someone to own the engine full-time. You’ll run content production end to end, combining editorial judgment with strong project management to deliver high volumes of quality content on tight timelines. You’ll coordinate the work of our in-house content specialists and directly manage our freelance network, without direct reports initially.

Progress Partners builds consumer web and mobile products used around the world, from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, in up to 36 languages. The Content & Localization team aims to own every word users read across our products and funnels, in every market.

We are building this team from the ground up. You'll join early, shape how we work, and see your impact directly in product and revenue metrics.

  • AI-first. We use AI to produce and localize content at scale, and humans to set the standards, judge quality and decide.

  • Craftsmanship. We hire true subject-matter experts who take pride in their craft and bring the depth and judgment AI can't replace.

  • Fast and pragmatic. We launch quickly, balance quality with speed through a risk-based approach, and improve as we learn.

  • Async and remote. We work across time zones and write things down.

  • Data-informed. We tie content and localization decisions to measurable outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Localization & Content.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan and manage content production across products, from brief to publication.

  • Coordinate AI-assisted content pipelines, including generation, review and import into our CMS.

  • Brief, manage and review freelancers: writers, video producers, editors, instructional designers and subject-matter experts.

  • Experience managing freelancers and remote experts at scale

  • Hands-on content creation skills: you can write, edit and produce content yourself, not only coordinate it

  • Strong editorial skills and a high bar for content quality

  • Hands-on experience with AI content and video tools

Nice to Have

  • Instructional design experience, such as structuring lessons, learning paths or assessments.

  • Experience with CMS-based content workflows.

  • Experience producing content for multiple languages.

In Your First 90 Days

  • Take over content production for an upcoming product launch and deliver it on schedule

  • Improve our production workflow and tracking, and roll them out across products

  • Build a reliable pool of freelancers for video and other formats

  • Define content quality and originality checks for production

How We Work

We’re fully remote and distributed across time zones. We default to async, communicate in writing, and trust people to deliver outcomes, not log hours. Decisions are transparent, ownership is clear, and your work is visible from day one.


Interview Process

We've designed our interview process to be transparent, respectful of your time, and a genuine two-way conversation; we want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us. You'll always know what stage you're at, what to expect next, and roughly how long things will take.

  • Initial screen with our Talent Acquisition Team - 30 min

What We Offer

We believe great work starts with taking care of our people, and we want everyone on our team to have the support and resources they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. Here's what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Remote-first: live and work wherever you're happiest and most productive.

  • A small, senior, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

Equal Opportunity

Progress Partners is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about building a diverse, inclusive team. jobs.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app.

This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

  • Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks.

  • Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs.

  • Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it.

  • Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes.

  • Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability.

  • Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work.

  • Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed.

  • Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance.

  • Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable.

  • Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you.

  • AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance.

  • Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer

  • Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma.

  • Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup.

    Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

  • Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As an Implementation Specialist at Hawk, your responsibility is to transform customer requirements into a functioning solution that helps them achieve their business objectives around transaction monitoring, customer screening and fraud detection, alongside cutting-edge AI technologies. You start with a signed contract and support the customer until go-live. This includes translating policies, regulatory obligations and risk factors into Hawk's setup, data mapping, workflow configuration, UAT support and ensuring that key project timelines and milestones are met. You support our customers in realising true value by detecting more financial crime, allowing investigators to focus on what matters instead of drowning in false positives, and adopting state-of-the-art AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements and needs assessment: gather and analyse the customer's AML, fraud and screening requirements and advise on best-practice configuration.

  • Configuration: translate policies, screening algorithms, regulatory requirements and risk factors into Hawk's setup, covering rules, screening, customer risk rating and workflows.

  • Data mapping and integration: lead the technical deployment and integration with the customer's systems, via API or batch mechanisms.

  • Testing and go-live: support the customer through testing, UAT and sign-off, troubleshoot issues, and support a successful transition to a production environment.

  • Training and enablement: deliver training to the customer's teams from a functional as well as technical standpoint.

  • Project management: plan and run the implementation from signature to go-live on time and within scope, with documentation and regular stakeholder updates, combining hands-on work with project leadership.

  • Primary contact: be the first point of contact for implementation questions and issues.

  • Collaboration and feedback: work closely with Customer Value Partners for a smooth implementation, and bring actionable customer feedback and gaps to Product, Development and Hawk's GTM organisation.

  • Document every configuration decision and the reasoning behind it, so the setup holds up when the customer's auditor or regulator asks why a rule was set the way it was.

  • Manage each implementation task and the implementation success as an outcome you own, as directed by our Customer Value Partner, resulting in activity completion and a go-live on the dates you committed to.

Your Profile

  • 6+ years in implementation consulting or solution consulting, with at least 3 of those years hands-on implementing AML, fraud or screening solutions.

  • Subject matter expertise in AML and compliance. You are familiar with key typologies and patterns, the regulatory expectations behind them, and how monitoring programmes as well as AI get examined.

  • You can confidently stand in front of an MLRO and discuss and defend a rule set. This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL, APIs, CSV and JSON, and data modelling. You're familiar with standardised payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022, SEPA and card data.

  • Integration literacy. You don't write production code, but you're at home with APIs, JSON payloads, SFTP configurations as well as SSO.

  • Proven track record of taking complex implementations to go-live on time, ideally several in parallel, with banking customers or other financial institutions.

  • Stakeholder alignment. You ensure that internal and external parties both have the information they need, keep them aligned and manage expectations.

  • Able to explain complexity simply. Imagine data models for compliance leads, fraud typologies for data engineers. You do it clearly in writing and in the room, in fluent English.

  • A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus

  • Business-fluent German, for working with our DACH customers.

  • CAMS (or equivalent) certification, or time spent in a second-line compliance or MLRO team.

  • Builds constructive relationships with customers and stays calm and under pressure Builder mentality: works independently and brings structure to ambiguity where no established process exists, taking the initiative to define one.

  • Is a resourceful problem-solver who investigates unknowns and tests system behaviour. Knows when and whom to escalate.

  • Manages expectations proactively. Flags timeline and scope risks early, quantifies them, offers phased options and aligns Sales and Customer Success.

  • Handles product gaps transparently. Clarifies the underlying (regulatory) requirement, offers workarounds with their trade-offs, feeds back to Product and doesn't commit to unconfirmed dates .

  • You use AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow to speed up mapping, documentation and analysis, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

About the role

Berlitz is rebuilding its commercial and financial platform. That includes a new CRM, usage-based billing, modern payment processing, and a consolidated ERP, all supporting new digital products for learners, teachers, and enterprise customers.

We're looking for a Senior Financial Systems Engineer to own the flow of money through that platform, from quote and checkout through billing and payment to the general ledger. You'll be the technical authority on how our systems exchange financial data. You'll make sure every customer, invoice, payment, refund, and credit reconciles cleanly at month-end.

This is a hands-on engineering role that sits at the intersection of engineering and finance. You'll report into Engineering and work day to day with Finance, RevOps, and our external NetSuite implementation partner.

What you'll do

  • Own the architecture and data contracts for our order-to-cash flow across HubSpot, Stripe, Adyen, Metronome, and NetSuite.

  • Build and maintain integrations using NetSuite SuiteScript and REST/SuiteTalk, PSP APIs and webhooks, and our iPaaS (Workato), choosing custom code or low-code where each makes sense.

  • Design reconciliation between payment processors, billing, bank settlements, and the ledger, and build the jobs, alerts, and audit trails that keep it reliable.

  • Model prepaid credit packages and usage-based consumption correctly, including deferred revenue, drawdown, expiry, refunds, and credit notes.

  • Support multi-entity, multi-currency operations, including subsidiaries, intercompany flows, FX, and tax handling.

  • Act as the technical counterpart to our NetSuite implementation partner: review designs, challenge assumptions, and take ownership of what they build.

  • Partner with Finance to shorten and de-risk month-end close by removing manual work and fixing data quality at the source.

  • Document the financial data model and integrations so the platform is supportable beyond you.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years building or owning financial, billing, or payments systems.

  • Hands-on NetSuite development experience (SuiteScript 2.x, REST/SuiteTalk, saved searches) and a solid understanding of its record model, including customers, sales orders, invoices, payments, deposits, and journals.

  • Production experience integrating Stripe and/or Adyen, including webhooks, idempotency, payouts and settlement reports, disputes, and fees.

  • Real accounting literacy. You can explain revenue recognition, deferred revenue, cash application, and bank reconciliation, and you know why they matter to Finance.

  • Strong integration engineering fundamentals: API design, event-driven patterns, retries and error handling, and data validation.

  • Comfort working across teams and translating between engineers, accountants, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Good judgement under deadline pressure, with the ability to ship pragmatically without creating reconciliation debt.

Nice to have

  • Experience with usage-based or consumption billing platforms (Metronome, Orb, Chargebee, or similar).

  • Experience at a multi-country business or in education / subscription services.

jobs.title: Ops Strategy Manager - DE
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Germany is one of iwoca's core markets, with its own Operations teams across Customer Success, Credit Analysis and Collections. The DE Operations Strategy team is the thought partner to those teams. We exist to understand Operations performance, find where Ops adds the most commercial value, and make the changes that get us there. We're a small team with a startup mindset: we challenge assumptions, prototype quickly, pilot in a lean way, and scale what works.

The role

As an Operations Strategy Manager, you'll own some of the most important projects in our German Operations, from defining the problem through to rollout, across the whole customer journey from application to recovery. Projects could include:

  • Better underwriting. Redesigning how our Credit Analysts work alongside our credit models, so that their judgement systematically improves model decisions rather than working around them.

  • AI and automation in Operations. Using AI to give our teams richer customer context and remove low-value work – for example, cutting the time Account Managers spend preparing for calls, or drafting the first version of routine customer communications.

  • Smarter task distribution. Rethinking how work is prioritised and split between people and automated processes – from when an Account Manager should call a customer to which customers need a personal conversation at all – so that our teams' time goes where human judgement adds the most value.

  • Stronger recoveries. Using our growing book of defaulted loans to work out which contact strategies, payment arrangements and recovery routes lead to the best outcomes – for iwoca and for the customer.

Whatever the project, you'll ground decisions in evidence: designing and running split tests, doing your own analysis, and working with our Data Scientists to get even more out of our data. You'll work with Operations, Product and Engineering to put changes live, share recommendations directly with Operations leadership and the German management team, and be part of iwoca's wider community of Analysts and Data Scientists.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Strategy experience. You've worked in a top-tier strategy consultancy or in a strategic role at a tech or finance company.

  • Analytical foundations. You have a strong analytical background, through academic qualifications (such as a STEM degree) and professional experience.

  • First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, challenge assumptions, and recommend well-reasoned, innovative solutions.

  • Execution. You've taken recommendations from concept to execution, with hands-on experience implementing product or process improvements.

  • Communication. You distil complex information into clear, engaging messages for a range of stakeholders – from Data Scientists and Operations Managers to C-level.

  • AI leverage. You use modern tools, including AI, to improve the quality, speed and rigour of your work, while staying responsible for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • German language. Our customers are in Germany, so German helps day to day – but it's definitely not a requirement.

  • Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL – either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven't coded before, we'd want you to be excited to learn on the job.

  • Operational excellence. You've driven measurable improvements in a fast-growing operation.

  • Experimentation. You've designed, run and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform operational or product decisions.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000 - £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Rema 1000 Paradis søker låsevakt/skiftleder
jobs.description:
Vi har flere ansatte som reiser til forsvar og studier og har behov for deres etterfølgere. Låsevakt/skiftleder er en viktig stilling hvor du får ansvar for å sørge for at butikken er i den forfatning som kreves og forventes hele åpningstiden. Det krever fart i beina, interesse for å gjøre en god jobb, overblikk og et utpreget godt humør. Vi er ca 20 ansatte og prøver hver dag å levere nærområdets aller beste handleopplevelse. Lokal tilhørighet er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Personlig egnethet og/eller erfaring veier tyngst.Hvis du tror at dette er noe for deg? Gi en lyd snarest. Oppstart midten/slutten av januar 

Ønsker du en variert og aktiv deltidsjobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Hos oss handler det om mer enn å fylle hyllene. Vi leter etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen til kundene våre – noen som møter dem med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Som butikkmedarbeider får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har fylt 18 år

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene. Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.title: Vil du skape aktivitet og fellesskap i Gjerpen og Frogner?
jobs.description:
Gjerpen og Frogner Nærmiljøsenter er frivilligsentralen for rundt 14 000 innbyggere i Skien, fra Bratsbergkleiva og Bøle til Venstøp og Fossum. Sammen med skoler, idrettslag og andre lokale aktører lager vi åpne og gratis møteplasser for alle aldre. Nå trenger vi en ny medarbeider!

Hva vi ser etter

Liker mennesker og trives med å få andre med deg

Er selvstendig, strukturert og følger opp det du setter i gang

Har erfaring fra frivillig arbeid, idrett, skole, kirke, kultur eller lignende

Kommuniserer godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig. Andre språk og flerkulturell erfaring er et pluss

Har førerkort og gjerne tilgang til bil

Relevant utdanning er en fordel, men erfaring og personlig egnethet teller mest

Godkjent politiattest kreves, fordi stillingen innebærer arbeid med barn og unge

Arbeidsoppgaver

Planlegge, koordinere og gjennomføre aktiviteter i nærmiljøet

Samarbeide med og styrke eksisterende aktiviteter og møteplasser hos frivillige og offentlige nærmiljøaktører

Rekruttere, følge opp og motivere frivillige

Være med i arbeidet med Lyttevenn på skolene i området

Bidra i fellesprosjekter i Der Du Bor, som SkoleFri-leirer og Der du bor-kortet

Kommunikasjon og synlighet på nett og i sosiale medier

Noe enkel administrasjon og rapportering

Vi tilbyr

Ett års engasjement i 40 % stilling, med mulighet for 60 % og for forlengelse

Lønn etter Der Du Bors lønnssystem, etter kompetanse og erfaring

Fleksibel arbeidstid. Noe ettermiddags-, kvelds- og helgearbeid må påregnes

Kontor på Venstøp bedehus, noe hjemmekontor er mulig

Et godt fellesskap med de andre sentrene i Der Du Bor

Varierte oppgaver og stor mulighet til å forme stillingen

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gjerpen og Frogner Nærmiljøsenter er frivilligsentralen for et område med rundt 14 000 innbyggere i Skien, fra Bratsbergkleiva og Bøle, over Bratsberg og Frogner, til Rising, Venstøp og Fossum. Vi er en del av Der Du Bor, et nettverk av nærmiljøsentre i Norge. Sammen med skoler, idrettslag, menigheter, museum og andre lokale aktører lager vi åpne og gratis møteplasser, turer, leirer og aktiviteter for alle aldre. Fra 2027 har vi fått statstilskudd til drift, og vi bygger videre på et godt samarbeid i nærmiljøet.

jobs.title: Zorgkundige (bepaalde duur)
jobs.description:
Voor ons WOONZORGCENTRUM DE MEY gelegen in Wachtebeke zijn we op zoek naar een zorgkundige voor bepaalde duur.  

Dagelijks bieden we kwaliteitsvolle zorg aan 75 bewoners met een verhoogde zorgnood. De kamers zijn verdeeld over drie afdelingen: De Meymering, De Klaproos en De Linde. De Meymering is een beschermde afdeling voor 15 personen met een extra verhoogde kwetsbaarheid. 

Jij vormt samen met jouw collega’s de steunpilaar voor onze bewoners en neemt op een warme manier de ondersteuning op in hun dagelijkse activiteiten om het leven en wonen zo aangenaam mogelijk te maken.

Met een lach en een blik van appreciatie zullen ze jou hartelijk bedanken! Daarvoor doe je het toch?

Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • Persoonlijke verzorging: Je ondersteunt bewoners bij hun dagelijkse hygiëne, zoals wassen, douchen, tanden poetsen en andere verzorgingsactiviteiten. Daarbij heb je aandacht voor hun comfort, waardigheid en zelfstandigheid.
  • Toiletbezoek en incontinentiezorg: Je begeleidt bewoners bij hun toiletbezoek en biedt de nodige ondersteuning bij incontinentiezorg.
  • Maaltijden en dranken: Je deelt maaltijden en dranken uit, zorgt ervoor dat bewoners comfortabel en veilig zitten en helpt hen bij het eten en drinken wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Observeren en rapporteren: Je houdt veranderingen in de toestand of het welzijn van bewoners in de gaten en deelt je observaties en eventuele bezorgdheden tijdig met de verpleegkundigen of andere zorgverleners.
  • Ondersteuning bij verpleegkundige handelingen: Je ondersteunt verpleegkundigen bij eenvoudige verpleegkundige handelingen, binnen je bevoegdheden en volgens de geldende afspraken en richtlijnen.
  • Een aangename leefomgeving: Je draagt bij aan een nette, opgeruimde en comfortabele omgeving waarin bewoners zich thuis voelen.

Wij zijn op zoek naar iemand met een hart voor de zorg!

  • Je bent een enthousiast persoon, die graag voor en met mensen werkt. Een passie voor ouderen en een gezonde portie collegialiteit in het samenwerken met jouw collega’s zijn voor jou evidenties.
  • Wanneer je ook volgende zaken kunt afvinken, zijn we vertrokken!
  • Een visum van zorgkundige bezitten
  • Respectvol en zorgzaam met onze bewoners omgaan
  • Een teamspeler zijn die ook zelfstandig kan werken
  • Sociaal zijn en een luisterend oor hebben voor onze bewoners

jobs.title: Juriste en droit de la concurrence (m/f/d) (réf. G) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Autorité de la concurrence est un établissement public indépendant dont le rôle est de garantir la libre concurrence et de veiller au bon fonctionnement des marchés. Sa mission primaire consiste en la recherche et la sanction des comportements anticoncurrentiels tels que les ententes entre entreprises et les abus de position dominant/ante. L'Autorité dispose également de nouveaux domaines de compétences, à savoir les pratiques commerciales déloyales dans le domaine agroalimentaire, les services dans le marché intérieur ou encore les relations entre les plateformes en ligne et leurs utilisateurs professionnels. Nous offrons un environnement de travail et des projets intéressants, une atmosphère collégiale et internationale, la valorisation des compétences des collaborateurs et un cadre de travail flexible.  Missions La personne recrutée rejoindra l'équipe d'instruction en qualité d'enquêteur-juriste ou d'enquêteur-économiste; L'enquêteur contribue à la procédure d'instruction des affaires concernant des pratiques anticoncurrentielles, en participant aux enquêtes menées par les conseillers instructeurs en charge de ces dossiers au sein de l'Autorité; Conduite d'enquêtes : participer aux enquêtes sur de potentielles infractions aux règles de concurrence (collecte et analyse d'informations au moyen des pouvoirs et outils d'investigation de l'Autorité); Rédaction et soutien juridique/économique : préparer les actes de procédures (demandes de renseignements ; rapports d'enquête ; projets de décision) et assister les conseillers instructeurs dans l'instruction des affaires de concurrence; Analyses sectorielles : participer aux enquêtes sectorielles et évaluer le fonctionnement de la concurrence dans les secteurs concernés; Veille juridique et économique : assurer une veille des évolutions législatives, réglementaires et jurisprudentielles en matier/ière de droit de la concurrence au niveau national, européen et international; Mission consultative : rédiger des avis sur les projets de textes législatifs ou réglementaires impactant le jeu de la concurrence; Représentation : participer aux comités d'experts et groupes de travail au niveau européen et international, en représentant l'Autorité dans les discussions relatives aux nouvelles régulations de la concurrence. Profil Compétences techniques Le poste est à dominance juridique et/ou économique; Droit de la concurrence : connaissances significatives, théoriques et/ou appliquées, en matier/ière de droit de la concurrence; Économie industrielle : capacité à analyser les marchés et les interactions stratégiques des acteurs via le cadre analytique de la théorie des jeux et de la microéconomie; Expertise interdisciplinaire : compréhension des liens entre le droit de la concurrence et d'autres domaines du droit et de l'économie (ex. : régulations sectorielles, marchés publics, professions réglementées); Maîtrise des logiciels usuels de bureautique (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.); Langues : maîtrise indispensable des langues française et anglaise; Capacités rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse : excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français. Compétences comportementales Gestion de projet : capacité à mener des enquêtes complexes de bout en bout, en définissant des priorités claires et un échéancier réaliste; Esprit d'équipe : capacité à collaborer au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, tout en prenant des initiatives; Discrétion : capacité à traiter les dossiers avec la plus grande discrétion; Esprit d'initiative et d'ouverture : ouverture aux nouvelles technologies et aux nouvelles méthodes d'investigation. Atouts Disposer d'une expérience professionnelle en droit de la concurrence dans une autre autorité nationale de concurrence, dans un cabinet d'avocats/dans un cabinet de conseil en économie, dans une juridiction nationale ou internationale; Maîtriser les langues allemande et luxembourgeoise; Disposer du Certificat de réussite aux Cours complémentaires en droit luxembourgeois (CDDL) / Maîtriser les outils statistiques et économétriques (R, Python, Stata). Conditions d'admission Ce poste peut être pourvu sous le statut de fonctionnaire de l'État ou d'employé de l'État. Vous n'avez pas à choisir votre statut au moment de postuler : celui-ci est déterminé au terme du processus de recrutement, en fonction des conditions à remplir pour chaque statut. Le poste est également ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons actuellement un Corporate Governance Officer (H/F). Description du poste Ce poste vise à garantir une gouvernance efficace, la coordination et la documentation de tous les comités établis dans le cadre des réglementations AIFMD et OPCVM (UCITS). Il soutient l'Organe de Direction en veillant à ce que les comités fonctionnent avec des mandats clairs, des processus cohérents et des décisions dûment documentées.Le poste est centré sur la gouvernance et n'exerce pas de fonction de contrôle de conformité (compliance) ni de gestion des risques. Organigramme de gouvernance et des comitésLe poste est responsable de la mise à jour de la partie « gouvernance et comités » de l'organigramme de l'entreprise, comprenant :Les structures des comités ;Les présidents des comités ;Les membres ;Les lignes de reporting vers les Ressources Humaines et les Conducting Officers.L'organigramme doit refléter fidèlement les dispositifs de gouvernance en vigueur et pouvoir être utilisé lors d'audits, d'inspections réglementaires ou de demandes de due diligence. 4. Organisation des réunions et documentationLe/La Responsable Gouvernance gère l'intégralité du cycle de vie des réunions de comité :Élaboration du calendrier annuel ;Organisation et planification des réunions ;Vérification du quorum ;Préparation des ordres du jour conformément aux mandats ;Diffusion des dossiers de réunion dans les délais impartis. Il/Elle rédige des procès-verbaux clairs et précis reflétant :Les discussions essentielles ;Les questionnements et analyses ;Les décisions prises ;Les actions à entreprendre.Il/Elle coordonne également leur revue, leur approbation et leur archivage sécurisé, ainsi que celui des documents associés. 5. Suivi des actions et tenue des registresLe poste :Assure le suivi des plans d'actions des comités ;Veille à leur attribution et à leur clôture ;Escalade les sujets lorsque nécessaire. Il/Elle maintient également un référentiel complet et structuré de la documentation de gouvernance :Chartes et mandats ;Ordres du jour ;Dossiers de réunion ;Procès-verbaux ;Décisions ;Registres des actions. Cette documentation doit pouvoir être produite rapidement en cas d'audit, de revue interne ou d'inspection réglementaire. Bien que ce poste ne relève ni de la conformité ni du risque, il requiert une bonne compréhension pratique des exigences de gouvernance liées aux réglementations AIFMD et UCITS,...

Maîtrise de la conception et de la gouvernance d'un design system. Maîtrise d'un outil de conception et de prototypage. Bonnes connaissances des référentiels d'accessibilité (RAWeb, RAAM, norme EN ) et de la loi du mai relative à l'accessibilité des sites internet et des applications mobiles des organismes du secteur public. Connaissance de HTML/CSS et des contraintes du développement front-end. Capacité à rédiger des spécifications UX/UI et des critères d'acceptation exploitables par des équipes de développement. Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit et à l'oral. Compétences comportementales Capacité à conceptualiser et à accompagner le changement. Orientation client et sens de l'écoute. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ?KWARTIER est une société luxembourgeoise spécialisée dans l'investissement, la gestion et le développement immobilier. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. Le profil recherchéNous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, débrouillarde, organisée et polyvalent(e), qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions concrètes. jobs.title: Lead Architect – Digital Assets & Tokenization
jobs.description:
Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up.

The Mission

You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives:

  • Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement.
  • Tokenised Collateral Management Platform: Enabling real-time repo transactions, CCP margin eligibility and DeFi distribution of government bonds through regulated lending environments.

Your responsibility is to translate these strategic initiatives into secure, scalable and auditable technical architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, integrating DLT with traditional financial market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody and CSD.
  • Design cross-chain architectures across permissioned networks (Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) and public blockchains (Ethereum/L2).
  • Define on-chain compliance frameworks, including ERC-3643/T-REX token standards, KYC-whitelisted wallets, AML screening and transaction reporting.
  • Architect institutional custody and key management solutions using MPC technologies such as Fireblocks and Taurus.
  • Establish engineering standards covering code quality, architecture reviews, testing and secure-by-design development.
  • Lead threat modelling and security architecture for high-value financial systems.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions across blockchain infrastructure, custody and audit solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Clearing and CSD stakeholders.
  • Remain hands-on with critical technical components and high-risk incidents.
  • Build and develop the engineering team as the platform transitions from development to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, including at least 3 years working on DLT or blockchain projects.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems and blockchain architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with EVM and permissioned blockchain networks such as Canton or Hyperledger Besu.
  • Knowledge of regulated security token standards, particularly ERC-3643/T-REX or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of smart contract security, cross-chain risks and on-chain compliance.
  • Experience designing secure, highly available financial systems operating 24/7.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including DvP, CSD, CCP and settlement processes.
  • Strong leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

AI Engineering Skills (Required)

  • Experience defining AI-augmented software development workflows using coding assistants, smart contract scaffolding and AI-generated test suites.
  • Ability to establish governance and security guardrails for AI-assisted code, including code reviews, secret management and licence/provenance checks.
  • Experience evaluating AI development tools and identifying practical productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of AI-powered product capabilities such as anomaly detection and operational triage, including associated risk controls.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the architecture for a major digital asset infrastructure initiative.
  • Build innovative tokenisation products at the intersection of TradFi and DeFi.
  • Work within an established European financial institution while enjoying the autonomy of a zero-to-one project.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions and shape the future engineering team.

Important: Candidates must be willing to work onsite in Paris, France, 4 days per week.

Salary: €100K–€120K gross annually.

jobs.title: Management & Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?

Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!

As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.

But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail.

You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.

The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.

No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!

Your responsibilities cover two main areas.

Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes

  • You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.
  • You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.
  • You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.
  • You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.
  • You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.
  • You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.
  • You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.
  • When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.

Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!

Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.

This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.

  • You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.
  • You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.
  • You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.
  • You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.
  • You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.
  • You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.
  • You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.

And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.

No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.

We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.

Does this sound like you?

  • Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.
  • You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.
  • You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.
  • Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.
  • You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.
  • You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.
  • You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!

What else do you bring?

jobs.title: Pedagogisk leder i Tomteråsen barnehage SA
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter nå etter en pedagogisk leder i vår barnehage fra 1. mars 2027.

Som som pedagogisk vil dette være dine arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Ansvar for det faglige/pedagogiske arbeidet på avdelingen du leder.

  • Veilede og støtte det øvrige personalet i hverdagen.

  • Planlegging og evaluering av turer og opplegg som gjennomføres.

  • Tilrettelegge for godt samarbeid med foresatte.

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre foreldresamtaler 2 ganger per år, ellers ved behov.

  • Dele kunnskap om barns læring og utvikling, og bidra til kompetanseheving i barnehagen.

  • Holde deg faglig oppdatert, samt delta på kurs som arrangeres.

  • Være en god rollemodell i en hektisk hverdag.

  • Krav til kompetanse

    • Utdannet barnehagelærer eller førskolelærer

    • Gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Ønsket kompetanse

    • Erfaring som pedagogisk leder eller barnehagelærer

  • Personlige egenskaper

    • Glad i å være ute i all slags vær

    • Opptatt av barnas utvikling

    • Positiv til en hektisk hverdag, og opptatt av kvalitet i alle ledd.

    • kreativ, strukturert og engasjert

    • Opptatt av å jobbe i team, og ser på viktigheten av alle ansatte sin kompetanse

    • Gjerne ha kunnskap eller ønske om å lære mer om landbruk, dyr og miljø da dette er vårt hovedfokus.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Tomteråsen barnehage Sa er en liten foreldreeid barnehage beliggende inne på boligfeltet på Tomteråsen i Nes kommune. Vi driftes som en ideel barnehage og vi er medlem av PBL.

Det er totalt 3 avdelinger i barnehagen, og vi har stort fokus på landbruk og miljø.

Med Hvam VGS rett ved siden av oss har vi et godt samarbeid her, og er jevnlig på besøk for stell av dyr og hjelp til å høste blant annet grønnsaker og poteter.

Vi baker vårt eget brød hver dag, og har varmmat flere ganger i uken.

Vi har egen lavvo i skogen på Tomteråsen, og egen bålplass på uteområdet vårt. Forholdene ligger godt til rette for gode turopplevelser i alle aldre.

Våre åpningstider er 06.45-17.15, og vi er åpent hele året. I romjulen og dagene før påsken har vi begrenset åpningstid.

Vi har fokus på små grupper og deler oss ofte for å kunne se alle barna slik at de har en god hverdag både fysisk og psykisk.

Se mer om barnehagen vår på vår hjemmeside: www.tomterasen.barnehage.no
