Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

  • Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

  • Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

  • Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

  • Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

  • Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

  • Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

  • Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

  • Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

  • Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

  • Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

  • Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.

  • Proven experience building workflows, sequences and lifecycle automation end to end, for both sales-led and PLG motions.

  • Experience designing and automating onboarding or handover processes, and defining health, risk and expansion signals that turn into alerts and actions.

  • The ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into plays and systems that people use in their daily work.

  • Day-to-day experience building with AI, with real workflows, agents or automations you have shipped, and a habit of testing new tools to see what works.

  • An “everything is figureoutable” mindset: you start from a blank page, ship a first version fast, learn from what happens and adapt quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase or comparable analytics tools.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a growing company where systems and processes are still being built, ideally across multiple countries or markets.

  • Familiarity with hospitality technology, POS, payments or merchant services.

  • Experience applying AI to outbound and customer success workflows, with attention to data quality and human review.

We’re looking for an operator who thinks commercially, builds with AI every day and moves fast: building from scratch, learning by testing, and helping every merchant get live quickly and grow with us.

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerker:innen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer Support Teams. Du baust einen skalierbaren, AI-gestützten und datengetriebenen Support auf, der unseren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Serviceerlebnis bietet. Dabei verbindest du operatives Tagesgeschäft mit strategischer Weiterentwicklung, optimierst Prozesse und förderst dein Team gezielt in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung. Mit smarten Automatisierungen, klaren KPIs und einem starken Team schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, unseren Customer Support nachhaltig zu skalieren.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du führst, coachst und entwickelst unsere Customer Support Specialists weiter – mit regelmäßigem Feedback und gezielten Trainings begleitest du sie auf ihrem Weg vom Junior zum Mid-Level und Senior.

  • Du verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft im Support und stellst sicher, dass Tickets effizient zugewiesen, priorisiert und gemäß unseren SLAs und Qualitätsstandards bearbeitet werden.

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Eskalationen und komplexe Kundenanfragen und übernimmst selbst anspruchsvolle oder dringende Supportfälle.

  • Du analysierst und optimierst relevante Support-KPIs wie Erreichbarkeit, Antwort- und Lösungszeiten, Ticket-Backlog und Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Du optimierst die Einsatzplanung, Aufgabenverteilung und Supportprozesse, um die Kundenerreichbarkeit zu steigern.

  • Du treibst unseren AI-gestützten First-Level-Support voran – mit dem Ziel einen großen Teil der eingehenden Tickets automatisiert zu lösen, ohne Abstriche bei der Servicequalität zu machen.

  • Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale im Team und verbesserst die Performance durch gezieltes Coaching, Qualitätskontrollen und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Knowledge Base kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass Hilfeartikel und Supportressourcen aktuell, verständlich und relevant bleiben.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Customer Success zusammen, um die Supportstrategie weiterzuentwickeln, KPIs wöchentlich zu überprüfen und operative Verbesserungen umzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit RevOps, Customer Success und Product zusammen, um Kundenfeedback einzubringen, wiederkehrende Probleme zu lösen und weitere AI-Automatisierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Führung eines Customer Support Teams mit, idealerweise als Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsrolle.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im People Management und Coaching und weißt, wie du Mitarbeitende gezielt förderst und in ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleitest.

  • Du kennst dich mit Customer Support Prozessen, SLA-Management, Performance-KPIs und Qualitätssicherung aus.

  • Du nutzt Daten und Reportings, um die Teamperformance zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu erkennen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Du kannst auch bei hohem Ticketvolumen effektiv priorisieren und komplexe Kundenanliegen strukturiert lösen.

  • Du arbeitest hands-on und verbindest operative Mitarbeit im Support mit der Verantwortung für dein Team.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Supportprozesse und Workflows zu optimieren und die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

  • Du überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation, analytisches Denken und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

  • Du schätzt den persönlichen Austausch mit deinem Team und bist bereit, regelmäßig Zeit in unserem Hamburger Büro zu verbringen. Dabei bieten wir dir ein flexibles Setup, sodass du nicht zwingend in Hamburg wohnen musst. Wichtig ist uns, dass du für regelmäßige Onsite-Phasen vor Ort bist. Dein Onboarding findet in den ersten 3–4 Wochen in Hamburg statt.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Nice-to-haves

  • Du hast bereits Customer Support Teams in einem schnell wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen skaliert.

  • Du kennst dich mit AI-gestützten Supportlösungen und Automatisierungsworkflows aus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Supportplattformen wie Intercom, Zendesk oder Freshdesk.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im B2B-Kundensupport für Softwareprodukte mit.

  • Du kennst Analytics- und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Looker oder Power BI.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den deutschen und österreichischen Kundenmarkt.

  • Du sprichst weitere Sprachen neben Deutsch und Englisch.

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

About you

You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high-traffic, low-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

What you will do

  • Own the technical direction of one or more of our services - architecture, performance, and reliability.

  • Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow.

  • Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes.

  • Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade-offs honestly.

  • Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

What we are looking for

Technical

  • Substantial experience building and operating high-traffic, low-latency backend services in production.

  • Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

  • Experience with observability and performance work in live systems.

  • Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

  • Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

Beyond the code

  • Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters.

  • Influence without authority, and willingness to change your position when someone has a better argument.

  • Clear written communication - design docs, RFCs, postmortems.

  • Good judgment about trade-offs and scope.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems.

  • Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AWS

  • Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e-commerce product discovery.

  • Exposure to AI/LLM-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar).



Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

💵 Base salary: $110k–$130k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

How we handle your data. jobs.title: (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 


What Will Your Role Be

We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience.

This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own Digital Measurement

    • Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products

    • Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions

    • Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection

    Drive Measurement Strategy

    • Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements

    • Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders

    • Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys

    Generate Insights

    • Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels

    • Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making

    • Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations

    Experiment and Optimise

    • Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives

    • Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements

    • Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes

    Collaborate Across Teams

    • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams

    • Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    • Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation

What You’ll Bring

  • Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics

  • Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures

  • Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms

  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python

  • Experience with client-side and server-side tracking

  • Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

  • A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance

  • Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and spoken English

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Product Analytics platforms

  • Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau

  • Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments

  • Experience with experimentation platforms

  • Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management

  • Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

Er is weinig hiërarchie: we drinken samen koffie en lunchen allemaal in dezelfde ruimte, ook de medisch specialisten, wat de communicatie laagdrempelig maakt. Het team is altijd bereid om elkaar te helpen, we communiceren direct met elkaar en we durven elkaar dan ook aan te spreken als dat nodig is. Buiten het werk om is er veel gezelligheid, van gezamenlijke vakanties tot appjes over de dagelijkse dingen. Deze informele, collegiale sfeer zorgt ervoor dat je je snel thuis voelt en samen met je collega's elke dag het beste uit jezelf kunt halen! Naast het Franciscus Gasthuis vind je ons gloednieuwe Operatie & Interventie Centrum, waar de OK afgelopen juni naartoe is verhuisd. Hier werk je in het nieuwste OK-complex van Nederland met moderne apparatuur, innovatieve technieken en een werkomgeving die is ingericht voor de zorg van morgen. Ben je benieuwd hoe ons Operatie & Interventie Centrum eruitziet? Bekijk dan deze video of kom een keer meelopen!

jobs.title: Coördinator Dagbesteding Geelbroekerweg Hooghalen
jobs.description: Als coördinator dagbesteding begeleid en ondersteun je bewoners met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag in hun dagelijks leven. Je coördineert de dagbesteding, vertaalt de doelen uit het persoonlijk plan naar passende activiteiten en stemt deze af met de persoonlijk begeleider, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de gedragsdeskundige. Binnen de Cirkel combineer je het werken op de dagbesteding met het werken op de woonlocatie. Zo zorg je samen met je collega's voor continuïteit, verbinding tussen wonen en dagbesteding en een eenduidige begeleidingsstijl.Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, behandelaren, verwanten en andere betrokkenen. Je stimuleert bewoners in hun ontwikkeling, zelfredzaamheid en maatschappelijke participatie, rapporteert over de voortgang en denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van nieuwe activiteiten. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten en draagt iedere dag bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en betekenisvolle leef- en werkomgeving.Samen met je collega's maak je iedere dag het verschil voor bewoners die behoefte hebben aan duidelijkheid, structuur en een omgeving waarin zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen.Wil jij bijdragen aan een betekenisvolle dag voor mensen met een intensieve ondersteuningsvraag? Een van onze collega's zet een mooie volgende stap binnen Vanboeijen. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe coördinator dagbesteding die samen met ons het verschil wil maken voor onze bewoners.Op de locatie Geelbroekerweg in Hooghalen bied je samen met je collega's een veilige, prikkelarme omgeving aan jongvolwassenen en volwassenen met complexe zorgvragen en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Wonen en dagbesteding zijn hier onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. In een warme en huiselijke omgeving lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan een waardevolle, voorspelbare en betekenisvolle dag voor de bewoners.

jobs.title: Constructiebankwerker / lasser
jobs.description: Als constructiebankwerker ontvang je een "bouwpakket" met laser-gesneden en gekampte onderdelen. Jij bewerkt deze onderdelen zodat er een lassamenstelling ontstaat. jobs.title: Begeleider Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam  Assen - Meppel - Nooitgedacht
jobs.description: Als begeleider in het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam werk je op verschillende locaties binnen Vanboeijen. Je hebt geen vaste werkplek, maar wél een vaste rol van betekenis: je wordt ingezet bij intensieve en complexe zorgvragen en brengt rust, richting en ontwikkeling. Je biedt onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding aan bewoners, sluit aan bij hun behoeften en draagt bij aan een veilige en stabiele leefomgeving.Je herkent signalen, duidt gedrag en handelt vanuit de Vanboeijen Manier en Triple C. Je coacht collega-begeleiders, deelt je expertise over methodieken en interventies en bent een voorbeeld in professioneel handelen, juist wanneer het spannend wordt. In het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam van Vanboeijen zet je jouw ervaring in waar die het hardst nodig is en maak je elke dag zichtbaar verschil.

jobs.title: Dierenarts A bij Dier Medisch Centrum Hellevoetsluis
jobs.description: Vacature: Dierenarts A in DMC HellevoetsluisBen jij een startende Dierenarts met een passie voor diergeneeskunde en wil je jezelf ontwikkelen in een professionele en ondersteunende omgeving? Hier krijg je de ruimte om onder begeleiding diagnoses te stellen, ervaring op te doen en een band op te bouwen met de dieren en baasjes uit de regio.Dit ga je doenAls Dierenarts A ben je een belangrijke schakel in ons medische team. Onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's werk je aan het stellen van diagnoses, opstellen van behandelplannen en het uitvoeren van medische procedures. Je dag is een combinatie van consulten, assisteren bij operaties en het leren communiceren met cliënten.Diagnostiek en Behandeling: Je assisteert bij consulten, het stellen van diagnoses en het uitvoeren van (chirurgische) behandelingen.Preventieve Zorg: Je leert cliënten adviseren over de gezondheid en het welzijn van hun dieren om problemen te voorkomen.Samenwerking: Je werkt samen met paraveterinairen en ervaren dierenartsen binnen ons netwerk voor de meest optimale zorg.Ontwikkeling: Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen door middel van trainingen en begeleiding van ervaren collega's.Dit neem je meeJij bent een enthousiaste teamspeler met een groot hart voor dierenwelzijn en de wil om te leren. Je bent communicatief vaardig en staat open voor feedback. Verder neem je mee:Een afgeronde opleiding tot Dierenarts en een registratie in het diergeneeskunderegister.Een passie voor diergeneeskunde die zichtbaar is in je enthousiasme om te leren.Een betrokken en klantgerichte instelling, waarbij je baasjes graag wilt adviseren.De ambitie om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen in het vak.

jobs.title: Ervaren timmerman / monteur voor veranda bouw
jobs.description: Je hebt aantoonbare werkervaring als timmerman / monteur, bij voorkeur in debouwsector of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving.Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal: Je kunt zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed communiceren in het Nederlands.Technisch inzicht: Je hebt een sterk technisch inzicht en beschiktover praktische vaardigheden die je in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden kunttoepassen.Zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken: Je kunt goedzelfstandig werken, maar je bent ook een waardevolle teamspeler.Het inwerken en opleiden van nieuwe medewerkers tot volwaardige monteurs.Klantgerichte instelling: Je hebt een professionele en klantgerichte houding en zorgt ervoor dat klanten tevreden zijn.Veranda lifestyle is een toonaangevend bedrijf gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpenen plaatsen van tuinkamers, overkappingen, verandas en serres in heel deBenelux.Wij staan bekend om onze hoogwaardige kwaliteit en een service enklantgerichte aanpak. jobs.title: Assemblage medewerker
jobs.description: Voor een opdrachtgever in de omgeving van Arnhem/Nijmegen zijn we op zoek naar een assemblagemedewerker aluminium kozijnen voor de gevelindustrie.Vanuit aluminium profielen die ze aangeleverd krijgen, worden deze verwerkt tot een eindproduct. jobs.title: Account Manager

jobs.title: Data Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.


Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. 

What you will do

Data pipeline

  • Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

  • Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

  • Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

  • Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

  • Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

    • Collaboration and sharing

  • Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

  • Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it


    • What we're looking for

    We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university 

  • Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship

  • Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases

  • Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment

  • Comfortable with open-ended problems where the answer is not known yet, and able to compare technical options and explain your reasoning, both in writing and in front of a team

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Flyte, Argo Workflows)

  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Spark, Dask)

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience working with robotics or sensor data (point clouds, camera streams, time-series data) and formats such as ROS bags or MCAP

  • Experience with data versioning or dataset management tools (e.g., DVC, lakeFS)


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You are eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world problems, and to see your work having an impact on actual machines

  • You want to contribute to a foundational data pipeline that helps our machines improve faster

  • You thrive in a hands-on environment where you learn new tools by trying them out on real data

  • You are curious about machine learning and about how training datasets are built

  • You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism

    • Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

    We are an international team working to solve problems with global impact. To facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Support EMEA
jobs.description:
As a Supply Chain Support Emea in Zaventem, you will help the Procurement & Supply Chain department keep supply chain activities organised within the Life Science industry. You will provide practical support that helps maintain clear processes and reliable day-to-day operations.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in the medical sector. They embody strong (human) values.

Today they are looking to recruit somebody that will provide support to the supply chain division.

Description

As a Supply Chain Support EMEA your responsibilities are:

  • Be the right hand and support of the Procurement and Supply Chain Manager
  • Support daily supply chain activities to help maintain smooth operational processes
  • Coordinate information between relevant internal contacts to keep supply chain tasks clear and up to date
  • Maintain accurate supply chain records and documentation for day-to-day follow-up
  • Custom Tasks and Certification of Documents
  • Support Contract Renewals and Creations
  • Follow up of Supply Chain Issues
  • Request of PO numbers and Vendor Info
  • Help prepare supply chain information for internal reporting and planning purposes
  • Contribute to organised supply chain administration across the EMEA scope
  • Provide general and ad hoc support on different projects
  • Provide meeting minutes, reportings
  • Reportings in SAP

A successful Supply Chain Support Emea should have:

  • Experience with supply chain administration and operational follow-up
  • Excellent administrative skills
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and manage information carefully
  • SAP knowledge
  • Fluent English and Dutch
  • Comfort working with internal stakeholders on supply chain matters
  • Ability to monitor actions and follow up on outstanding items
  • Understanding of procurement and supply chain processes
  • Ability to prepare clear operational information for reporting purposes

jobs.title: Shiftmanager McDonalds @Stekene
jobs.description:
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Voor onze klant McDonald's, een toonaangevende speler in de fast food sector, zijn we op zoek naar enthousiaste Shift Managers in Stekene.

In deze rol ben jij de spil van het team tijdens jouw shift. Je combineert operationele kennis met people management en zorgt ervoor dat zowel klanten als collega's een topervaring beleven.

Via intensieve opleidingen word je van A tot Z klaargestoomd om deze uitdagende rol succesvol in te vullen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je stuurt het volledige verloop van een shift aan en zorgt voor een vlotte operationele werking
  • Je coördineert de keukenprocessen: productbereiding, voorraadbeheer, leveringscontrole en apparatuuronderhoud
  • Je staat in voor optimale klantenservice en creëert een gastvrije sfeer in de zaak
  • Je plant teamleden in op de juiste werkposten en stuurt hen operationeel aan
  • Je bewaakt kwaliteits-, hygiëne- en servicenormen gedurende de hele shift
  • Je motiveert en coacht je team om excellente klantbeleving te realiseren
  • Je zorgt voor een correcte afsluiting van de shift inclusief schoonmaak en opruiming

Wie zoeken wij:

  • Relevante ervaring is een pluspunt, maar gemotiveerde starters zijn even welkom
  • Klantgerichtheid zit in je DNA
  • Je bent leergierig, nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail
  • Flexibiliteit is voor jou geen probleem: je werkt ook avonden en weekends
  • Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en natuurlijk leiderschapstalent
  • Teamwork en people management liggen jou goed
  • Je spreekt uitstekend Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van het Frans

jobs.title: Er det deg vi leter etter?
jobs.description:
Er det deg vi leter etter? Vi ser etter dyktige vikarer i medlever og nattevakt stillinger, med mulighet for fast turnus til våre barnevernsavdelinger i Agder.

Arbeidsgiver: Stendi

Stillingstittel: Miljøterapeut/Miljøarbeider

Frist: 27. desember

Ansettelsesform: Tilkalling

Vi har avdelinger i Mandal, Farsund og Moi.

Velkommen til Stendi AS barnevern!

Hos oss får du en meningsfull jobb der du hver dag bidrar til å gi mennesker et godt og trygt liv. Samtidig får du verdifull erfaring og spennende muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

Vi ser etter deg som har et ekte engasjement for mennesker, og som har erfaring med å stå i krevende situasjoner. Du finner glede i de små tingene, er en trygg og stabil voksenperson, og har en naturlig evne til å skape gode relasjoner med våre beboere. Mange av dem har opplevd utfordrende livssituasjoner, og kan derfor reagere uventet – da er din trygghet og tilstedeværelse avgjørende.

Vi ønsker oss en person som er trygg i seg selv, tillitsskapende og god på relasjonsbygging – spesielt med barn og ungdom. Du trives i et miljø der hverdagen kan være uforutsigbar, og der utviklingsarbeidet står i sentrum.

Vi ønsker deg som har en positiv innstilling, gode samarbeidsevner og et ønske om å jobbe tett sammen med både kolleger og beboere – for her skaper vi resultater sammen.

Personer med erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge vil bli prioritert.

Typiske arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Daglig drift av boligen.

  • Samtaler med barn og unge.

  • Opprettholde god struktur og skape et trygt arbeidsmiljø sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Dokumentering/daglig journalføring/rapport skriving/ kartlegging.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdanning: 3-årig helse- og sosialfaglig høyskoleutdanning. Vernepleier, sosionom eller barnevernspedagog er vår kjernekompetanse, men annen utdanning på minimum bachelornivå kan bli vurdert

  • Relevant erfaring i institusjon, eller annet liknende arbeid, vil også bli vurdert opp mot kvalifikasjonskravet.

  • Studenter som er i ferd med å gjennomføre relevant utdanning er også velkommen til å søke.

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Skriver og snakker godt norsk (tilsvarende nivå B1)

  • Gyldig politiattest.

  • Personlig egenhet vurderes svært viktig

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Vi ser etter deg som er trygg i voksenrollen og kan møte ungdommenes behov på en god måte

  • Du er fleksibel og trives med store utfordringer og du har evne til hurtig omstilling.

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og evne til å opprettholde god struktur, ha et faglig perspektiv og kunne samarbeide i team.

  • Har godt humør, engasjert og bidrar positivt inn i arbeidsmiljøet.

  • Har erfaring fra lignende arbeid innen barnevern, skole og/eller rus/psykiatri.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter

  • Evne til å formidle via dokumentasjon

  • Kan stille på kort varsel

  • Stor grad av ledig arbeidskapasitet i ferier

Hvorfor burde du jobbe hos oss?

Vi tilbyr en meningsfull og givende jobb der du virkelig ser hvilken forskjell din innsats gjør for barna og ungdommene du jobber med. Vi tilbyr gode utviklingsmuligheter slik at du kan videreutvikle og styrke din kompetanse.

På alle våre avdelinger har vi medlever turnus. Der jobber våre ansatte 3 døgn på, 7 døgn fri, 4 døgn på og 7 døgn fri. Dette gir våre ansatte mulighet til å følge opp når de er på jobb, samtidig som de får gode avbrekk med en ukes fri mellom skiftene. Den samme turnusen gjelder for våkne nattevakter.

På grunn av ønsket mangfold i tjenesten, oppfordres spesielt menn til å søke.

Merk søknaden om du ønsker å jobbe medlever eller våken nattevakt.

Kontaktperson:

Navn: Albert Veliqi

Tittel: Rekruttering ansvarlig

jobs.title: Engasjerte vikarer søkes til Stendi Deichmanske, omsorgsbolig for aktiv rus og psykiske lidelser
jobs.description:
Er du en trygg og positiv person som liker å møte utfordringer med strak arm? Er du en inspirerende pådriver som trives med å jobbe tett med mennesker? På Stendi avdeling Deichmanske leter vi etter de aller beste til å bli med på laget.

Stendi er best i det vi gjør og er ledende innen private helsetjenester i Norden. Vi utvikler bransjens beste medarbeidere, investerer i bærekraftig vekst og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Avdeling Deichmanske er en heldøgns omsorgsbolig midt i Oslo sentrum. Vi gir tjenester til mennesker med sammensatte og langvarige utfordringer knyttet til rus og psykisk helse. Våre beboere lever med alvorlige psykiske lidelser og er i aktiv rus. Dette stiller høye krav til faglighet, fleksibilitet og relasjonskompetanse.

Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i tydelige rammer, struktur og forventninger, samtidig som vi møter beboerne med varme, respekt og en fleksibel tilnærming. Vårt mål er å bidra til en mest mulig forutsigbar og meningsfull hverdag for den enkelte, og å legge til rette for små, men viktige endringer i livet deres – på deres egne premisser.

Vi søker nå tilkallingsvikarer til vår avdeling, og vi ønsker deg som finner arbeid med rus og psykiatri spennende og meningsfullt. Som ansatt vil du bidra til å hjelpe beboerne mot en meningsfull hverdag, med støtte til aktiviteter, opprettelse og oppfølging av avtaler, assistanse med ADL-aktiviteter, medisinadministrasjon og mye mer.

Vaktene går over 12-timer, 08:00-20:00/10:00-22:00. Du vil få varierte oppgaver og være involvert i ulike aktiviteter knyttet til beboerens liv. Ingen dager er like på Deichmanske, og hvis du trives med mangfold og spennende utfordringer, er dette den perfekte stillingen for deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Miljøterapeutisk arbeid og relasjonsbygging med beboere i utfordrende livssituasjoner

  • Bistand i dagliglivets gjøremål (ADL), oppfølging av avtaler og aktiviteter

  • Medikamenthåndtering og observasjon

  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid internt og eksternt

  • Dokumentasjon og målrettet miljøarbeid

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har relevant utdanning, men ikke et krav

  • Har erfaring med ROP-problematikk, aktiv rus og alvorlig psykisk lidelse

  • Har erfaring med utagerings problematikk

  • Er lærevillig, motivert og løsningsorientert

  • Er trygg, ressurssterk og tydelig – men samtidig raus, empatisk og relasjonsorientert

  • Har godt humør og bidrar med positiv kultur på arbeidsplassen

  • Er selvstendig, men som også samarbeider godt i team

  • Tåler høyt tempo, og er rolig i møte med uforutsigbarhet og kravsituasjoner

  • Har et brennende engasjement for mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner

  • Mye kapasitet i perioder

jobs.title: 100% miljøarbeider i barnebolig i Steinkjer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å skape et trygt hjem for ungdom?

I vår barnebolig møter du ungdom som trenger trygge voksne som ser dem, støtter dem og bidrar til gode dager. Vi søker engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å skape trygghet, mestring og livskvalitet gjennom sterke relasjoner og faglig godt arbeid. Hos oss får du en meningsfull jobb der du utgjør en forskjell, hver eneste dag.

Om stillingen

Vi etablerer et nytt botilbud for ungdom i Steinkjer og søker trygge, engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å være med fra start. Hos oss blir du en del av et fagmiljø som skal skape et hjem preget av trygghet, omsorg, utvikling og mestring.

Som medarbeider i barneboligen vil du være en viktig person i ungdommenes hverdag. Du bidrar til å bygge relasjoner, skape forutsigbarhet og legge til rette for gode opplevelser og utviklingsmuligheter. Arbeidet innebærer både miljøterapeutisk oppfølging og praktiske gjøremål, og du vil samarbeide tett med ungdom, pårørende, kollegaer og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.

Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i ungdommenes behov og hverdag. Derfor benytter vi en fleksibel turnus som følger skoleruta og tilpasses skoleuker, ferier, helger og høytider. Dette bidrar til kontinuitet, forutsigbarhet og et helhetlig tilbud for ungdommene.

Vi søker etter miljøarbeider i 100% stilling (35,5t/u) med arbeid hver tredje helg. Det vil være en blanding av ettermiddagsvakter og langvakter i denne turnusen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bidra til å skape et trygt og godt hjem for ungdommene

  • Bygge gode og tillitsfulle relasjoner

  • Legge til rette for mestring, utvikling og deltakelse i hverdags- og fritidsaktiviteter

  • Gi individuell oppfølging i tråd med vedtak, mål og tiltaksplaner

  • Samarbeide med pårørende, skole og øvrige samarbeidspartnere

  • Utføre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til drift av hjemmet

  • Dokumentasjon og journalføring

  • Delta aktivt i fagutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Er trygg, varm og tydelig i møte med ungdom

  • Har evne til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team

  • Har engasjement for miljøterapeutisk arbeid og ungdoms utvikling

  • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljø og faglig fellesskap

Vi tilbyr

  • Muligheten til å være med å bygge opp et nytt og spennende tilbud for ungdom

  • En meningsfull arbeidshverdag hvor du gjør en forskjell

  • Fleksibel turnus tilpasset ungdommenes hverdag gjennom skoleår, ferier og høytider

  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • Opplæring i Trygghet og Sikkerhet (TSS)

  • Opplæring i dokumentasjonssystemer, rutiner og faglige arbeidsmetoder

  • Veiledning, refleksjon og faglig utvikling

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kollegaer

  • Muligheten til å være med å forme kultur, fagmiljø og arbeidsmåter fra oppstart

Derfor er denne stillingen litt annerledes

Dette er ikke bare en jobb i turnus. Dette er en mulighet til å være med på å bygge et hjem for ungdom som trenger trygge voksne rundt seg. Du får tid til å skape relasjoner, bidra til utvikling og være en viktig del av ungdommenes hverdag. Samtidig blir du en del av et fagmiljø som satser på kvalitet, kompetanse og kontinuerlig utvikling.

Hos oss handler jobben om mer enn oppgaver. Den handler om mennesker, relasjoner og å skape et hjem.

Øvrige kvalifikasjoner (må-krav):

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig (minimum B2)

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Gyldig politiattest i henhold til gjeldende lovkrav. Kontroll av politiattest gjennomføres via DigiPost.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker - deeltijds 20u/ week
jobs.description:
Als customer servicemedewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van eerstelijns ondersteuning aan klanten door het effectief beheren van vragen en klachten en de pro-actieve opvolging van “probleemorders”.  Je speelt een cruciale rol in het garanderen van een optimale klantervaring en het behouden van een positieve relatie met onze klanten.

Deze functie wordt deeltijds ingevuld, waarbij je elke voormiddag werkt van 8u00 tot 12u00 of van 13u-17u. 

Verantwoordelijkheden

Klantenservice:      - Bieden van snelle en effectieve oplossingen voor klantenvragen en -klachten via telefoon en digitale kanalen.      - Continu streven naar verbetering van de klantervaring door empathisch en oplossingsgericht te handelen bij elk klantcontact.      - Zorgen voor optimale bereikbaarheid van de klantenservice afdeling, waarbij alle communicatiekanalen efficiënt worden beheerd.Ordermanagement: Proactieve opvolging van probleemorders, inclusief communicatie met klanten over de orderstatus en eventuele oplossingen.Klantenreviews: Monitoren en reageren op klantenreviews, en het initiëren van verbeteringen in dienstverlening gebaseerd op feedback.

  • Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en van het Frans. Basisvaardigheden in het Engels zijn een plus.
  • Communicatie: Sterke verbale en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden, met het vermogen om helder en klantvriendelijk te communiceren.
  • Probleemoplossend: Vermogen om problemen snel te identificeren en praktische oplossingen te bieden.
  • Digitale Vaardigheden: Goede beheersing van digitale communicatietools en CRM-systemen.

jobs.title: Teamleader dagwerk
jobs.description:
DE OESTERBANK vzw is als industrieel maatwerkbedrijf actief sinds 1966 en gekend als een sociale werkgever met innovatieve, technologische arbeidsprocessen. Hiervoor werken wij nauw samen met diverse toonaangevende bedrijven.

Onze absolute drijfveer? Elke dag opnieuw het beste in onze mensen naar boven brengen.

Op dit ogenblik zoeken we teamleaders dagwerk.

Wil jij een verschil maken op de werkvloer én in het leven van mensen? Heb je talent voor het aansturen van een team en haal je energie uit samenwerken en coachen? Dan is deze functie als teamleader iets voor jou. In deze rol combineer je mensgericht leiderschap met een sterke focus op kwaliteit en resultaat, en bouw je elke dag mee aan een inclusieve en efficiënte werkomgeving. We zijn op zoek naar collega’s om onze teams te versterken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je wordt tewerkgesteld in een productieatelier waar je de productie in goede banen leidt en meewerkt indien nodig. Dit kan in Oostende in onze hoofdgebouwen of bij een klant, afhankelijk van jouw verplaatsingsmogelijkheden.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat je team optimaal kan functioneren door het werk efficiënt te organiseren en het overzicht te bewaren. Daarbij waak je over veiligheid, kwaliteit en het behalen van de afgesproken doelstellingen, steeds in overleg met je leidinggevende.
  • Je hebt ook voor het welzijn van je team en je besteedt aandacht aan zowel ergonomische als psychosociale aspecten.
  • Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen en draagt ideeën aan om werkprocessen te vereenvoudigen en te optimaliseren.

·

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Je hebt geproefd van het aansturen van een team en kan vooral terugblikken op enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen een productie of montageomgeving.
  • Je bent een positieve en motiverende persoonlijkheid die verantwoordelijkheid opneemt en graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt.
  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk en communiceert vlot en duidelijk met collega's en medewerkers.
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken en neemt eigenaarschap over je taken.
  • Je bent flexibel en beschikt over een rijbewijs B.

jobs.title: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Client Officer
jobs.description:
Onze partner is een toonaangevende Belgische softwareleverancier die met gespecialiseerde B2B-oplossingen klanten ondersteunt bij het digitaliseren en optimaliseren van hun processen.Vanuit hun kantoor in Zaventem bouwen zij dagelijks aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen binnen een sterk groeiende onderneming. Die groei gaat hand in hand met een jonge en dynamische bedrijfscultuur waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en een aangename werksfeer centraal staan.Om hun verdere groei te ondersteunen, zijn zij op zoek naar een enthousiaste Client Officer. Als Client Officer ben je de schakel tussen de klanten en de interne organisatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat elke vraag correct, professioneel en efficiënt wordt behandeld. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en behandelt vragen die binnenkomen via de helpdesk.

  • Je bent vlot in het Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van Engels en Frans.

jobs.title: Electrical Maintenance Technician

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.description:
About the Team

The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole.

You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog:

  • GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview

  • Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available

  • Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available

We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production.

What will you do?

  • Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage.

  • Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements.

  • Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents.

About you:

  • 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem.

  • Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery.

  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

  • Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Representative - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you'll play a key role in accelerating Mollie's growth in the Netherlands, building relationships with larger SMB merchants and helping them find the right payment solutions for their businesses.

You'll take full commercial ownership of your pipeline, combining inbound and outbound sales and managing more complex opportunities with businesses with annual revenue of up to €12M.

Joining an established, high-performing Dutch sales team, you'll bring your commercial expertise, market understanding and independent approach to winning new business, while continuing to grow your expertise in payments and fintech.

What you'll ship

  • Generate new business through a roughly 50/50 mix of inbound and outbound sales activities.

  • Independently own the full sales cycle, managing larger and more complex commercial opportunities.

  • Lead consultative sales conversations, understand merchant needs and position the right payment solutions.

  • Consistently achieve quarterly sales targets and drive net revenue growth in the Netherlands.

  • Navigate complex negotiations and stakeholder relationships to convert opportunities into live merchants.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful merchant onboarding, implementation and go-live.

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, manage a healthy pipeline and actively share your commercial knowledge with the team.

What you will bring

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B technology sales experience, or at least 2 years of highly relevant experience in payments or fintech.

  • A proven track record of achieving sales targets and independently generating new business through outbound prospecting, including cold calling.

  • Strong full-cycle sales experience, with the ability to independently manage larger customers and more complex deals.

  • Well-developed consultative selling, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong market understanding, commercial judgement, pipeline management and forecasting skills.

  • Native-level Dutch.

  • Curiosity about technology and the practical application of AI in sales.

  • A hungry, humble and smart mindset. You're ambitious, hands-on, self-aware and confident in taking ownership, while remaining open to feedback and continuous learning.

Experience in fintech, payments or the payment service provider (PSP) ecosystem is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

About the Role

The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown.

You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost.

  • Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements, flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project.

  • Develop system architectures and conceptual designs, perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces).

  • Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans, and drive them through to completion with the teams involved.

  • Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support.

What we would love to see from you

In this role, ideally, you will have the following:

  • Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them.

  • A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact.

  • Able to work effectively with neighboring subsystems (thermal, GNC, propulsion, flight software, operations), understanding their interfaces and constraints well enough to resolve cross-disciplinary trade-offs and keep interface control documents aligned.

  • Strong systems engineering skills: defining requirements and their flow-down, managing technical baselines, and producing architectures and trade-offs.

  • Experience with budgets and performance analysis (power, mass, data, thermal) to support design decisions.

  • Hands-on experience with development, assembly, integration and testing of electrical units for space applications.

  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to engineers, managers and partners.

  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in the relevant domain.

As a guideline, candidates typically bring 5+ years of relevant experience in aerospace system design. We value demonstrated capability over the number of years, so we welcome applications from candidates with a strong track record who may have followed a non-linear path.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to structure complex problems and reach sound decisions.

  • Organised and pragmatic, able to set priorities across several work packages.

  • Positive and flexible, with a can-do attitude to get the job done.

  • Collaborative, communicating at all levels of the business and working across disciplines.

  • Feedback ready, willing to give proactive and mindful feedback across all levels of the company.

  • Highly motivated, to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven and demanding start-up environment.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

  • Coordinate with other spacecraft engineering disciplines to ensure consistent interfaces and successful end-to-end system integration.

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.description:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.
