jobs.title: Global Water Technologies Lead
jobs.description: The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us onGlobal Water Technologies Lead**Location:** Vevey, Switzerland  **Work model**: Hybrid / Full time  **Contract type / duration:** Permanent  **Target start date**: January 1, 2027  **Deadline for applications**: December 4, 2026**Be a force for good and inspire high\-performing Operations teams**As a **Global Water Technologies Lead at Global Operations**, your mission is to lead technical expertise in water and wastewater treatment and to guide a worldwide network of water experts, so our factories run safe, efficient and sustainable water systems. We are a global community of 150K\+ colleagues across the value chain \-Manufacturing \& Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement and Agriculture\- driving focus, speed and meaningful impact for consumers. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory engineering teams, regional and market technical leaders, sustainability champions, procurement teams, suppliers, universities and research institutes. This is your opportunity to strengthen culture, competitiveness, and future\-ready capabilities as **\#OneOperations****How you'll make an impact as a Global Water Technologies Lead** * Leading technical expertise in water and wastewater treatment across Nestlé factories worldwide, setting the standard for safe, efficient and compliant systems.* Driving the water use reduction strategy by applying the Reduce, Reuse, Recycle model and introducing new technologies and digital solutions.* Building and guiding a global network of water experts who support wells, water treatment and effluent treatment operations and projects.* Delivering major investment projects, from new wells to water recycling systems, through standardised and future\-ready technologies.* Safeguarding food safety, quality and the environment by shaping standards for water as an ingredient, legionella prevention and effluent management.* Growing talent and partnerships by developing expert careers, global training programs and collaboration with universities, suppliers and knowledge partners.**What will make you successful** * Bringing recognized expertise in water treatment and effluent treatment, from system design to daily operations.* Leading and inspiring technical teams and expert networks through influence, coaching and collaboration.* Using a problem\-solving and continuous improvement mindset to manage risk, compliance, cost and performance.* Communicating fluently in English.* Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.**What to expect from our hiring process**We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.All internal candidates whose skills most closely align with the role's requirements will be considered. Please discuss your application with your HR Business Partner and line manager before applying.**Ready to Be a Force for Good?**Apply now and inspire high\-performing Operations teams.j4id10498021jm j4it1148jm j4iy26jm

jobs.title: Analyst
jobs.description: Millennium Management is a global hedge fund with more than 6,000 employees and offices in the United States, Europe and Asia.  We were founded in 1989, and we employ a global multi-strategy investment approach, opportunistically engaging in a broad array of trading and investing strategies. Millennium has differentiated itself from other investment management firms through our consistent ability over the last 35 years to generate returns that have not been correlated to the general market.The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. We offer an opportunity for developing one’s professional career while working with individuals trained in a variety of disciplines in a collegial and dynamic environment. We also offer a broad range of competitive benefits on a global basis. General Information- Hiring Department/Group:    Equities- Role:                                     Analyst- Office Location:                    Zug (CH)Job Function Summary:The successful candidate will support the Equities Volatility business through researching, developing, maintaining and monitoring option pricing and volatility models. They will partner closely with traders, quants, and technology teams to design the models used to price and risk-manage the book, deliver them into the team’s proprietary front-to-back trading platform, and keep them running during market hours, investigating and fixing issues in real time. The role requires strong analytical and modelling skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to move ideas from research to production in a fast-paced trading environment.Principal Responsibilities- Develop and maintain the team’s option pricing and volatility surface models. - Build analytics and front-end tools that support the traders’ decision-making.- Deliver risk, scenario and PnL explain views for the book, and support traders on day-to-day pricing and risk questions.- Contribute to the pricing and execution logic behind automated quoting and hedging.- Monitor pricing, risk and trading services during market hours, and debug and resolve production issues as they occur.- Take over a significant inherited codebase: understand it, keep it running in production, debug it and progressively improve it.- Own robust services and data pipelines, running in a real-time trading environment.Qualifications/Skills Required:- Master’s degree in applied mathematics (with specialism in probability and finance), physics or engineering from a university or equivalent institution.- Minimum of 2–4 years’ experience in an investment bank, including experience in derivatives, in a hybrid role covering quantitative research and quantitative development, to be able to demonstrate building trading models and shipping them as production code.- Strong understanding of derivatives pricing, stochastic calculus, numerical methods and volatility modelling.- Proficiency in Git and Linux required, and experience using Python C++. - Demonstrated experience of delivering production code used by traders and working in a large existing codebase.- Experience working in a fast-paced trading environment and demonstrated experience being able to prioritise under time pressure, take ownership and deliver robust solutions quickly.- Professional fluency in English required to be able to explain models clearly to traders and act on their feedback.

jobs.title: Advocacy officer – AMERICAS
jobs.description: Position summary : The Advocacy Officer (AO) supports and implements advocacy strategies related to the Americas region (50%) and provides general support to activities led by the International Advocacy Director (30%): Within the Americas program, the Advocacy Officer works with partner organizations and networks – particularly members of the Franciscan Family – at the country, regional, and international levels to coordinate and implement a regional advocacy strategy and related activities. The AO identifies key human rights issues within the region and opportunities to address these at the United Nations (UN). The AO also gathers and processes relevant information and facts related to the region.  The AO provides general support to the implementation of advocacy strategies and activities led by the International Advocacy Director.  The AO acts under the supervision of, and in cooperation with, the IAD and operates in compliance with FI’s vision and mission. About Franciscans International :Franciscans International is an international non-governmental organization, with general consultative status at the United Nations, working for the promotion and protection of human rights. Since its establishment in 1989, FI has used advocacy as a tool to address human rights abuses. From its offices in Geneva and New York, FI relies on the expertise and first-hand information of a large network of partners. We work together with and on behalf of Franciscan orders and congregations, as well as with grassroots movements and other civil society organizations to advocate for structural changes addressing the root causes of injustice.  MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES :Planning, management and monitoring results : Under the supervision of the IAD, implement FI’s advocacy strategy and related activities in the Americas region.  Coordination and networking : Coordinate with local partners on advocacy activities through facilitation of meetings, technical support, and mobilization. Participate in relevant regional meetings as needed. Ensure consultation of key constituencies to support FI’s work in specific countries and at the international level. Maintain and develop strategic contacts with Franciscans, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), UN agencies, diplomats, and other relevant partners. UN advocacy work : Address regional and/or country-specific concerns at UN level. Actively participate in relevant UN meetings and debates. Organize and coordinate advocacy work at the UN, including lobby meetings, awareness-raising events, and statements. Invite, organize, assist, and accompany local partners to take part in this work. Maintain and deepen networks and coalitions at international level for joint advocacy purposes.  UN reporting and research : Gather information through communication and coordination with partners. Draft and edit reports, briefings, and other advocacy and awareness-raising materials. Monitor and/or analyze developments concerning human rights issues relevant to FI’s advocacy strategy in the region. Translate information received from national partners into recommendations to UN human rights mechanisms. Capacity building : Implement capacity building activities and training programs for national partners on human rights advocacy. Coordinate and organize workshops and consultations with partners and other stakeholders in the region. Supervision : Assist in the supervision of consultants, provide oversight, and take responsibility for delegated assignments. Coordination with colleagues : Work with fundraising, project management, finance and communications team members. Perform all necessary administrative tasks.  Support to IAD : Assist with reporting on FI advocacy activities. Research and draft advocacy documents. Any other activities, including administrative tasks, required to assist the IAD in the implementation of FI’s overall advocacy strategy. CANDIDATE PROFILE Experience and qualifications :Advanced degree in law, international human rights law, international relations, development, or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant international human rights experience. Familiarity with UN human rights mechanisms, in particular the Human Rights Council and Treaty Bodies, is strongly desired. Experience working with NGOs is considered an asset.  Solid knowledge of the international human rights system, law, and policies. A sound understanding of the political context in which human rights advocacy processes take place.  Familiarity with human rights dynamics and trends in the Americas region, including related to human mobility.  Previous experience working with partners or organizations at the grassroots level is considered an asset. Skills and other requirements :Ability to effectively engage – including publicly – a wide range of audiences (diplomats, UN experts, affected communities, Franciscans, faith-leaders, and human rights defenders). Attention to detail and a strong commitment to achieving expected results. Ability to prioritize assignments and implement advocacy, fact-finding and capacity-building activities as well as monitor their impact. Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills. The ability to work in a diverse team, support colleagues, and work with minimal supervision at times. Proficiency in oral and written English and Spanish is essential. Knowledge of other relevant regional languages, especially Portuguese, is considered as a strong asset. Availability to travel if needed, including to the Americas region.  Strong commitment to human rights, social issues, and environmental justice. FI OFFERS Experience in a professional human rights advocacy organization, with strong connections at the grassroots; and  The ability to grow and develop in a junior position; A weekly working time of 32 hours (80%), 20 days of annual leave, travel insurance, and a salary commensurate with experience.  Location :    Geneva, Switzerland  Reports to : International Advocacy Director (IAD) Contract : 80%, permanent position Start date : 1 February 2027, depending on availability   HOW TO APPLY Deadline for application: 25 December 2026 Applications should be sent in English by email to Mr. Budi Tjahjono at b.tjahjono@franciscansinternational.org specifying “Advocacy Officer” in the subject line.  Applications should include the following documents:  A Curriculum Vitae;  A 1-page letter of motivation;  2 references with contact details – email, phone number, and relation; and  Confirmation that you have a valid Swiss work permit or are eligible to obtain one. Please note that, due to the holiday period, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by 6 January 2027. First-round interviews will be conducted between 11 and 15 January 2027. The successful candidate should start on 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible, depending on availability.  Franciscans International is an equal opportunity employer. All interested candidates matching the requirements are welcome to apply whatever their origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, or belief. We thank all those who apply. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We apologize that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Observatory Systems Engineer for LIFE Space Mission
jobs.description: EinleitungstextETH Zurich | Space is dedicated to advancing space activities both within ETH and in collaboration with external stakeholders. Our mission is to position ETH Zurich as Europe's leading institution in space research and education, while also being recognized as a premier partner for space-related projects within Switzerland and globally. We are committed to driving technological advancements, shaping future policies, and inspiring the next generation of space scientists and engineers.ProjekthintergrundThe LIFE (Large Interferometer for Exoplanets) mission is an ETH Zurich-led concept for a space-based mid-infrared interferometer designed to characterize the atmospheres of nearby exoplanets and search for signs of habitability and life. As part of the ETH Zurich | Space engineering team, you will take a leading technical role in the development of LIFE, working closely with the mission's scientific and engineering teams, international partners, and industrial suppliers. Your work will primarily focus on prototype and precursor developments and, as the project evolves, may extend to elements of the full LIFE observatory. While LIFE will be your primary assignment, you may occasionally contribute to other ETH Zurich | Space missions. This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will take senior technical responsibility for systems engineering of the LIFE observatory and its prototype and precursor developments,  payload and spacecraft systems engineering, integration and test, and technical coordination. their development and implementation across the participating organizations.As part of your role, you will:Lead and coordinate the technical development of assigned LIFE mission, observatory, and payload elements across the mission consortium and industrial partners, ensuring alignment on requirements, interfaces, schedules, and technical decisions in close collaboration with LIFE project specifications, and interface control documents, with requirements flowdown from mission to payload, instrument, and subsystem levels.Lead payload and spacecraft systems engineering across multiple institutions and suppliers, defining and controlling interfaces between instruments, optical assemblies, structures, spacecraft platforms, and other subsystems.Manage technical budgets for mass, power, thermal, data, pointing, and limited-life resources.Develop mission architectures covering launch and orbit selection, platform and payload architecture, ground segment, operations planning, launch campaign preparation, and in-orbit commissioning.Lead cross-discipline trade studies balancing scientific return, technology readiness, mission feasibility, schedule, and cost, particularly in early concept phases.Plan and lead manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test activities for LIFE-related instruments, payloads, and observatory elements, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering and test teams across participating institutions and suppliers.Develop and execute test plans and procedures from component to observatory level, including acceptance and post-delivery testing of externally supplied hardware and environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, EMI/EMC).Manage nonconformances; support or coordinate failure and anomaly review boards, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.Lead mission, payload, and instrument verification and validation, maintaining verification traceability and requirements relevant to scientific objectives.Lead technical risk identification, analysis, and mitigation using methods such as FMECA and fault tree analysis.Lead the technical preparation and coordination of mission and payload lifecycle reviews, including defining review objectives, technical content, and required documentation, and presenting engineering results and recommendations at MDR, PRR, SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, AR, and test readiness reviews.Provide technical oversight of suppliers developing flight and test hardware for LIFE, from specification through acceptance and delivery, and contribute to the integration and test infrastructure required for LIFE prototype, instrument, and observatory development.Coordinate additional technical resources from students and external partners with the project leadership team, mentor junior engineers and students, and contribute to teaching in the Space Systems program where appropriate.Contribute technical content to mission proposals and funding applications, including ESA, SSO, SNSF, and Innosuisse proposals.Ihr ProfilYou have extensive experience in space systems engineering and enjoy taking technical responsibility across disciplines and organizations. An advanced degree is an advantage.10+ years of relevant practical experience in space systems engineering, mission architecture, payload/instrument engineering, or spacecraft engineering.Systems engineering experience at the integrated payload or observatory level on the James Webb Space Telescope, Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, or a comparable large space astrophysics mission, ideally spanning element delivery through integration, test, launch and commissioning.Experience serving as technical authority or interface lead for an integrated payload or observatory composed of elements from different institutions and suppliers (e.g., telescope assembly, science instruments, and supporting structure).Demonstrated senior technical responsibility across the design, development, manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test lifecycle of space-flight missions, payloads, or instruments.Hands-on experience leading verification and validation across multiple requirement levels (e.g., mission, payload, and element), and leading environmental test campaigns at payload or observatory level, including thermal vacuum, dynamics, and EMI/EMC.Strong system-level analysis and trade-study skills, with an in-depth understanding of mission requirements, systems engineering principles, and lifecycle processes.Experience managing technical requirements, interfaces, and supplier deliverables across multiple institutions and industrial partners, including technical oversight of flight-hardware subcontracts.Experience with optical, infrared, or cryogenic science instruments, technical issues, and drive multidisciplinary engineering activities toward project milestones.Proven ability to lead and coordinate distributed, multi-institution teams without direct line authority, jobs.title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and . **Applications can be submitted until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (max. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.For further information, please contact or . **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.   Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology  ******jid92ba563jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Das ist okay, denn wir erwarten auch einiges von Ihnen. Aber erst einmal der Reihe nach:  Reicht eine AHV\- oder IV\-Rente zum Leben nicht, entstehen oft viele Fragen. Auf diese gibt niemand kompetenter und freundlicher Antwort als unsere Kundenberaterinnen und –berater. Die Auskünfte erfolgen meist auf telefonischem oder schriftlichem Weg.  Sie berechnen und verfügen Ergänzungsleistungen. Bei Ihren Entscheiden berücksichtigen Sie die verschiedenen Gesetzgebungen. Auch in anspruchsvollen Dossiers behalten Sie stets den Überblick. Bei Änderungen unternehmen Sie die richtigen Schritte. Bei aller Fachkompetenz agieren und kommunizieren Sie stets mit Einfühlungsvermögen, denn Sie wissen, dass Ihre Berechnungen Auswirkungen haben. In Ihrer Tätigkeit stossen Sie auch immer wieder auf komplexe juristische Fragen und nehmen zur Klärung Kontakt mit unserem Rechtsdienst auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit externen Stellen wie Gemeinden, Bezirksgerichten oder Konkursämtern zusammen.  Sie sehen es, Ihr Arbeitsalltag ist abwechslungsreich und anspruchsvoll zugleich. Aber diese Challenge suchen Sie ja genau, oder?  Sie überzeugen uns fachlich und menschlich.  Sie haben sich mit einer kaufmännischen Ausbildung (E\- oder M\-Profil) auf diese anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit vorbereitet. Alternativ verfügen Sie über eine qualifizierte kaufmännische Weiterbildung mit Handelsdiplom und Erfahrung im Versicherungswesen. Besonders beeindrucken können Sie uns mit einem Fachausweis im Bereich Sozialversicherungen oder mit der Bereitschaft, ihn zu erlangen. Arbeitserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen administrativen Tätigkeit wird Ihnen den Einstieg bei uns sehr erleichtern.  Neben Ihren fachlichen Qualifikationen verfügen Sie über eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit zu vernetztem Denken. Sie haben Freude an komplexen versicherungstechnischen Sachverhalten. Sie entscheiden gerne und kommunizieren klar. Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsraum ist ganz nach Ihren Geschmack und in konstruktivem Feedback sehen Sie die Chance zur Weiterentwicklung.  Wer viel mitbringt, darf auch viel erwarten.  Die SVA Zürich ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Sozialversicherungen. Sie gehört zu den Top\- Arbeitgebenden im Kanton und liegt in Fussdistanz zum Hauptbahnhof Zürich. Dass unsere rund 1200 Mitarbeitenden überdurchschnittlich zufrieden sind, hat gute Gründe: eine Tätigkeit, die Sinn macht, flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home\-Office, gute Sozialleistungen und eine wertschätzende Du\-Kultur. Wollen Sie sich beruflich und persönlich weiterentwickeln? Herzlich willkommen bei uns!Mehr über die SVA Zürich erfahren Sie auf .  Wir freuen uns auf Sie.  Weitere Informationen zu dieser Stelle erhalten Sie von unserer HR\-Fachfrau,  **Brdar**, Telefon .  ![Sozialversicherungsanstalt des Kantons Zürich SVA]()* Sozialversicherungsanstalt des Kantons Zürich SVA  Röntgenstrasse 17  8005 Zürich*jid04f3245jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

  • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

  • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations wirst du Teil unseres Retail-Teams in Rostock und arbeitest eng mit unseren Store Managern und verschiedenen Bereichen der Zentrale zusammen. Deine Mission 🧭

Das bringst du mit 💼

  • Wirtschaftliches Studium: Idealerweise studierst du BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Handelsmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wir geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Faire Vergütung: 17–19 € Stundenlohn zzgl. Bonusmodell sowie 20 % Mitarbeiterrabatt und zusätzliche Prämien.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Deine Arbeitszeiten lassen sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren.

  • Karriereperspektive: Sammle praktische Führungserfahrung und entwickle dich bei entsprechender Eignung perspektivisch in Richtung Area Management weiter.

  • Onboarding & Weiterbildung: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, Unterstützung durch deinen Team Lead sowie Zugang zu internen und externen Trainings.

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Bring deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte unsere Abläufe aktiv mit.

  • Gut versorgt: Zweimal pro Woche gibt es ein frisch gekochtes Mittagessen. Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und frisches Obst stehen dir täglich kostenfrei zur Verfügung.

  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Eine Übernahme nach deinem Studium und deine weitere Entwicklung bei Gusti sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Klingt nach mehr als einem klassischen Studi-Job? Genau das ist es.

Bewirb dich jetzt als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💫

jobs.title: Partner Manager EMEA North
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

The role

🎯 Your main goal will be to make partners a strategic go-to-market pillar for n8n in EMEA North (Benelux and the Nordics), building a focused ecosystem that drives partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue.

As our first partner hire on the ground in the region, here is what you'll own:

🤝 Build a focused partner ecosystem

  • Define the partner plan for EMEA North and pick a core group of 10 to 20 partners that bring repeatable business, not one-off deals.

  • Recruit and activate regional SIs, boutique consultancies and resellers, and engage larger regional SIs where it makes sense.

  • Cover the UK market as well during your first months, alongside EMEA North.

📈 Drive partner revenue

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, split roughly evenly between the two.

  • Run your partner pipeline like a sales motion: qualify, forecast and push deals forward with partners and AEs.

  • Grow sourced and influenced revenue beyond the region's historic benchmark within your first six months.

🧭 Enable partners and align the team

  • Enable partners to position, sell and deliver n8n with confidence.

  • Work hand in hand with regional sales leadership and AEs, partner marketing and solutions engineering.

  • Share what you learn in the field to shape how we go to market with partners across Europe.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🤝 Partner experience: You have 5+ years of experience building partnerships with SIs, resellers or consultancies, from first steps to mature relationships.

  • 💰 Revenue mindset: You see partner management as a sales function, and you're comfortable owning targets, forecasting and running sales cycles with partners.

  • 🔁 Resale and co-sell motions: You have built resale or co-sell motions with both new and established partners.

  • 🧠 Technical acumen: You can position technical solutions like n8n credibly to technical and business audiences.

  • 🏛️ Executive presence: You can represent n8n with confidence at partner leadership level.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You thrive in scale-ups, enjoy building from scratch and work with a high degree of autonomy.

  • 🗣️ English: You're fluent in English, at full professional level.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌍 Local languages: You're a native Dutch, Danish, Norwegian or Swedish speaker.

  • 🏢 GSI and Big Four experience: You have worked with global SIs or Big Four firms alongside smaller partners.

  • 🇳🇱 Netherlands-based: You're based in the Netherlands.

Location

Remote in Europe, ideally in Benelux or the Nordics (Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Norway or Finland). You need an existing right to work in your country of residence.

Why join us?

At n8n, you won't inherit a partner playbook, you'll write it. As our first partner hire on the ground in EMEA North, you'll have the autonomy to shape the partner plan for the territory and define how we go to market with partners across Europe. You'll join a fast-growing, remote-first team that values autonomy, speed and builders who own their results.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

jobs.title: Har du lyst til å jobbe med barn som assistent i skole og sfo?
jobs.description:
For oppdragsgiver på Ringerike (skole) søker vi nå etter en skoleassistent til skole/sfo. Dette er et vikariat/engasjement som kan bli langvarig og vi ønsker oppstart så raskt som mulig.

Skolen har delt i grupper. I den ene gruppen er det barn fra 1-3 trinn og i den andre gruppen 4-6 trinn og i tillegg er det behov på sfo. 

Vi tenker i hovedsak at det ikke kreves noen spesiell bakgrunn men det er en fordel om man er barne- og ungdomsarbeider eller har vært assistent i barnehage/skole eller har erfaring fra arbeid med barn. 

Men det viktigste for oss er at vi finner den rette personen; personlig egnethet teller mest. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • veilede elever i undervisningen
  • være en lærerstøtte
  • oppfølging av enkeltelever som har behov for ekstra støtte
  • følge opp elever når de gjør arbeid eller trenger hjelp
  • er støttende med elevene i lek og samhandling
  • delta på friminutt og uteskole. 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

Det kan være en fordel om man er barn og ungdomsarbeider eller har vært assistent i barnehage/skole eller har erfaring fra arbeid med barn. (ikke noe av dette er krav).

Det viktigste er at man trives med arbeid med barn og at man får energi av å se de utvikle seg og man bidrar til trivsel og trivelig dager. 

Personlig egnethet teller mest for oss.

Vi ser for oss at du er nysgjerrig og interessert i å bli kjent med elevene.

 

Vi tilbyr

  • Varierte og givende arbeidsdager sammen med barn
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • Hyggelig arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer

Høres dette spennende ut?Søk ved å trykke på «Søk på stillingen» og registrer/last opp CV, søknad, attester, vitnemål mm på Temp-Team hjemmeside. 

Har du spørsmål så kontakter du Temp-Team v/Glenn G. Hovde på 

tlf. 982 44 777 eller epost gho@temp-team.noSøknadsfrist: Snarest (og oppstart snarest)

(relevante kandidater kontaktes fortløpende) 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Temp-Team leier ut personell og rekrutterer kandidater til faste stillinger innen de fleste bransjer og stillingskategorier. Vår målsetning er å levere dyktige og motiverte medarbeidere som innfrir våre kunders krav til både faglige kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper. I vår forretningsmodell fokuserer vi på tett personlig oppfølging, etisk forretningsførsel og leveranse som avtalt. Temp-Team ble etablert i Norge i 1985, og har nå 15 avdelinger lokalisert i Bergen, Drammen, Follo, Hønefoss, Kristiansand, Oslo, Romerike, Sandvika, Sarpsborg, Stavanger, Trondheim, Tromsø, og Tønsberg. Vi har også en egen spesialistavdeling for bil og mekanikk. Vårt hovedkontor ligger ved Nationaltheatret i Oslo.Temp-Team inngår i Juhler Group, en internasjonal gruppe av rekrutterings- og bemanningsbyråer med kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Finland, Danmark, og England. I Norge har gruppen om lag 50 internt ansatte og hadde en omsetning på 222 mill. i 2025.

jobs.title: MEKANIIKKASUUNNITTELIJA – KONEAUTOMAATIO JA SISÄLOGISTIIKKA
jobs.description: **Haluatko suunnitella koneita ja automaatiojärjestelmiä, jotka näkyvät ja toimivat oikeassa tuotantoympäristössä?**Kone Kuusisto Oy etsii mekaniikkasuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan suunnitteluosaamistaan.Toimimme automatisoitujen kappaleenkäsittely- ja sisälogistiikkaratkaisujen toimittajana. Suunnittelemme ja toteutamme asiakaskohtaisia koneita, robottijärjestelmiä ja tuotannon automaatioratkaisuja, joiden tavoitteena on tehostaa asiakkaidemme tuotantoa ja materiaalivirtoja.Meillä suunnittelija pääsee vaikuttamaan ratkaisujen tekniseen toteutukseen ja näkemään, miten suunnitellut järjestelmät toimivat käytännössä.**Mitä työtehtäviisi kuuluu?**Tehtävässä osallistut asiakaskohtaisten kone- ja automaatioratkaisujen mekaniikkasuunnitteluun.Työtehtäviäsi ovat esimerkiksi:- Koneiden, laitteiden ja automatisoitujen kappaleenkäsittelyjärjestelmien 3D-mekaniikkasuunnittelu. - Kuljetin-, siirto-, tarttuja- ja muiden käsittelymekanismien suunnittelu. - Kokoonpanojen, osien ja valmistuspiirustusten laatiminen. - Komponenttien valinta, mitoitus ja teknisten ratkaisujen kehittäminen. - Osaluetteloiden ja valmistusdokumentaation tuottaminen. - Yhteistyö sähkö- ja automaatiosuunnittelun, valmistuksen, asennuksen ja käyttöönoton kanssa. - Suunnitteluratkaisujen kehittäminen projektien aikana. Tehtävän sisältöä voidaan painottaa osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Toivomme, että sinulla on:- Soveltuva tekninen koulutus, esimerkiksi konetekniikan insinööri (AMK) tai diplomi-insinööri, tai vastaava käytännössä hankittu osaaminen. - Kokemusta 3D-mekaniikkasuunnittelusta. - Ymmärrystä koneenrakennuksesta, rakenteista ja valmistusmenetelmistä. - Kykyä ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia ja viedä suunnittelutehtäviä eteenpäin. - Oma-aloitteinen ja yhteistyökykyinen työskentelytapa. **Eduksi katsomme:**- Invertor ja muun Autodesk osaamisen. - Kokemuksen teollisuusautomaatiosta, robotiikasta tai materiaalinkäsittelyjärjestelmistä. - Koneenosien, voimansiirron, pneumatiikan ja toimilaitteiden tuntemuksen. - Kokemuksen koneiden turvallisuuteen liittyvistä suunnitteluratkaisuista. - Kokemuksen suunnittelun ja valmistuksen välisestä yhteistyöstä. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Arvostamme myös halua oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- Mahdollisuuden osallistua monipuolisiin kone- ja automaatioprojekteihin. - Työtehtäviä, joissa suunnitteluratkaisut viedään käytännön toteutukseen. - Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittää omaa osaamista. - Yhteistyötä mekaniikka-, sähkö- ja automaatioalan ammattilaisten kanssa. - Tehtävän, jonka vastuuta voidaan kasvattaa kokemuksen karttuessa. **Kiinnostuitko?**Lähetä ansioluettelosi ja lyhyt kuvaus osaamisestasi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **eemeli@konekuusisto.fi**.Kerro hakemuksessasi erityisesti aiemmista suunnitteluprojekteistasi, käyttämistäsi 3D-suunnitteluohjelmistoista sekä siitä, millaisissa tehtävissä haluaisit kehittyä.**Lisätiedot:**Kone Kuusisto Oy / Eemeli Kuusisto Karhusuontie 521 27800 Säkylä 040 582 7218 www.konekuusisto.fi**Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ratkaisuja, jotka tekevät tuotannosta tehokkaampaa.**

Je bent hun aanspreekpunt van begin tot einde, denkt mee na over hun keuzes en zorgt ervoor dat alles vlot verloopt. Een afwisselende functie waarin je commercieel contact combineert met organisatie en opvolging. Benieuwd? Lees dan zeker verder.Om je al een eerste beeld te geven van de job:
  • Eens een residentieel project verkocht is, neem jij het dossier over en word je het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de koper tijdens het volledige afwerkingstraject.
  • Klanten begeleiden bij hun materiaalkeuzes, van vloeren en binnendeuren tot keuken, sanitair en andere afwerkingsdetails.
  • Zorgen voor een correcte administratieve opvolging van dossiers, berekeningen en gemaakte afspraken.
  • Vlot schakelen met leveranciers en partners om alles in goede banen te leiden en de kwaliteit van het project te bewaken.
  • Communiceren met klanten in het Nederlands & af en toe in het Frans en/of Engels.
Je komt terecht bij een ontwikkelaar die zich specialiseert in residentiële nieuwbouwprojecten, zowel appartementen als woningen. Van ontwerp en vergunning tot verkoop, uitvoering en oplevering wordt het volledige traject intern opgevolgd, waardoor kwaliteit en betrokkenheid centraal staan in elk project.Intern kom je terecht in een hecht team van een15tal medewerkers. De communicatielijnen zijn kort, deuren staan letterlijk en figuurlijk open en collega's staan klaar om elkaar te helpen. Er wordt hard gewerkt, maar minstens evenveel belang gehecht aan een aangename werksfeer en een goede verstandhouding binnen het team.De bedrijfscultuur wordt gekenmerkt door gedrevenheid, ambitie en een positieve ingesteldheid. About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
jobs.description:
Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”


Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan? 


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus.

  • Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen.

  • Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting.

  • Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer.

  • Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren.

  • Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken.

  • Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat.

  • Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Wat bieden we?

  • Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux.

  • Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor.

  • Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops.

  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen.

Heb je nog vragen of twijfel je nog een beetje? Geen probleem! Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Niels (Recruiter, Instagram of               

Tot snel!

jobs.title: Assistant administratif - Patrimoine - Cellule Marchés publics et économat H/F/X
jobs.description:
Mission:

Assister les responsables de tous les sites pour négocier tous les petits marchés de fournitures ;

Assurer la gestion de l'économat et des stocks au service Patrimoine,

Assurer la déclaration et suivi des dossiers assurances automobiles ;

Assurer la gestion administrative de l'accord-cadre des appareils multifonctions- imprimantes et leurs consommables.

 

Tâches principales:

Les tâches reprises ci-dessous sont destinées à fournir au travailleur une idée concrète des tâches à réaliser. Celles-ci ne sont pas limitatives et sont susceptibles de modifications selon les besoins du service

Rédaction :

  • Le suivi administratif (publications e-procurement, courriers/contacts avec les candidats/soumissionnaires, informations et notifications des diverses décisions prises ; 
  • Suivi des délais légaux prévus par la réglementation relative aux marchés publics, la loi organique en fonction de la continuité des besoins du CPAS ;
  • Rédaction des rapports d'analyse des offres et des projets de délibérations du Bureau Permanent et du Conseil de l'Action Sociale motivant l'attribution ou la non-attribution des marchés ;
  • Préparation des bons de commande ;
  • Prévision et modifications budgétaires sur base d'une analyse des consommations ;
  • Encodage des factures, notes de crédit et engagements provisoires.
  • Partager au reste de l'équipe ses connaissances
  • Exécuter toute tâche utile au bon fonctionnement du service Patrimoine.

Législation :

  • Connaissance de base de la réglementation en matière de marchés publics et de la loi organique des CPAS ;

Planification :

  • Préparation de la partie technique des Cahiers spéciaux de charges concernant les fournitures du CPAS ;
  • Gestion des échéances des marchés et anticipation des marchés à relancer ;
  • Gestion des petits marchés publics (procédures négociées) pour l'Administration Centrale et assister les autres services dans la négociation de ces marchés ;
  • Gestion des articles de bureau et des stocks ;
  • Contrôle des paiements, des arriérés et des dépenses.

Economat :

  • Encodage des factures, notes de crédit et engagements provisoires ;
  • Contrôle des paiements, des arriérés et des dépenses ;
  • Analyse et comparaison des prix (prospection du marché) ;
  • Préparation des bons de commande ;
  • Préparation de la partie technique des cahiers spéciaux des charges concernant les marchés de fournitures de bureaux en ce compris la commande des appareils multifonctions, imprimantes et le du mobilier de bureau ;
  • Gestion des articles de bureau et des stocks papeterie, mobilier, produits d'entretien, petits appareils électriques, cafétéria,... ;
  • Réception et contrôle des livraisons ;
  • Approvisionnement et organisation du dépannage des multifonctions, télécopieurs, affranchisseuse, plieuse-colleuse, etc.) ;
  • Accueil des représentants ;
  • Prévisions et modifications budgétaires sur base d'une analyse des consommations ;
  • Assurer la gestion comptable et administrative des courriers sortants ;

Profil :

Diplôme requis :  

Diplôme de l'enseignement secondaire supérieur : CESS ou équivalence belge

Compétences requises:

  • Maîtrise des outils de bureautique classiques (Outlook, Word, Excel, OneNote) ;
  • Etre en mesure de consulter et d'analyser avec pertinence les textes légaux en matière de marchés publics ;
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et bonne orthographe ;
  • Organisation et rigueur administrative ;
  • Initiative, autonomie et adaptabilité ;
  • Sens des responsabilités ;
  • Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse ;
  • Facilités de contact et de communication ;
  • Connaissance élémentaire écrite et orale de la seconde langue (Selor Art. 8 et 10 ou équivalent).

Constituent un plus : 

  • Connaissance de la législation en matière de marchés publics et/ou expérience en droit public
  • Connaissance de BO Secrétariat, 3P, OneNote ;
  • Connaissance du fonctionnement d'un CPAS ;

Nous proposons :

  • Respect de l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée :

jobs.title: Butikkselger på Kid Interiør, Thon Senter Oasen Haugesund
jobs.description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

Til vår butikk på Thon Senter Oasen i Haugesund søker vi nå en butikkmedarbeider i 20% stilling. Kanskje er det deg?

Hos Kid hjelper vi kundene med å skape hjem de trives i. Nå ser vi etter en ny kollega som vil være med på å skape inspirerende handleopplevelser, gode resultater og et hyggelig miljø for både kunder og kollegaer.

Som butikkselger hos oss blir du en viktig del av teamet. Du møter mennesker med et smil, liker å ta initiativ og trives i en aktiv hverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like.

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • Gi kundene gode opplevelser gjennom service og salg
  • Inspirere og veilede kunder i valg av produkter
  • Bidra til at butikken alltid fremstår ryddig, innbydende og inspirerende
  • Varepåfylling, vareplassering og kampanjegjennomføring
  • Jobbe mot butikkens mål og bidra til gode resultater
  • Samarbeide med kollegaer for å skape en velfungerende butikkhverdag

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Er positiv, utadvendt og glad i å møte mennesker
  • Motiveres av salg og gode kundeopplevelser
  • Tar initiativ, ser hva som må gjøres og får ting gjort
  • Er ansvarsfull, løsningsorientert og fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid
  • Trives i et høyt tempo og liker varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Har interesse for interiør, tekstiler og trender
  • Snakker og skriver norsk godt
Derfor trives medarbeiderne våre i KidDa vi spurte noen av våre kollegaer hva de liker best med å jobbe hos oss, svarte de:«Kid har gode verdier og ser den enkelte medarbeider.»«Det er lett å lære seg jobben, og man får raskt en god mestringsfølelse.»«Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver med gode utviklingsmuligheter.»

«Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!»

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg innen salg, kundeservice og retail
  • Flotte kvalitetsprodukter og inspirerende butikkmiljøer
  • Varierte arbeidsdager hvor din innsats gjør en forskjell
  • Et stort butikknettverk med muligheter på tvers av landet
  • Bonusordning for alle faste medarbeidere som er ansatt i mer enn 20 % stilling

Med en veldrevet organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder vil være butikkleder. Du blir en del av et sammensveiset team med dyktige kolleger, både i egen butikk, i regionen og som en del av et stort nordisk konsern.

Interessert? Søk via vår karriereside på karriere.kid.no. Vi behandler kun søknader som registreres i vår rekrutteringsportal.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...

jobs.title: Technisch Coördinator: Installaties & Organisatie
jobs.description:
Ben jij een technisch organisatietalent dat graag het overzicht bewaart, snel schakelt en ervoor zorgt dat installaties van voorbereiding tot uitvoering vlekkeloos verlopen?

Wil jij jouw technische kennis en organisatietalent inzetten in een verantwoordelijke functie waarin je installatieteams aanstuurt, uitdagingen oplost en de volledige installatiewerking mee organiseert en verbetert?

Voor een groeiend technisch bedrijf in de regio Tielt zoeken we een Technisch Coördinator die techniek en organisatietalent combineert.

Je coördineert installaties van voorbereiding tot uitvoering, begeleidt installatieteams en krijgt de ruimte om de werking verder te optimaliseren.

Jouw uitdaging
  • Neem de coördinatie van technische installaties in handen: je plant en organiseert de werkzaamheden van verschillende installatieteams en volgt de uitvoering van de projecten nauwgezet op.
  • Zorg voor een sterke technische voorbereiding: je analyseert de installatievereisten, bereidt werkopdrachten voor en zorgt ervoor dat installateurs over duidelijke instructies en de nodige informatie beschikken.
  • Stem mensen, materialen en planning op elkaar af: je controleert de beschikbaarheid van materialen en zorgt ervoor dat alles tijdig klaarstaat voor een vlotte uitvoering.
  • Wees het centrale aanspreekpunt: je onderhoudt contacten met klanten, installateurs en interne collega's en zorgt voor een duidelijke communicatie over planning, uitvoering en praktische afspraken.
  • Begeleid klanten van voorbereiding tot installatie: je bespreekt de praktische en technische aspecten van installaties met Nederlandstalige en Franstalige klanten.
  • Blijf betrokken bij de technische praktijk: je voert waar nodig plaatsbezoeken uit om de technische situatie te beoordelen en installaties correct voor te bereiden. Bij grotere projecten ga je ook ter plaatse om de voortgang van de werkzaamheden op te volgen en waar nodig bij te sturen.
  • Ondersteun en begeleid de installatieteams: je zorgt voor duidelijke werkafspraken, helpt medewerkers bij technische of organisatorische vragen en stimuleert een efficiënte samenwerking.
  • Bewaak kwaliteit en veiligheid: je ziet erop toe dat installaties correct worden voorbereid en uitgevoerd, met aandacht voor veiligheidsvoorschriften en een klantgerichte dienstverlening.
  • Maak de werking steeds efficiënter: je verzorgt de nacalculatie van projecten, analyseert verbeterpunten en neemt initiatief om de planning, voorbereiding en samenwerking verder te optimaliseren.
Wie zoeken we?
  • Je beschikt over een bachelorsdiploma in een technische richting of je hebt gelijkwaardige ervaring.
  • Je hebt een grondige technische kennis van sanitair en elektriciteit en kunt technische installaties correct beoordelen en voorbereiden.
  • Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en kunt verschillende installaties en werkopdrachten tegelijk coördineren.
  • Je combineert technisch inzicht met een praktische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak en weet snel de juiste prioriteiten te bepalen.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en beschikt over een goede praktische kennis van het Frans en Engels om met klanten, leveranciers en andere betrokken partijen te overleggen.
  • Je bent communicatief en klantgericht en kunt duidelijke afspraken maken met zowel klanten als technische medewerkers.
  • Je hebt de nodige leidinggevende en coachende vaardigheden om installatieteams te ondersteunen, aan te sturen en te motiveren.
  • Je bent analytisch en besluitvaardig en kunt technische en organisatorische informatie vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.
  • Je neemt graag initiatief om processen te verbeteren en hebt aandacht voor kwaliteit, efficiëntie en veiligheid.
Technisch sterk? Organisatorisch nog sterker? Dan hebben wij misschien jouw volgende uitdaging!

Jij zorgt ervoor dat alles op de juiste plaats staat. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jouw carrière de juiste richting uitgaat.

jobs.title: Meewerkend Kraanmachinist
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren kraanmachinist die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt, maar ook graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt? Als Meewerkend Kraanmachinist Mobiele Kraan combineer je zelfstandig hijswerk met montage- en onderhoudswerkzaamheden op verschillende werven.

Je bent ongeveer 90% van je tijd actief met de kraan. De overige 10% werk je samen met je collega's mee aan montagewerk of industrieel onderhoud. Een afwisselende functie dus, waarbij je zowel technisch inzicht als vakmanschap kunt inzetten.

Functieomschrijving

Als Meewerkend Kraanmachinist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en correct uitvoeren van hijswerkzaamheden op verschillende werven.

Jouw taken bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Je verplaatst de mobiele/telescopische kraan over de openbare weg.
  • Je beheert de kraan en het bijhorende materiaal en staat zelfstandig in voor het opstellen van de kraan.
  • Je controleert en gebruikt de hijsmiddelen op een correcte manier.
  • Je slaat lasten veilig en correct aan.
  • Je leest en interpreteert hijsplannen en voert hijswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit.
  • Je werkt op verschillende werven en past je aan de omstandigheden en het type project aan.
  • Je voert het eerstelijns onderhoud van je kraan uit en zorgt ervoor dat je machine in goede staat blijft.
  • Je werkt ongeveer 90% van de tijd met de kraan.
  • Tijdens de overige werkzaamheden help je collega's mee met montagewerk en/of industrieel onderhoud.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met de collega's op de werf en zorgt voor een goede communicatie, onder andere via walkie talkie.
  • Je werkt steeds volgens de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften.
  • Je hebt ervaring als kraanmachinist, bij voorkeur met mobiele of telescopische kranen.
  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.
  • Het lezen en interpreteren van hijsplannen vormt voor jou geen probleem.
  • Je bent flexibel ingesteld en staat open voor verschillende taken, werven en werkuren.
  • Je spreekt goed tot zeer goed Nederlands, zodat communicatie en veiligheid op de werf gegarandeerd zijn.
  • Je beschikt over een hijsbewijs en attest voor het aanslaan van lasten, of bent bereid deze te behalen.
  • Je hebt geen hoogtevrees.
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk, nauwkeurig en resultaatgericht.
  • Veiligheid staat bij jou altijd voorop.
  • Je beschikt over een VCA-attest, of bent bereid dit te behalen.
  • Je bent technisch en praktisch ingesteld en steekt graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen.
  • Je kunt snel en nauwkeurig werken, ook wanneer de omstandigheden op de werf veranderen.
