Arbeidssted: Leknes lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (hovedsakelig kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 20 - 40%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte. 

  • Klargjøre leiebiler i henhold til våre standarder (vask mm)

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Service Provider for Ship Cleaning
jobs.description: Are you looking for a part-time job that fits well alongside your studies or other work? Would you enjoy an active job where the pace is fast, the team is international and every shift keeps you moving? Join our team at SOL in Turku!As a Service Provider (Palveluvastaava), you will work as part of our cleaning team on a ship docked in Turku. Your tasks include cleaning cabins and the ship's common areas, such as bathrooms, making beds, collecting waste, vacuuming and wiping and cleaning different surfaces.The working environment is fast-paced, and you will work around customers and as part of a team. Tasks are divided between team members at the beginning of each shift. The amount of work varies depending on the day and shift, and Saturday evenings in particular can be busy.Working hours are 7:10–8:40 and 19:36–21:00, Monday to Sunday. The guaranteed working time is approximately 5 hours per week, but depending on your availability, you can typically work around 5–15 hours per week. Due to the working hours, the position is particularly suitable for students or those who have another daytime or part-time job.The employment is permanent and part-time, and the starting date will be agreed with you.WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?For this position, we expect you to: * be at least 18 years old * have good communication and interaction skills * be able to communicate in Finnish or English at a good level * be comfortable working in a busy environment where situations can change quickly * have a positive attitude towards customer service and teamwork.Previous experience in cleaning or similar work is an advantage, but it is not required. We will teach you the tasks and support you in learning the job.The work is active and involves a lot of walking, using stairs and working at a quick pace, so you should be comfortable with physically active work.WHAT DO WE OFFER YOU?You will join a multicultural team where the working languages are Finnish and English. The work is mainly done in teams, and you will receive an introduction to your duties, so you will not be left to figure things out on your own.We offer you: * a permanent part-time position * flexible working opportunities, typically 5–15 hours per week * thorough introduction to your tasks * a supportive and international work community * an active job that fits well alongside studies or other daytime work.The salary is determined according to the Collective Agreement for the Facilities Services Sector (KIPA TES), pay grades PR1–PR2, depending on the duties and experience.Interested? Fill in the online application and apply to join our sunny team! Please note that we do not accept applications by email.For more information about the position, please contact Roman Yehorov (roman.yehorov@sol.fi).SOL Palvelut Oy is a Finnish service company providing high-quality cleaning and facility services nationwide for a wide range of properties, including offices, industrial facilities, shopping centres and public spaces. We provide our customers with solutions for cleanliness and high standards of hygiene, serving businesses, central government and municipalities throughout Finland. We invest in our employees skills, training and career development. In 2025, SOL Palvelut had a revenue of EUR 190 million. We are committed to environmental goals such as using 100% renewable electricity, improving energy efficiency and using Nordic Swan Ecolabelled cleaning products. SOL Palvelut is part of the family-owned SOL Group, which employs more than 12,000 people.

jobs.title: Heavy Vehicle and Machinery Mechanic

  • Good knowledge of hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical systems

  • Ability to read technical drawings and service manuals
  • Good level of English communication

Work conditions:

 or +47 463 61 676.

jobs.title: Palvelumyyjä Asiakasomistajapalvelu- ja S-Pankki-pisteelle Kirkkonummelle / Tjänsteförsäljare till Ägarkundstjänst- och S-Banken-punkten i Kyrkslätt
jobs.description: Primary location:KIRKKONUMMITervetuloa tarjoamaan asiakkaille parasta palvelua Asiakasomistajuus ja S-Pankki-asioissa!Haemme meille Varuboden-Oslalle palvelumyyjää asiakasomistajapalvelu- ja S-Pankki-pisteelle Kirkkonummelle määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen ensi vuoden loppuun saakka. Työaika on 37,5 h/vko.Millaista työtä tarjoamme?Palvelumyyjänä pääset palvelemaan asiakkaitamme monipuolisesti asiakasomistajuuteen ja S-Pankin palveluihin liittyvissä asioissa.Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat irti täyden hyödyn osuuskaupan asiakasomistajuudestaja S-Pankin päivittäisistä palveluista.Kerrot asiakkaalle S-mobiilin monipuolisista palveluista ja eduista sekä vinkkaat asiakasomistajille hyödyllisistä digipalveluista.Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä jatkuvan tuen kehittyäksesi.Tähtäämme yhdessä tavoitteisiimme ja saat osaavan tiimin tueksesi.Pidämme sinusta hyvää huolta mm. liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun avulla. Lisäksi tarjoamme Suomen parhaat henkilökuntaedut, joita pääset käyttämään ympäri Suomen, S-ryhmän ja yhteistyökumppaneiden toimipisteissä. Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuden jatkuvalle itsensä kehittämiselle erilaisin koulutusmahdollisuuksin.Palkkaus tässä tehtävässä määräytyy kaupan työehtosopimuksen määrittelemästä ja on aiemmasta kokemuksesta riippuen 2233€/kk – 2572€/kk, minkä lisäksi palkitsemme myyntitavoitteiden saavuttamisesta kvartaaleittain. Lisäksi meillä on mahdollisuus koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon koko yrityksen tuloksen perusteella.Mitä toivomme sinulta?Olet tavoitteellinen ja pidät myyntityöstä.Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus ja/tai työkokemusta myynti- tai asiakaspalvelutyöstä.Haluat ylittää asiakkaan odotukset jokaisessa asiakaskohtaamisessa ja osaat hahmottaa asiakkaan kokonaistilanteen.Sinulta löytyy sekä kykyä että halua oppia uutta. Käytät ketterästi työssä vaadittavia järjestelmiä.Osuuskauppamme on kaksikielinen ja katsomme eduksesi, jos osaat palvella asiakkaitamme sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi.Ajokortti on tässä tehtävässä välttämätön.Kiinnostuitko? Hae tehtävää jo tänään!Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 13.12.2026.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa asiakkuuspäällikkö Satu Suoniemi (satu.suoniemi@sok.fi). Tehtävä alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.Jos tulet valituksi tehtävään, tarkistamme luottotietosi ja oikeustoimikelpoisuutesi.--------Välkommen att erbjuda kunder bästa möjliga service i frågor gällande ägarkundskap och S-Banken!Vi söker en tjänsteförsäljare till Varuboden-Oslas ägarkundstjänst- och S-Banken-punkt i Kyrkslätt för en tidsbunden anställning som familjeledighetsvikarie fram till slutet av nästa år. Veckoarbetstiden är 37,5h/veckaVilken typ av arbete erbjuder vi?Som tjänsteförsäljare får du betjäna våra kunder mångsidigt i frågor som gäller ägarkundskap och S-Bankens tjänster.Ditt mål är att säkerställa att våra kunder får full nytta av ägarkundskapet i vårt handelslag och av S-Bankens dagliga tjänster.undefinedDu berättar för kunden om de mångsidiga tjänsterna och förmånerna i S-mobil och ger tips om digitala tjänster som ägarkunder har nytta av. Vi erbjuder en omfattande introduktion och kontinuerligt stöd så att du kan Vi arbetar tillsammans för att nå våra mål och som stöd får du ett kompetent team.Vi tar väl hand om vår personal bland annat genom motions-, kultur- och välmåendeförmån. Dessutom erbjuder vi Finlands bästa personalförmåner som du kan utnyttja runtom i Finland, i både S-gruppens och våra samarbetspartners enheter. Vi erbjuder dig även möjligheten att ständigt utveckla dig själv genom olika utbildningsmöjligheter.Lönenför denna tjänst baserar sig på handelsbranschens kollektivavtal och är mellan 2233€/månad och 2572€/månad beroende på tidigare arbetserfarenhet. Dessutom belönar vi för uppnådda försäljningsmål kvartalvis. Utöver detta erbjuder vi möjligheten till en resultatpremie för hela personalen på upp till 1,70 €/ arbetad timme, baserat på resultatet för företaget som helhet.Vad förväntar vi oss av dig?Du är målmedveten och tycker om försäljningsarbete. Du har lämplig utbildning och/eller arbetserfarenhet av försäljnings- eller kundservicearbete. Du vill överträffa kundens förväntningar i varje kundmöte och du kan skapa dig en helhetsbild av kundens situation. Du har både förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker. Du använder smidigt de system som jobbet kräver. Vårt handelslag är tvåspråkigt och det är en fördel om du kan betjäna våra kunder både på finska och svenska. Körkort är nödvändigt för tjänsten.Intresserad? Ansök redan i dag!Vi framskrider med rekryteringsprocessen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt, men senast söndagen den 13.12.2026.För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta kundrelationschef Satu Suoniemi (satu.suoniemi@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.Om du blir vald för tjänsten kontrollerar vi dina kreditupplysningar och din rättshandlingsförmåga.

jobs.title: Kundrådgivare till Vasa
jobs.description: Jyväskylän Aluetaksi Oy söker kundrådgivare för att förstärka sitt team i Vasa!Vi söker till Vasa, serviceinriktade och positiva medarbetare till mångsidiga kundserviceuppgifter. Som kundrådgivare är du en viktig länk mellan kunder och förare och bidrar till en smidig kundupplevelse av hög kvalitet.Jyväskylän Aluetaksi Oy:s dotterbolag KSMYK har valts till tjänsteproducent för FPA-ersatta taxiresor i Mellersta Finland, Österbotten, Nyland, Egentliga Tavastland och Kajanaland under avtalsperioden 2027–2030. Dessutom är KSMYK avtalspartner för Joensuun Taksi Oy i tre landskap.Produktionen av FPA-taxitjänster inleds den 1 januari 2027, och i och med den nya tjänsteproduktionen söker vi nu nya kundrådgivare till våra beställningscentraler.Vad innebär arbetet?·Att betjäna kunder via telefon, e-post och chatt·Att ta emot beställningar och förmedla dem i systemet·Att följa beställningarnas status·Att säkerställa att beställningarna genomförs·Att arbeta i ett trevligt team där hjälp och stöd alltid finns att få·En gedigen introduktion av hög kvalitetVad förväntar vi oss av dig?·Flytande kunskaper i finska och svenska (kunskaper i engelska ses som en fördel)·En genuin vilja att hjälpa kunder·God kommunikationsförmåga och goda kundservicefärdigheter·En tydlig telefonröst och grundläggande IT-kunskaper·Ett aktivt, initiativrikt och självständigt arbetssättTidigare erfarenhet av kundservice eller arbete i en callcentermiljö är meriterande, men det viktigaste är rätt inställning och en vilja att lära sig.Varför välja oss?Arbetet är förlagt till tre skift, vilket ger frihet och flexibilitet i vardagen. jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Translational Research
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

Do you want to contribute to research about non-coding RNAs in sperm health and infertility?

A PhD position is available at the Department of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences in the Translational Vascular Research group, working on the project ´Developmental non-coding RNA signatures of sperm health and infertility´

The Translational Vascular Research group includes both basic scientists and clinicians. We perform research spanning across disciplines, from the analysis of patient samples to laboratory based investigation of cell behaviour. Parts of our research group are based at Karolinska Institute/KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden, with the opportunity for close collaborations with these institutes.The fertility department at the Women’s clinic at the University Hospital of North Norway (UNN) is a collaboration partner and will contribute with expertise in andrology and analysis of semen samples.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD program is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25% each year and will consist of teaching and other duties for the Department of Clinical Medicine. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to a PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position. 

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Male infertility is an increasing global health concern, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying impaired sperm function remain poorly understood. Previously, our group identified more than 2,000 testis-enriched non-coding RNAs and characterised their expression across germ-cell development. In this project, you will investigate which of these non-coding RNAs persist into mature sperm and whether their expression is associated with sperm quality and fertility. In collaboration with the fertility clinic atthe University Hospital of North Norway (UNN), you will analyse sperm samples from fertility patients and healthy donors. Using sperm phenotyping, cell sorting and RNA sequencing, you will examine differences in non-coding RNA expression between sperm populations with different functional characteristics, including motility and morphology. Selected transcripts will also be investigated in matched testicular tissue using imaging and in situ hybridisation to study their expression during germcell development. By integrating molecular and clinical data, the project aims to identify non-coding RNA signatures associated with sperm health and their potential as biomarkers of male fertility.

You must submit a cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests. 

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Professor Lynn Butler 

  • phone: +47 776 25 104
  • email: lynn.m.butler@uit.no
Qualifications

Required Professional Qualifications

  • A Candidate Medicine, or a Master’s degree in biological sciences . If you are near completion of your Master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis. You must document completion of your degree before commencement in the position.
  • Documented fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications, but not required:

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language
  • Prior experience with cell culture-based laboratory projects, bioinformatics is beneficial. The candidate must be flexible and keen to work as part of a larger team.

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

Required Personal Qualifications

  • An enthusiasm for research and learning
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a larger team
  • Willingness to collaborate with others During the assessment, emphasis will be put on your potential, motivation and personal suitability for the position.

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective. Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at UiT The Arctic University of Norway represents a newly created entity gathering almost all possible health study programs. This facilitates an unique interdisciplinarity and innovation in health education and research. We work closely with the services in the North to solve tomorrow's challenges. Read more about us at uit.no/helsefak

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

jobs.description:
Do you have an eye for detail and take pride in leaving behind a high-quality result? Then you may be our new colleague in the Cleaning Services team.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will carry out cleaning and service tasks for Jeudan’s customers, focusing on the quality and standards that characterize Jeudan. You will be responsible for checking the quality of your own work and ensuring that all tasks are completed thoroughly.

You will also be responsible for ordering and replenishing consumables. If you identify any issues, defects, or maintenance needs in a customer’s premises, you must report them so that we can maintain a high level of quality and service in accordance with our service agreements.

You will perform ongoing self-inspections and maintain a dialogue with the Operations Manager regarding tasks and the quality of the work performed.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone with experience in commercial cleaning and service.

You are positive, service-minded, and able to work independently in a structured manner. You have a keen eye for detail and can communicate in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing, at a level that enables you to interact effectively with customers, colleagues, and others.

In addition, it is important that you enjoy working independently and are comfortable working evening shifts.

The properties you will be responsible for, or provide cover for, are located in central Copenhagen. Therefore, you must be comfortable cycling around the city using an electric cargo bike.

WHAT WE OFFER

A workplace where your employment conditions are well organized and professionally managed. At Jeudan, we take pride in having you as part of a team that helps maintain and care for the classic and heritage-listed properties in central Copenhagen.

We offer an attractive position with competitive employment terms, including a pension scheme, health insurance plan, and flexible benefits package in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM, with mutual flexibility to accommodate customer needs.

APPLICATION

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Operations Manager Gitte Enright through Jeudan’s main switchboard on +45 7010 6070.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consultant to join our Microsoft Applications practice.

Eligibility: Should be eligible for UK SC Clearance

In this role, you will provide expert consultancy, support, solution design, development, and technical leadership across a portfolio of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions. You will work closely with customers to understand business requirements, design scalable solutions, deliver enhancements, and support the ongoing optimisation of their Dynamics 365 environments.

As a senior consultant, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers, providing technical expertise across the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform ecosystem while supporting delivery teams in the successful implementation and support of business-critical solutions. You will contribute to solution architecture, application customisation, integrations, upgrades, migrations, and continual service improvement initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Dynamics 365 professional who enjoys combining technical expertise, customer engagement, and solution delivery within a managed services and consultancy environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level consultancy, support, and technical leadership for Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.
  • Design, configure, customise, and extend Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement applications to meet customer requirements.
  • Deliver enhancements, change requests, and project-based development across customer portfolios.
  • Develop custom plugins, workflows, custom APIs, integrations, and extensions using C# and .NET.
  • Build and maintain Power Platform solutions including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse components.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and performance issues.
  • Work directly with customer stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and recommend best-practice solutions.
  • Support upgrades, migrations, and platform optimisation initiatives.
  • Contribute to solution design workshops, technical documentation, and estimation activities.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for technical issues and support teams.
  • Mentor junior consultants and promote knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and service enhancement.
  • Ensure solutions align with Microsoft best practices, governance standards, and security requirements.

Qualifications

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience implementing Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM) platform and core technologies.
  • Extensive experience designing, configuring, and supporting Dynamics 365 solutions.
  • Strong development experience using C#, .NET, JavaScript, and TypeScript within Dynamics 365 environments.
  • Hands-on experience developing Plugins, Custom Workflow Activities, Custom APIs, and integrations.
  • Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security models, and data management.
  • Experience delivering solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Experience integrating Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions with external systems and services.
  • Experience gathering, analysing, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience working within managed services, consultancy, or customer-facing delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proven experience acting as a technical lead or senior consultant on customer engagements.

Desirable Skills

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Service implementation experience.
  • Dynamics 365 Sales implementation experience.
  • Power Pages experience.
  • Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus experience.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure integration services.
  • Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Experience delivering Dynamics 365 migrations and upgrade projects.
  • Power BI experience.
  • Experience working within public sector environments.
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications.
  • Microsoft Power Platform certifications.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Security Clearance (SC) or eligibility to obtain SC clearance.

Personal Attributes

  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and self-motivated.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality.
  • Positive and consultative approach to customer engagement.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and learning.

The Successful Candidate Will

  • Deliver high-quality Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions that meet customer requirements and business objectives.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers through technical expertise and professional consultancy.
  • Drive the successful delivery of enhancements, upgrades, and platform improvements.
  • Improve solution performance, maintainability, and user adoption.
  • Reduce recurring issues through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
  • Support the growth of the Dynamics 365 capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership.
  • Contribute to customer satisfaction, retention, and continued service growth opportunities.
  • Ensure solutions are aligned with Microsoft best practices, governance standards, and operational support requirements.

jobs.description: •    Prípravné a dokončovacie práce (Mise-en-place): Kompletná realizácia prípravných prác pred začatím prevádzky a upratovacích prác po jej skončení. Čistenie, leštenie a preberanie inventáru (príbory, sklo, porcelán), prestieranie stolov a príprava doplnkov na stoly podľa štandardov hotela.•    Vizuálna kontrola a doplňovanie bufetov: Zabezpečenie bezchybného vizuálneho stavu bufetových stolov. Dodržiavanie stanovených 5* gastronomických pravidiel obsluhy, poskytovanie informácií o ponuke nápojov a jedál.•    Práca s pokladňou a POS systémom: Prijímanie objednávok na nápoje mimo základného bufetu, ich presné zaúčtovanie v hotelovom reštauračnom systéme a realizácia platieb (hotovosť, platobné karty, izbové účty) v súlade s internými finančnými smernicami.•    Debarasovanie a hygiena rajónu: Priebežné a rýchle odnášanie použitého inventáru zo stolov hostí (debarasovanie), udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na stoloch, príručných stolíkoch a v celom pridelenom rajóne počas celej zmeny.•    Základný servis nápojov a výčap: Obsluha výčapného zariadenia, správny a estetický servis piva, nealkoholických nápojov, fľašových vín, ako aj základná príprava bežných teplých kávových a čajových nápojov.•    Aktívny predaj (Upselling): Aktívne ponúkanie a odporúčanie prémiových nápojov, vín alebo dennej ponuky nad rámec štandardného bufetu s cieľom maximalizovať priemernú útratu hostí.•    Prípravné práce pre MICE a bankety: Aktívna účasť na príprave miestností a inventáru pre konferencie, školenia a firemné akcie (MICE). Priamy výkon obsluhy, roznášanie jedál, debaras a asistencia počas slávnostných recepcií, svadieb a gala večerí podľa pokynov nadriadeného.•    Hygienické štandardy (HACCP): Prísne a nekompromisné dodržiavanie osobných hygienických štandardov, pravidiel úpravy zovňajšku (grooming) a hygienických predpisov systému HACCP na stredisku•    Všeobecné ustanovenia: Dodržiavanie a plnenie príkazov nadriadeného. Dodatočné povinnosti a úlohy môžu byť zamestnancovi pridelené v rámci dohodnutého druhu práce podľa požiadaviek prevádzky hotela a aktuálnej situácie.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
- Poskytuje prijímateľom sociálnej služby každodennú opatrovateľskú starostlivosť, praktickú podporu a primeraný dohľad podľa ich individuálnych potrieb, schopností a aktuálneho zdravotného stavu, pričom podporuje čo najvyššiu možnú mieru ich samostatnosti.
- Poskytuje pomoc, podporu alebo dohľad pri sebaobslužných činnostiach, najmä pri osobnej hygiene, starostlivosti o ústnu dutinu, vlasy a nechty, obliekaní, obúvaní, stravovaní, pitnom režime, vyprázdňovaní a používaní inkontinenčných a kompenzačných pomôcok.
- Poskytuje pomoc pri mobilite, chôdzi, vstávaní, líhaní, presunoch a polohovaní a vykonáva ďalšie opatrovateľské opatrenia v rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, individuálnych potrieb prijímateľa a pokynov oprávneného odborného pracovníka.
- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.
- V rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, zaškolenia, poverenia a interných postupov vykonáva alebo asistuje pri meraní základných fyziologických funkcií, podporuje dodržiavanie liečebného režimu a poskytuje pomoc pri užívaní liekov iba v rozsahu dovolenom právnymi predpismi a internými postupmi.
- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežných činnostiach spojených s vedením domácnosti, najmä pri plánovaní a realizácii nákupu, príprave a podávaní jedla, umývaní riadu, upratovaní, vetraní, starostlivosti o lôžko a bielizeň, triedení odpadu a bezpečnom používaní domácich spotrebičov; ak prijímateľ činnosť nezvládne, vykoná ju v potrebnom rozsahu.
- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky
- finančný príspevok na stravu

Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

  • Audit & Tax Support: Support local annual statutory audits and tax filings (VAT, CIT, etc.) by preparing audit schedules and liaising with external auditors.

  • Financial Reconciliation: Perform regular balance sheet reconciliations, identifying and resolving variances between corporate reporting systems and local statutory ledgers..

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

  • At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Location and employment

This is a full-time employee role, remote and based in Toronto, Ontario. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications for this role.

jobs.title: Manager, DC Commercial Diligence
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the worldâs largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a Manager of DC Commercial Diligence to support commercial due diligence across our data center acquisition pipeline. This is a hands-on underwriting role: for every site Vultr pursues, whether an operator colocation lease, a powered shell, a lease-to-own structure, or a powered land purchase, you will work the data room directly, build out findings, and bring a well-supported point of view to the Senior Manager on whether the deal is what it claims to be. You will build fluency across power availability and energy commercial terms, counterparty and lease economics, and the deal model, and your work will directly inform the Go/No-Go recommendations and negotiating positions the Senior Manager brings to investment gates on transactions worth tens to hundreds of millions of dollars. Your job is to be constructively adversarial to every deal: the diligence function exists to find what the seller's materials do not say.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support commercial due diligence end to end for active acquisitions: review documents in the data room, maintain the findings register, and prepare evidence-based materials for investment gates alongside the Senior Manager

  • Diligence power under guidance: interconnection queue position versus contracted capacity, utility and ESA terms, tariff structure, curtailment provisions, demand charge pass-throughs, and power-on forecast credibility, flagging where bankable capacity and marketing figures diverge

  • Diligence counterparties: operator financial health and credit, guarantor structure, lease terms including minimum power obligations, escalations, expansion rights, termination provisions, and service level commitments

  • Build and maintain components of the deal model: total development cost, fit-out and NRC comparisons, yield, tax and incentive assumptions, and sensitivity to power cost and ramp scenarios, under the Senior Manager's review

  • Verify seller claims against primary sources: utility confirmations, interconnection studies, executed versus draft agreements, title and site control instruments

  • Draft Go/No-Go packages, risk registers, and challenge questions for operators; run day-to-day RFI cycles through resolution

  • Support the Senior Manager, Director, and Acquisitions Managers with diligence-derived data and analysis; do not carry deal negotiation

  • Escalate findings transparently through the Senior Manager, including adverse findings that may be unwelcome to the deal team

  • Coordinate with external counsel and consultants on legal, environmental, and specialty workstreams under the Senior Manager's direction

  • Help pre-qualify pipeline sites toward proposal-ready status so sales never offers an unvetted site

  • Apply and help refine repeatable diligence frameworks, checklists, and data room standards across deal types

  • Track diligence performance metrics: cycle time per deal, findings volume and severity, and post-close issue rate

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years in data center, energy, or infrastructure transactions with hands-on exposure to due diligence: you have worked in data rooms and contributed to investment views, even if final sign-off sat with others

  • Working familiarity with power markets: interconnection processes and queue mechanics, utility tariffs, energy services agreements, and power purchase agreement structures as applied to data centers

  • Solid understanding of data center lease structures, operator economics, and mission-critical delivery commitments

  • Strong financial modeling ability in Excel: comfortable building and maintaining components of a development cost, returns, and scenario model

  • Demonstrated attention to detail in finding discrepancies in deal materials: capacity claims that did not hold, unexecuted agreements presented as commitments, terms with hidden exposure

  • Able to synthesize a large document set into clear, evidence-cited findings for review by senior stakeholders

  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent diligences in a fast-moving deal environment, with guidance from the Senior Manager

  • Bachelor's degree required; coursework or certification in finance, engineering, or energy valued

Preferred Experience

  • Infrastructure private equity, investment banking, or project finance deal teams; hyperscaler energy or site acquisition; IPP or utility origination; data center operator corporate development

  • Exposure to behind-the-meter generation and natural gas supply arrangements (firm transport, MDCQ, balancing)

  • Familiarity with the GPU/AI infrastructure ecosystem and hyperscale construction processes

Compensation

$110,000-$135,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (United States)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team. You will be the technical authority embedded with our most complex customers, guiding them through deployment, architecture, onboarding, and the adoption of agentic development workflows. You bring deep hands-on experience from prior roles and use that depth to advise, design repeatable patterns, and drive customer outcomes end to end. You operate autonomously, own the technical success of your customers, and bring their experience back to shape how Coder builds and delivers.

This is not an execution-only role. You are equally comfortable doing deep technical work with a customer and stepping back to design the repeatable pattern behind it. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by customer outcomes, and capable of influencing organizational change alongside the technical work.

Â 

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for post-sales customers, guiding deployment architecture, environment design, and adoption of Coder across both human and AI development workflows

  • Own onboarding engagements end to end, ensuring customers move from contract to productive adoption with speed and confidence

  • Lead Get Well engagements where architecture decisions, rollout patterns, or organizational dynamics are limiting customer health or growth

  • Help customers implement the technical and organizational changes required to adopt agentic development practices at scale

  • Design and document repeatable delivery patterns across onboarding, architecture, and adoption that can scale across customer segments

  • Design and recommend reference architectures tailored to each customer's cloud environment, security posture, and organizational constraints

  • Translate customer environment complexity into clear guidance on networking, ingress, identity, and infrastructure patterns

  • Anticipate technical and operational risks, escalate to the right internal stakeholders, and track issues through to resolution

  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture guides, how-to resources, and statements of work that extend your impact across the customer base

  • Capture structured product feedback from customer deployments and advocate directly with engineering and product teams for roadmap and usability improvements

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineering, or equivalent post-sales technical role, with a demonstrated track record of guiding enterprise customers through complex technical deployments

  • Proven hands-on experience from a prior role designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major provider: AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure; you have done the work and can speak to it with specificity

  • 2+ years experience deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in an enterprise context

  • Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security or compliance stakeholder

  • 2 or more years of production experience with Kubernetes: cluster design, workload scheduling, networking, storage, and operational lifecycle

  • 2 or more years of experience with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling; you understand how enterprise teamsâ structure, version, and maintain IaC at scale

  • Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, including networking fundamentals: ingress controllers, proxies, load balancers, and DNS resolution in cloud-native environments

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps practices; you understand how code moves from commit to running workload in an enterprise context

  • Working knowledge of cloud security and identity: IAM patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance-relevant controls

  • Understanding of observability practices including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems

  • Demonstrated ability to design repeatable delivery patterns, not just solve one-off problems

  • Comfort working through organizational and workflow change alongside technical change with customers

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills: you can hold a room with a senior infrastructure team and produce a clear architecture document without those being separate skills

  • High customer empathy: you understand that the best technical solution does not always fit a customer's constraints, timeline, or organizational reality

  • Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy in a startup environment

Â 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Experience at both early-stage startups and larger software organizations

  • Background as a Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Platform Engineer before moving into a customer-facing role

  • Familiarity with regulated environments: air-gapped deployments, network isolation, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or DORA requirements

  • Experience with disaster recovery design and multi-region availability patterns

  • Cloud cost optimization experience, including rightsizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps practices

  • Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience with Backstage.io or similar internal developer portals and platform tooling

  • Prior work on or alongside a developer platform or platform engineering team

  • Experience introducing new operating models or delivery patterns across post-sales or go-to-market teams

  • Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

Â 
Â

  • Enter and manage all external resource requests in the VNDLY Vendor Management System.

  • Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for new staff augmentation and subcontractor resources.

  • Process all administrative resource events, including adding, extending, removing, and offboarding resources via Lift Tickets.

jobs.description:
Social Media & Community Manager

Full-time (flexible, results-based hours), Remote

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a lean, AI-first digital publisher that runs research-led review and comparison websites in the trading space. The teamâs edge is verified, evidence-based research that helps traders make better decisions, built on a strict editorial standard where ratings canât be bought and every claim is checked. The next step is turning that research into an audience, and this hire is the person who builds it.

The Role

As Social Media & Community Manager, you will build the audience for a fast-growing publishing project in prop trading. Traders ask their hardest questions on X, Reddit and YouTube: which firm pays out, what a challenge really costs and which rule will end an account. Youâll own the channels end to end, turning verified research into posts, threads, graphics and video that traders actually want to watch and share, and growing a community around it. X is the priority for brand exposure and Reddit is where the community is built, with YouTube, Instagram and Facebook alongside.

Youâll work closely with the Senior Project Manager, who agrees priorities with you and oversees the editorial standard across the project. Within those goals, how you get there is your call: you pick the formats, the hooks and the tools, and youâre judged on results. This role is ideal for a self-driven, AI-first creator who has grown channels before, has better taste than the model and wants to own the outcome without being managed day to day. Itâs a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own content ideas, production, publishing, community engagement and performance across X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, working to an agreed channel plan with X and Reddit as the priority channels

  • Create finished content yourself: posts, threads and scripts, graphics, carousels and thumbnails, screen demos, and edited videos with clear pacing, captions and audio

  • Build and keep improving AI workflows that take verified research to scripts, drafts and platform-specific versions, with your own quality check before anything goes live

  • Engage with traders and creators on X, contribute transparently to relevant Reddit communities within their rules, and feed recurring questions back into the content plan

  • Produce YouTube Shorts and explainers, Instagram Reels, carousels and Stories, and Facebook posts and short videos, and manage comments and messages on every channel

  • Run the content calendar: a sustainable publishing schedule, recurring formats and smart repurposing of strong material across platforms

  • Protect quality and accuracy by verifying claims, acting on editorial feedback, including appropriate commercial disclosures and escalating sensitive issues

  • Track reach, engagement, retention, watch time and website traffic, report progress against agreed KPIs and use the data to improve topics, hooks, titles, thumbnails and editing

Ideal Candidate

  • Proven record of growing organic social channels or communities you ran yourself, with before-and-after numbers to show for it, including hands-on experience with X and Reddit, so you can make an impact from day one

  • Deeply AI-native: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools daily for ideas, scripts, drafts and analysis, build your own AI workflows rather than only prompting, know where their output fails and take ownership of the final work

  • Based in a time zone with at least 4 hoursâ overlap with Central European Time; candidates in the Americas should be no further west than US Mountain Time

  • Strong writing and editing skills in English, able to turn technical material into clear posts, compelling scripts and helpful community replies without losing accuracy

  • Can produce finished graphics, carousels, Reels, Shorts and explainers on your own using Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or equivalents, with good judgment on hooks, pacing and captions, and a portfolio of content you personally created to show for it

  • Working knowledge of publishing and analytics on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube, and of prop trading concepts such as evaluations, drawdown and payout conditions, or proven credibility in another technical or financial niche

  • Independent, results-driven thinker who forms their own view, pushes back when the evidence says otherwise, measures themselves on outcomes and starts on the next problem without waiting to be asked

  • A stable track record: youâve stayed with companies or projects long enough to see them through full growth cycles, and you bring loyalty, honesty, integrity and discretion with confidential information

Nice to Have

  • TikTok experience

  • Motion graphics skills

  • Comfortable presenting on camera

  • Experience running creator collaborations

  • Background in affiliate publishing

Tools & Stack

Claude, ChatGPT, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, YouTube Studio, X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, platform analytics, Slack
