jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde alene og kan lide at have ansvar.

  • Har gode IT-kundskaber

  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Det vigtigste er dog, at du har lyst til at give vores gæster en god oplevelse – også når klokken er mange.

❤️ Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med gode kolleger.

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar og frihed.

  • En hverdag, hvor ikke to nætter nødvendigvis er ens.

  • En del af Milling Hotels, hvor vi arbejder efter værdien om at drive hoteller med sjæl.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til hotelchef Claus Lundhede på clundhede@millinghotels.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye natportier velkommen på Milling Hotel Park i Middelfart!

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

jobs.title: Director, Global Platforms
jobs.description: Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.As Director, Global Platforms, youll be accountable for the enterprise applications and data solutions that support our global business. Youll lead and develop a global team of solution owners to deliver reliable platforms as business needs change. Youll report to the CIO and work with IT leadership on portfolio priorities and decisions.Your portfolio includes solutions for group functions (such as finance, HR and procurement); supply chain (warehouse, delivery and order management); sales and marketing (CRM, e-commerce and B2B); and Vianor. It also covers manufacturing applications (manufacturing execution systems, maintenance and quality) and product-related solutions. Across the business, it includes integration platforms, data platforms, master data management, insights and analytics.Key responsibilities- Lead and develop the Global Platforms organization. Build the capabilities, capacity and ways of working needed for effective solution ownership, clear accountability and sustainable delivery.- Set platform strategy and priorities. Through your solution owners, own the roadmaps, solution quality and full lifecycle, from design and delivery through operation, upgrades and retirement. Standardize and modernize where it adds business value, balancing global reuse, risk and necessary local variation.- Turn demand into platform roadmaps with Business IT, which leads business relationships and shapes demand with business and global process owners. Align platform designs and roadmaps with the standards governed by Enterprise Architecture.- Oversee platform-specific security, privacy, continuity and audit readiness. Work with IT Operations and Information Security on readiness, resilience, incidents and controls. IT Operations owns shared infrastructure, including factory IT infrastructure, as well as workplace, service management and related security services.- Govern service outcomes, supplier performance, escalations and improvement. Application management services partners carry out day-to-day support, maintenance and agreed changes for contracted applications.- Plan portfolio finances and manage lifecycle costs and strategic suppliers within your delegated authority.- Use measures of business value, adoption, delivery, cost, risk and service performance to guide priorities and improve results.To be successful in this role, you will have- Experience leading enterprise application or platform portfolios and developing teams in a global matrix organization.- A track record of modernizing and integrating enterprise applications and managing them through their lifecycle.- Experience managing budgets and outsourced application delivery.- The ability to explain investment and delivery options to business and technical leaders.Experience in manufacturing or another industrial environment is an advantage.Key competenciesYou take ownership of outcomes and make clear decisions when priorities compete. You work across functions and regions to build agreement, and you coach solution owners to make decisions and follow through.- Strategic and operational leadership- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills- Ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement- Resilient, analytical, and solution-oriented mindsetOur way of workingOur talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.Are you interested in joining our team?Please submit your application, including your CV and salary request, by December 14, 2026.We will start interviews as applications are received, so we encourage you to apply early.For further information please contact:Timmy McLellan, email timmy.mclellan@nokiantyres.com.Location / CountryNokia/Helsinki, Finland.

We've already closed our first public sector deals, and weâre ready to invest further into the space. jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and SDU Microelectronics, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies. The candidate is expected to start on September 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both IME and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek an experimental researcher whose core expertise is photonic integrated circuits (PICs) and chip-scale photonic technologies. The Fellow will establish an independent, internationally competitive research programme that advances integrated photonic devices, circuits and platforms and uses them to explore emerging computing and quantum technologies.

The position is intentionally anchored in photonic chip technology rather than in a single application domain. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and research vision, the programme may address photonic AI and optical computing, programmable photonic processors, optical interconnects and chip-to-chip communication, quantum photonic circuits and photonic quantum computing, or closely related directions. Candidates are not expected to cover all of these areas.

The Fellow will be based at SDU’s main campus in Odense and will be jointly embedded in SDU Microelectronics at IME and the interdisciplinary environment of DIAS.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Research Focus Areas 

The scientific core of the position is the design, realization and experimental validation of integrated photonic technologies. We are particularly interested in candidates who can connect device- and circuit-level innovation to new computing architectures or quantum systems.

Relevant research directions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Photonic integrated circuits (PIC) on silicon, silicon nitride, III–V, thin-film lithium niobate, or other emerging and heterogeneous photonic platforms.

  • Programmable photonic circuits, reconfigurable interferometric or resonator-based networks, nonlinear photonic devices, and integrated sources, modulators and detectors.

  • Photonic and optical computing, including photonic neural networks, optical matrix operations, neuromorphic photonics, analog optical computing, or other hardware approaches for AI and scientific computing.

  • Optical I/O, chip-to-chip optical links, photonic chiplets, co-packaged optics, and energy-efficient interconnects for future computing systems.

  • Quantum photonic integrated circuits, including integrated generation, manipulation, routing and detection of non-classical light, programmable quantum photonics, quantum interconnects, or photonic approaches to quantum information processing and computing.

  • Electronic-photonic co-design, control and readout, packaging and heterogeneous integration linking PICs with CMOS or other electronic technologies.

  • A successful candidate may be strongest in only part of this landscape. The central requirement is a convincing research identity in integrated photonic chip technology and a clear vision for how that expertise can open new scientific questions in computing, quantum technologies, or both.

 

Qualifications

We are looking for a researcher with a clear trajectory toward international research excellence and with the curiosity to build bridges between disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to formulate an independent scientific agenda while engaging constructively with both engineering and fundamental-science environments.

Applicants should demonstrate:

  • A PhD or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, photonics, applied physics, quantum engineering, materials science, or another closely related field, obtained by the application deadline.

  • Demonstrated research experience gained in diverse institutional and international environments, with a track record of establishing an independent research profile and collaborations beyond the candidate’s current institutional setting.

  • A strong experimental research profile in photonic integrated circuits or closely related chip-scale photonic technologies.

  • Evidence of expertise in PIC design, fabrication or foundry-based realization, experimental characterization, heterogeneous integration, or a closely related photonic-chip workflow.

  • High-quality research output appropriate to career stage and a clear potential to establish an independent and internationally visible research programme.

  • A credible vision for applying integrated photonics to emerging computing and/or quantum technologies.

  • Potential to attract competitive external research funding and to develop international academic and industrial collaborations.

  • A genuine interest in boundary-crossing research and in contributing actively to the intellectual life of DIAS.

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

  • Experience with electronic-photonic co-design, advanced packaging, nonlinear photonics, quantum photonics, photonic computing, optical interconnects, or semiconductor foundry ecosystems will be considered an advantage where relevant to the candidate’s proposed programme.

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.   

 

About SDU Microelectronics:

SDU Microelectronics is a growing research section within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. The section develops integrated circuits and hardware systems for emerging applications and brings together expertise in analog and mixed-signal IC design, neuromorphic and AI hardware, spintronics, sensing, cryogenic electronics and advanced computing systems.

The new Fellow will add a strong photonic-chip dimension to this environment. This creates direct opportunities for joint research in electronic-photonic co-design, photonic accelerators, optical interfaces for AI systems, cryogenic and quantum interfaces, heterogeneous integration, and new computing architectures that combine electronic, photonic and other emerging technologies.

The environment provides access to electronic design, measurement and system-prototyping capabilities and to national and international research and industry networks in semiconductors, photonics and quantum technologies. The Fellow will be encouraged to build an independent group and external funding portfolio while contributing to the long-term development of integrated photonics at SDU.

Read more: SDU Microelectronics (SDU)

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For questions about the scientific profile and SDU Microelectronics, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi, Head of SDU Microelectronics: email: moradi@sdu.dk or +45 5386 9444.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at SDU Microelectronics, Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration in Odense regularly.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

 

 

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. 

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. 

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Equal opportunity employmentThe University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Please go to our website for full information on how to apply.

The application deadline is 28th of February 2027 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

Hvad er Companyplanner?

Companyplanner er en softwareplatform ejet af Vinduespudserskolen ApS, som vi har udviklet på i over to år.

Platformen bruges dagligt af selvstændige vinduespudsere og fungerer som driftsmotoren i deres virksomheder. Her håndterer de alt fra intelligent ruteplanlægning og kundehåndtering til fakturering, leadhåndtering og automatisering af deres daglige drift.

Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Det er ikke et studentermedhjælperjob, hvor du blot skal løse en række standardiserede opgaver.

Companyplanner er kritisk for vores elevers virksomheder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at softwaren spiller, og at vi løbende udvikler og optimerer den i takt med deres behov.

Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem Product Management, User Research, UX/UI, softwareudvikling, softwaretest og AI.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • Være i direkte dialog med vores brugere, gennemføre brugerinterviews og forstå deres behov og udfordringer.

  • Analysere og prioritere brugernes ønsker og forbedringsmuligheder i softwaren.

  • Omsætte brugernes behov til konkrete funktioner og krav til vores udviklingsteam.

  • Designe brugerflows, prototyper og nye funktioner med fokus på brugeroplevelsen (UX/UI).

  • Kommunikere og samarbejde tæt med vores softwareudviklere i en agil udviklingsproces.

  • Teste nye funktioner og følge dem hele vejen fra idé til produktion.

  • Præsentere og demonstrere nye løsninger for brugerne, indsamle feedback og sikre, at funktionerne skaber værdi i praksis.

Du kommer med andre ord til at arbejde med hele produktudviklingsprocessen – fra at identificere et problem hos brugeren til at se den færdige løsning blive brugt i deres virksomhed.

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra start. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, villig til at lære, kan tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt.

Du skal have lyst til at forstå brugernes virksomheder og deres dagligdag, så du ikke bare forstår, hvad de efterspørger, men også hvorfor de efterspørger det.

Du synes, det er spændende at undersøge, hvordan teknologi og digitale produkter kan løse reelle problemer, og du har lyst til at omsætte den faglighed, du får gennem dit studie, til løsninger, der bliver brugt i virkeligheden.

Det er også vigtigt for os, at du har lyst til at være med på den bølge, vi oplever inden for AI. At du følger med i, hvad der rører sig, eksperimenterer med nye værktøjer og løbende undersøger, hvordan AI kan effektivisere dine arbejdsgange og gøre kvaliteten af dit arbejde endnu bedre.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Et studiejob på 15-20 timer om ugen.

  • En konkurrencedygtig timeløn afhængigt af kompetencer og erfaring.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider med mulighed for færre timer i eksamensperioder og flere timer i perioder, hvor studiet fylder mindre, hvis det ønskes.

  • Mulighed for praktikophold som en del af din uddannelse.

  • Stort ansvar, stor frihed og reel indflydelse på produktets udvikling.

  • Praktisk erfaring med Product Management, UX/UI, User Research og agil softwareudvikling.

  • Mulighed for at eksperimentere med og anvende AI i din daglige arbejdsgang.

  • Løbende sparring og tæt samarbejde med et agilt team.

  • En arbejdsplads på vores kontor i det centrale København.

Om os

Da vi for fire år siden gjorde Vinduespudserskolen til en privatuddannelse, havde vi et lidt mærkeligt mål: Vi ville gøre vinduespudserbranchen mere sexet.

Og det synes vi faktisk, vi er lykkedes med.

Den typiske person, der træder ind i branchen i dag, har ændret sig. Vi ser alt fra unge gutter med store iværksætterambitioner til personer med lange akademiske uddannelser, der ønsker mere frihed i hverdagen og at komme væk fra dagligdagen foran computeren.

Det, der driver os som skole, er, at vi hver dag kan hjælpe mennesker med at skabe en hverdag og et liv, de trives bedre i.

Vi ønsker at vise, at der findes andre veje i livet end den traditionelle uddannelsesvej, og at det at starte sin egen virksomhed ikke behøver at være et uoverskueligt projekt, når man får den rette hjælp step by step.

Som en naturlig del af den rejse begyndte vi at udvikle Companyplanner, fordi vi ønskede at give vores elever de bedst mulige forudsætninger for at drive og skalere deres virksomheder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, og nu er vi klar til at sætte ekstra fart på og hjælpe endnu flere.

Den tankegang kommer du også til at mærke direkte hos de elever, du kommer til at arbejde med. Det fede ved jobbet er netop, at du løbende kan se og mærke, hvilken forskel dit arbejde gør for andre menneskers virksomheder og hverdag.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af dig selv, hvad du studerer, hvad du interesserer dig for, og hvorfor du synes, stillingen kunne være spændende.

Har du tidligere arbejdet med digitale produkter, brugerundersøgelser, UX/UI, AI eller egne projekter, må du meget gerne vedhæfte eksempler på det. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Produktspezialist:in (German-speaking)
jobs.description:
You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell.

Do you speak German natively and want to help organisations get the most from a world-class SaaS platform? Then this might be the role you're looking for.

Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board.

You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch, or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt.

 

Join our Rebel Alliance

We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert.

 

What you'll do

  • Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently

  • Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately

  • Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one

  • Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English

  • Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed

  • Report recurring issues to help us improve the product

  • Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability

 

What you bring (essentials)

  • Native-level German (C2) and strong business English

  • Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales

  • Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side

  • A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well

  • Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell

  • Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup

  • Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2)

  • Reliable internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace

 

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows

  • Experience supporting clients across both German and English

 

The short version

If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

jobs.title: Työmaapäällikkö, Keski-Suomen maanteiden hoitourakat
jobs.description: Haemme Destialle työmaapäällikköä Keski-Suomen maanteiden hoitourakoihin.Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä työpäällikön, kollegoidesi ja oman tiimisi kanssa. Vastaat hoitourakan toteutuksesta kokonaisuudessaan: varmistat, että tarjouslaskenta, suunnittelu, aikataulutus, budjetti, hankinnat, raportointi, laskutus ja laajuusvaatimukset täyttyvät. Ohjaat työryhmän resursointia yhdessä työpäällikön ja kollegoidesi kanssa. Lisäksi vastaat laadunvarmistuksesta, poikkeamien raportoinnista ja korjaamisesta sekä lisä- ja muutostöiden tunnistamisesta ja osallistut niihin liittyvään myyntityöhön. Pääset myös mukaan kehittämään kunnossapidon innovatiivisia toimintatapoja ja digitalisointia.Työssäsi vastaat hoitourakan kokonaisuudesta:- johdat urakan toteutusta tarjouslaskennasta valmistumiseen asti- vastaat aikataulusta, budjetista, hankinnoista, raportoinnista ja laskutuksesta- varmistat laadun, raportoit poikkeamat ja vastaat niiden korjaamisesta- tunnistat lisä- ja muutostyöt sekä osallistut niihin liittyvään myyntityöhön- toimit esihenkilönä omalle tiimillesi: rekrytoit, perehdytät, tuet työhyvinvointia ja työkykyä sekä autat tiimiäsi kehittämään osaamistaan- poistat esteitä työnjohtajien ja tekijöiden tieltä, jotta arjen työ rullaa- toimit linkkinä tilaajan, oman tiimin ja muiden sidosryhmien välillä- osallistut kunnossapidon kehittämiseen ja digitalisointiin yhdessä kollegoidesi kanssaToimipisteesi sijaitsee Keski-Suomessa. Roolissa liikut säännöllisesti koko urakka-alueella. Työsuhde on luonteeltaan vakituinen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.Miten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?Destian arvot näkyvät arjen työssä siinä, miten kohtaamme ihmiset, teemme yhteistyötä ja rakennamme parempaa infraa: rehdisti, yhdessä, uudistuen ja menestyen. Työmaapäällikkönä olet tässä työssä etulinjassa, johtamisesi näkyy suoraan siinä, miten tiimisi viihtyy, miten tilaaja kokee yhteistyön ja miten alueen tienkäyttäjät arkensa kokevat.Onnistut tehtävässä, kun olet luonteva ihmisten johtaja ja viihdyt kunnossapidon rytmissä, jossa sää, vuodenajat ja yllätykset kuuluvat työhön. Et tarvitse valmista esihenkilön kaavaa, riittää että haluat oppia, kuunnella ja auttaa tiimiäsi onnistumaan joka päivä. Olet ratkaisukeskeinen, tavoitteellinen ja viestit luontevasti niin tilaajan, esihenkilöiden kuin tekijöiden suuntaan.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:- soveltuvaa teknisen alan koulutusta (rakennusmestari, insinööri tai DI)- aiempaa kokemusta kunnossapidon urakan työnjohtotehtävistä- halua kehittyä ja oppia lisää esihenkilötyöstä sekä auttaa työryhmää onnistumaan joka päivä- ajokorttia ja mahdollisuutta oman auton käyttöön- näppäryyttä tietotekniikan kanssa sekä tavoiteorientoitunutta toimintatapaa- yhteistyökykyä, hyviä viestintätaitoja sekä halukkuutta jakaa omaa ammattitaitoa tiimissäLopullinen tehtävä ja työn sisältö muokataan valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja valmiuksien mukaan. Tehtävässä vaaditaan Elinvoimakeskuksen MH-urakan vaatimuksen mukaisen kirjallisen asiantuntijatentin suorittamista. Perehdytämme näihin osana aloitusta, ne ovat osa ammattilaisuuden vahvistamista, eivät este lähteä hakemaan.Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan kokemus alueurakoiden vetämisestä, Elinvoimakeskuksen tilaajayhteistyöstä tai kunnossapidon digitalisaation kehittämisestä. Pitkä ura ei ole edellytys, näyttöä ja motivaatiota arvostetaan yhtä paljon.Lupaamme, että DestiallaDestialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia.Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa.Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa mielellään rekrytoiva esihenkilö työpäällikkö Toni Oravasaari toni.oravasaari@destia.fi tai +358406325403)Destia OyDestia on suurin infra-alan palveluita Suomessa tuottava yhtiö ja osa kansainvälistä Colas-konsernia.   • Educated Electricians

Job Tasks are as follows:

  • Working with Remote Currents

  • Cable pulling and dressing

  • Assemble Junction Boxes (Mountain of DIN Rails and terminal blocks)

  • Cables & Wires terminations (Circuit, connection, marking, dressing)

A couple of months ahead this will also be part of the job description:

  • Installation and connection of final fix items. Power sockets, light, light switches)

  • All electrician profiles are educated electricians, with foreign or Danish papers.

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Biomedical Engineering
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Department of Technology and Innovation at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Biomedical Engineering. The candidate is expected to start on June 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities. 

We are looking for a distinguished researcher to take up this position at the newly established Centre of Biomedical Engineering (BEC) at SDU. The ideal candidate has deep knowledge about engineering, physics and maths. They have experience of working with healthcare professionals and are great communicators of complex ideas. The field of biomedical engineering is interpreted in a broad manner. However, there needs to be clear evidence of (potential) clinical translation and stakeholder engagement for patient impact. It is expected that the successful candidate can move from fundamental science to technology readiness level 6 or above. 

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of biomedical engineering, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of biomedical engineering, computational bioengineering, mechanical or electrical engineering. To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline.  

  • Ability to work well in a team, and coordinate team research.

  • Excellent coding skills and/or exceptional experimental competences.

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.    

 

Department of Technology and Innovation

The Department of Technology and Innovation is host to research groups that cross domain-specific boundaries to solve complex problems. The Biomedical Engineering Centre (BEC) at the department conducts interdisciplinary research at the interface of biomechanics, sensing, medical devices, and computational modelling. The successful candidate will join a growing research program focused on creating novel medical technologies. 

BEC is committed to developing engineered solutions that are intuitive, practical, and accessible to clinical users. We use a need-driven approach to ensure the technologies we develop are fit for purpose and directly address real clinical challenges. The centre has strong collaborative ties with leading institutions, such as the University of Oxford, and an international outlook is favored by the Department. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact jberg@iti.sdu.dk (Professor Jeroen Bergmann).

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at the Biomedical Engineering Centre in Odense and is also expected to participate DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. 

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. 

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.  

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Application requirementsThe application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborated research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).   

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to 3 of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page. 

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

 

Submission guidelines

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).  

  • All files must be submitted in PDF format which must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. Any CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out.  

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the assessment process and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background. SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.   

Equal opportunity employment The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

  How to apply Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is February 28, 2027, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Annual remote expense budget.

Paid parental leave.

jobs.title: Vagtplanlæggere til Helhedsplejen Øst – vi søger nu 2 – måske et godt makkerpar der har lyst til nye udfordringer sammen?
jobs.description:
Vagtplanlæggere til Helhedsplejen Øst – Du planlægger ikke bare vagter, du skaber tryghed for borgere og kollegaer

Er du typen, der elsker struktur, men også kan bevare overblikket, når telefonen ringer, en medarbejder melder sig syg, og dagens plan skal tænkes om på fem minutter?

Kan du få mennesker, kompetencer, ønsker, overenskomster og drift til at gå op i en højere enhed?

Så er du måske den af de to vagtplanlæggere, vi leder efter til Helhedsplejen Øst.

Som vagtplanlægger ved Helhedsplejen Øst får du ikke blot ansvar for vagtplaner. Du får en nøglerolle i at skabe sammenhæng, kontinuitet og gode arbejdsdage for både borgere og medarbejdere. Kort sagt: Du er en af de personer, der får hverdagen til at fungere.

Om stillingen 

Helhedsplejen Øst i Brønderslev kommune søger to vagtplanlæggere, der sammen skal sikre en optimal vagtplanlægning for vores ca. 160 sosu-medarbejdere og mange afløsere, fordelt på to lokationer i Hjallerup og Dronninglund.

Da vi søger to vagtplanlæggere, vil I få et meget tæt samarbejde og skal kunne dække ind for hinanden ved fravær. Derfor vil I også den første tid hjælpe hinanden, på tværs af de seks teams, hvor der både indgår dagvagter, aftenvagter og nattevagter. På sigt vil I hver især komme til at tilhøre den ene lokation mere end den anden, men I skal fortsat have et tæt samarbejde, så I kan tage over for hinanden ved behov.

Som vagtplanlægger får du en central rolle i at sikre en stabil og velfungerende drift. Din planlægning har stor betydning – både for borgernes oplevelse af kontinuitet og kvalitet i plejen og for medarbejdernes arbejdsglæde og trivsel.

Du bliver bindeled mellem ledelse, planlægning og medarbejdere og får ansvaret for at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for den daglige opgaveløsning. Samtidig bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner i arbejdet med at udvikle en bæredygtig og fremtidssikret bemandingsplanlægning.

Dine opgaver

  • Udarbejde, vedligeholde og optimere vagtplaner for Helhedsplejens medarbejdere.
  • Sikre den rette bemanding med de rette kompetencer på de rette tidspunkter.
  • Håndtere ændringer ved sygdom, ferie, uddannelse og andre akutte situationer.
  • Arbejde målrettet med kapacitetsstyring, så ressourcerne anvendes bedst muligt.
  • Analysere bemandingsbehov og planlægge ud fra aktivitetsniveau, belastning og forventede ændringer.
  • Bidrage til at skabe kontinuitet, så borgerne så vidt muligt møder kendte medarbejdere.
  • Understøtte en effektiv drift med fokus på kvalitet, økonomi og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invite applications for a tenure-track DIAS Fellow position at Assistant Professor level in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment, with a focus on input-output life cycle assessment methods and big data. The candidate is expected to start during the summer/early fall in 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Who are we looking for?

The position translates this ambition into a concrete research agenda, because many of the most pressing sustainability questions, such as how consumption in one country drives resource use, emissions and social conditions in another, or how a new technology changes environmental impacts across whole economies, cannot be answered within a single discipline. Industrial ecology addresses these questions by tracing material, energy and monetary flows through global supply chains, drawing on methods and data from engineering, economics and the natural and social sciences. Input-output analysis, built on big data covering production, trade, emissions and resource use and combined with life cycle assessment and material flow analysis, provides the quantitative framework for linking decisions about individual products, technologies and policies to their economy-wide consequences. The Fellow will build this capacity at SDU and use DIAS as a platform to work with researchers in fields such as health, food, energy, economics and political science on questions that cross disciplinary boundaries. Within this ambition, the specific profile is as follows.

We seek an early-career researcher who will advance quantitative sustainability assessment within industrial ecology by developing data-driven environmental-economic and systems models that link global production and consumption to environmental and socioeconomic outcomes. The role includes independent research, research-based teaching and supervision, interdisciplinary collaboration across DIAS and the Department, and development of competitive external funding proposals. Relevant research themes include:

·         environmental and material footprinting of global production and consumption systems;

·         development and application of environmentally extended input–output (EEIO) and multi-regional input–output (MRIO) models and databases, including hybrid physical–monetary systems and transparent, reproducible data workflows;

·         hybrid modelling that combines EEIO analysis with life cycle assessment (LCA), material flow analysis (MFA), econometrics or other quantitative methods;

·         applications to food and resource systems, healthcare systems and medical technologies, the circular economy, energy, infrastructure and other societal systems; and

·         scenario, structural decomposition, uncertainty and econometric analysis for sustainability transitions, policy and decision support.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

·         A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

·         A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields.

·         Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

·         Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must:

·         Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of industrial ecology, environmental or ecological economics, environmental science or engineering, sustainability science or a closely related field. To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

·         The successful candidate should demonstrate strong competence in EEIO or MRIO analysis, and at least one of the following areas: LCA, MFA, or hybrid modelling; econometric, statistical, or other quantitative methods; and programming, data science, or management of large, heterogeneous datasets.

·         Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries.

·         Be fluent in English.

·         Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages.

·         Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.   

The Department of Green Technology

The Department of Green Technology at SDU is a dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment focused on developing technologies and strategies for a sustainable future. Our research spans environmental chemistry, process engineering, life cycle thinking, and circular systems. We collaborate closely with industry and public stakeholders to ensure real-world impact and relevance.

This position will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE).

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

SDU LCE uses industrial ecology approaches to reduce environmental impacts and reconcile human development with environmental stewardship. We conduct holistic systems analyses and design studies to characterise and optimise engineering solutions over the long term, considering resource use, energy efficiency, climate and environmental impacts, and economic and socioeconomic performance. At SDU LCE, we develop and apply theory, methods and tools for material flow analysis (MFA), life cycle assessment (LCA), life cycle engineering, energy-system analysis and design, resource-criticality assessment, process integration and techno-economic assessment.

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For further information about SDU Life Cycle Engineering and this position, please contact Head of Centre, Professor Morten Birkved, at morb@igt.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential.

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Equal opportunity employmentThe University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Please go to our website for full information on how to apply.

The application deadline is February 28, 2027, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

  • Har erfaring med madlavning fra et størkøkken eller lignende

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og har sans for orden

  • Tives med at hjælpe til, hvor der er behov

Det tilbyder vi

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med god kollegaer

  • En fleksibel tilkaldeordning med vagter efter behov

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med varierede køkkenopgaver

  • Et køkkenteam, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, ansvarlighed og god idéer

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos Liftra opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund.
