jobs.title: Regional Buying Manager
jobs.description:
Do you possess an extensive and proven track record in combining buying, advanced performance analysis, and strategic stock control, to shape high-impact product mixes for a leading women’s wear brand? Are you an experienced professional and passionate about data-driven strategy?

VERO MODA is seeking a Regional Buying Manager for our international Planning & Buying team in Aarhus. This role is crucial for strategically leading the development of buying strategies, optimizing stock, and curating assortments that meet global ambitions and local market needs. Your advanced analytical expertise and commercial mindset will be instrumental in driving significant sales and support our global retail success.

YOUR TEAMJoin our vibrant International Planning & Buying department. You will collaborate with local retail managers, country teams, and stakeholders across Europe. We craft data-driven collections and strategies in a fast-paced, international setting, valuing collaboration and pushing retail excellence. As a key member of our team, you will contribute significantly to our collective expertise and strategic direction.

YOUR JOBAs Regional Buying Manager, you will take ownership of and proactively develop and execute buying strategies that boost performance across Europe. You will use sharp commercial instincts and robust data to ensure our assortments and sales plans are not only relevant and impactful, but also future-proofed for sustained growth. Your role is key to achieving topline and EBIT targets, optimizing stock, and guiding local teams to align with our global vision and local demands.

Key responsibilities:

  • Being in the front of development and implementation of comprehensive buying strategies, effectively aligning brand and local market needs.

  • Drive the creation of data-driven product assortments and clear sales plans.

  • Oversee and strategically manage stock control for maximum efficiency and impact on financial targets.

  • Provide expert guidance and support to local teams with market performance insights and tools.

  • Ensure collection relevance and commercial viability by expertly balancing global trends and local preferences.

YOUR PROFILEYou are a highly experienced, strategic, and analytical professional with a passion for retail and women's fashion. You leverage data for complex strategic decisions but also understand the creative and commercial aspects of buying. As a strong and influential communicator, you build relations easily in dynamic, international environments. You are adept at navigating diverse market demands and stakeholder expectations.

We imagine you:

  • Have extensive and demonstrable experience in retail buying or planning in fashion at a senior level.

  • Possess a distinguished proven track record in advanced stock control, in-depth analysis, and strategic reporting.

  • Are an expert and highly proficient in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

  • Have a deep understanding and strong passion for women's fashion trends and consumer demand.

  • Ideally, bring leadership experience or a strong capacity to mentor junior team members.

WHAT WE OFFERAt VERO MODA, you will be part of a global brand with a clear vision and a collaborative culture. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the buying strategy, impact markets worldwide, and grow within a team that values your ideas. Join us in Aarhus to create inspiring and high-performing women's fashion. This is an opportunity to make a significant strategic impact and further your career in a dynamic international environment.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Retail Buying & Planning at +45 30 85 27 48.

Please upload your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than the 8th of December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once we have found the right match.

LOCATION: Aarhus C, Denmark.

TRAVEL: Approx. 30 annual travel days.

jobs.title: 2 hjertevarme pædagogmedhjælpere eller pæd. assistenter til Børnehuset Olympus
jobs.description:
Olympus Børnehuset leder efter verdens bedste pædagogmedhjælper………

 

Brænder du for at skabe en tryg, varm og udviklende hverdag for børnehavebørn? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor kvalitet og omsorg går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Børnehuset Olympus er en sammenlagt institution beliggende på to matrikler på henholdsvis Korevej 2 og Fortunavej 1. Korevej er en lille hyggelig børnehave med 20 børn, og Fortuna er en spændende, integreret institution med 18 vuggestuebørn, og 39 børnehavebørn. Det er i børnehaven i afd. Fortuna,  vi mangler hænder.

Børnehuset Olympus er en institution i udvikling, og derfor er der rig mulighed for at være medskaber af et udviklende læringsmiljø, der understøtter alle børns deltagelse i børnefællesskaber, alt sammen med udgangspunkt i Aalborg kommunes børnesyn.

 

Vi søger to pædagogmedhjælpere/pædagogiske assistenter på 37 timer . Begge stillinger er i vores børnehavegrupper på Fortunavej. Vi forventer du kan tiltræde 1. februar 2027.

 

Til den rette pædagogmedhjælper tilbyder vi

  • Skønne børn, forældre og kolleger
  • En hverdag der udstråler ro, nærvær og en varm, hjemlig stemning  
  • Et fagligt stærkt team, der prioriterer refleksion over egen og andres praksis
  • Et miljø hvor der er fokus på udvikling og kvalitet i det pædagogiske arbejde – både i planlægning og praksis – du arbejder under reference til stuens pædagoger.
  • Gode muligheder for sparring og kompetenceudvikling
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel og samarbejde vægtes højt, og hvor man mødes med smil og et godt humør

 

Vi ønsker os en pædagogmedhjælper der kan

  • Være med til at skabe trygge og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børn i alderen 0–6 år
  • Arbejde anerkendende og relations baseret med det enkelte barn, og har lyst til at være på gulvet blandt børnene 
  • Være med til at planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter med høj faglig kvalitet
  • Indgå aktivt i samarbejdet med forældre, og ser dem som vigtige samarbejdspartnere 
  • Tage del i det praktiske arbejde i hverdagen, og ser det som en mulighed for vigtige læringsstunder med børnene
  • Bidrage til en varm og inkluderende kultur i huset

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Først og fremmest går på arbejde for børnenes skyld
  • Er nærværende, anerkendende, omsorgsfuld og tydelig i din tilgang til børnene
  • Trives i en hverdag med både struktur og fleksibilitet
  • Er mødestabil, og kan møde i hele åbningstiden 6.30-16.50
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et positivt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi har øje for hinanden og respekterer hinandens forskelligheder
  • Gerne har erfaring fra det pædagogiske område – evt. uddannelse som pædagogisk assistent (ikke et krav)

 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV senest den 11. december 2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til Foa´s overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Gitte Høyrup Christensen, 20638914. Du er ligeledes velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg. Forud for ansættelse indhentes reference og børne- og straffeattest.

Arbejdsstedets adresse er Fortunavej 1, 9210 Aalborg SØ.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a full-time position as Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets is open for appointment from April 2027 or soon thereafter

Your work tasksYou will join the Intelligent Energy Systems and Flexible Markets (iGRIDS) research group in the Section for Electric Power Systems and Microgrids at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will actively contribute to the group’s collaborative research, teaching, and broader academic activities.

Your research will address modelling, optimisation and intelligent management of power and integrated energy systems, with emphasis on electricity markets, demand flexibility, uncertainty-aware scheduling and active distribution networks. You will develop computational and data-driven approaches for flexibility across sectors, including power–heat and power–mobility applications.

You will develop and lead research projects, secure external funding and collaborate with academic, industrial and public-sector partners. You will teach and supervise students at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels and support AAU’s problem-based learning (PBL) environment. It is also expected that you will be able to undertake teaching in Danish within the first few years of employment.

Your competenciesApplicants should have Associate Professor-level qualifications in electrical power engineering, energy systems or a related field, with a documented record of original research and teaching. Relevant competencies include:

  • Energy systems and markets: Expertise in modelling, optimisation, and control of integrated energy systems, including energy hubs, sector coupling, electricity markets, energy economics, demand response, flexibility aggregation, and uncertainty-aware scheduling.
  • Grid integration: Experience in integrating renewable energy, storage, and flexible demand into active distribution networks, addressing voltage regulation, congestion management, grid stability, and coordinated flexibility services.
  • Research excellence and leadership: Strong publication record and demonstrated ability to develop research directions, secure competitive funding, and lead national and international collaborative projects, particularly EU-funded initiatives.
  • Teaching and collaboration: Documented experience in university teaching at bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels. Experience in teaching within Flexible Master's Programmes, particularly for industry professionals, is considered an advantage. Ability to contribute to Problem-Based Learning (PBL), communicate effectively in English and collaborate constructively with students, colleagues and external partners.
  • Additional strengths: Experience in experimental validation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and industry-oriented research or teaching is advantageous.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirementsAppointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of employment as an assistant professor but may also be obtained in other ways.  

It is a precondition that applicants have documented research at an international standard. In addition, applicants are assumed to have received supervision and pedagogical skills development and to have obtained a positive written assessment of their teaching qualifications.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see The Faculty of Engineering and Science. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this   
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here  

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Associate professor.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

About Node16.ai

Our mission is to improve the detection and prevention of financial crime by enabling financial institutions to collaborate and share intelligence without compromising sensitive customer and transaction data.

By combining artificial intelligence, federated learning and modern software infrastructure, we aim to make anti-money laundering (AML) processes more effective, secure and scalable.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Tester to join our growing team and contribute to the quality, reliability and functionality of our software products.

About the role

As a Junior Software Tester at Node16.ai, you will support the testing and quality assurance of the company’s web applications and software systems.

You will work closely with developers and product stakeholders to prepare and execute software tests, identify and document defects, verify fixes, and support the delivery of reliable software solutions.

This position offers an opportunity to develop practical experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation within an innovative AI-driven technology company.

Recent graduates and candidates at the beginning of their software testing or quality assurance careers are encouraged to apply. Prior professional experience is not required.

jobs.title: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
jobs.description:
Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad

Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EMPLOYEES

Foreign employees working temporarily in Denmark may be eligible for certain tax deductions, depending on their individual tax situation.

 Travel between your home country and Denmark

If you maintain your permanent home in your home country and your personal and financial ties remain there, you may be eligible for a deduction for travel between your home country and your workplace in Denmark. Eligibility depends on your Danish tax status. You must keep documentation of your journeys, such as tickets and receipts. The amount shown for 2026 is approximately DKK 6,000.

Double-household deduction

If your employment in Denmark is temporary and you maintain a home both in Denmark and in your home country, you may, under certain conditions, qualify for a deduction for additional household expenses. This may apply when your work requires you to live away from your permanent home.

To qualify, your employment must generally be temporary, and the distance between the two homes must make daily travel unreasonable. The deduction may be available for up to two years.

Important: These deductions are not automatic. You are responsible for checking whether you qualify and for entering the relevant deductions on your Danish tax assessment. Keep your documentation in case the Danish Tax Agency requests it.

You must arrange and pay for your own transport to Denmark.

 If possible, bring your own car. A car can make your stay easier and more convenient, as you may need to travel between different farm locations and your accommodation in nearby houses. It will also give you more freedom to explore the local area.

jobs.title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Pedestrian Experience with AI and VR
jobs.employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
jobs.description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Analysis of pedestrian experience and behaviour using Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality” will investigate how streetscape design elements influence pedestrian experience and behaviour using AI and VR. Advances in AI-driven environment generation and VR immersion now enable the creation and systematic testing of diverse, immersive streetscape scenarios, allowing assessment of pedestrian experience and behaviour that was previously infeasible. This PhD project will: (1) use AI tools to generate and manipulate 3D streetscape scenarios representing diverse urban design interventions; (2) integrate these environments into a VR platform for immersive pedestrian-experience; (3) conduct controlled experiments measuring emotional, behavioural and perceptual responses to assess walkability, experience and behaviour; and (4) run co-creation workshops with diverse groups (young and older adults, diverse genders and people with disabilities) and stakeholders (municipalities, local businesses, NGOs) to validate, critically assess and refine the methodology and findings. Partner university: University of Leeds. Planned secondments at University of Leeds: M12–M17 and M36–M47 Main Supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Kostas Mouratidis, University of Copenhagen, email: km@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Natasha Merat, University of Leeds, email: N.Merat@its.leeds.ac.uk Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at the University of Leeds, you are required to fulfil the requirements described here: https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport-research-degrees/doc/entry-requirements-3
  • Fluency in English (see Entry requirements | University of Leeds) and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:
  • Urban design / urban planning
  • Human-environment interactions
  • Data analysis / statistical analysis
  • Programming and/or design skills
Personal attributes that are desirable:
  • Strong motivation for high-quality research
  • Collaborative spirit
  • Systematic approach to research
  • Attention to detail
Key criteria for the assessment of applicants
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevance of studies, coursework, and thesis
  • Relevant work experience (if any)
  • Publications (if any)
  • The grade point average achieved
  • Other professional activities
  • Language skills
  • Quality and relevance of project proposal
  • The successful applicant is also required to be enterprising and to possess good interpersonal skills
Terms of employment The arrangement concerns two separate fixed-term positions: initially as a Research Assistant, leading towards an appointment as a PhD fellow. The respective durations of the two positions are 1 year and 3 years. The position as a PhD fellow is contingent upon the successful enrolment of a suitable candidate in the PhD School at the University of Copenhagen, as well as satisfactory completion of the Research Assistant period. These assessments will be carried out 3-6 months prior to the expiry of the Research Assistant contract. The start date is 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the requirements from the European Commission related to the MSCA programme and the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,850 DKK/roughly 4,260 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund. Application and assessment procedure Your application, written in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” below and must include the following documents in PDF format:
  • Motivated letter of application (max. one page)
  • A project proposal (max 5 pages where the candidate presents a proposal on how they wish to approach their project including theory and methods)
  • CV incl. education, experience, language skills, publication list (if any), and other skills relevant for the position
  • Certified copy of original master’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD position employment, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Applicants with a master´s degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used. Certified copy of original bachelor’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If the applicant has completed a combined bachelor’s and master’s education (e.g. 5-year combined master’s), the applicant should submit the combined diploma, transcript of records, and authorised English translations if issued in other language than English or Danish.
  • Language diplomas or language test results (if any)
The deadline for applications is 20 December 2026, at 23.59pm CET. We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. The assessor makes a non-prioritised assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant can comment on the part of the assessment that relates to him/herself. The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. You may read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ For more information on working and living in Denmark visit http://ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) and https://www.workindenmark.dk. Interviews are expected to take place in the begining of February 2027. Questions For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor, Kostas Mouratidis at km@ign.ku.dk. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen The Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher in human skin biology and wound healing. The position is part of a newly established research group investigating how cells coordinate their behaviour to maintain and repair tissues. The position is fully funded for at least 2 years, with the possibility of extension, through generous funding from the LEO Foundation. The earliest possible start date is 1 April 2027. Please clearly state your availability and preferred start date in your cover letter. Information about the Department of Biology is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/. Information about the specific research section you will be affiliated with is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/research/cbp/. Project overview The overarching aim is to develop strategies to help people with slow- or non-healing wounds. This project investigates how planar cell polarity (PCP)—the coordinated orientation of cells within a tissue—contributes to human skin organization and wound repair. Although PCP signaling is essential for tissue organization across many organisms, its role in human epidermis remains poorly understood. You will establish reconstructed human epidermis (RHE) as an experimental model to investigate PCP signaling in human skin, then use advanced fluorescence microscopy to characterize PCP clusters, their polarization, and how they change during wound repair and in response to other stressors. The project bridges fundamental questions in cell and developmental biology with potential long-term applications in regenerative medicine and skin repair. It is supported by collaborators with expertise in RHE development and by access to confocal and advanced microscopy, including SIM, TIRF, and STED. The project provides a clear starting point and room to shape the research questions as findings emerge. In your cover letter, please clearly describe what interests you about the project and what related research questions you would be excited to explore. Your role We are seeking a motivated, technically skilled, and scientifically independent postdoctoral researcher to play a central role in establishing this research programme. As one of the first members of a newly established research group, you will have an exceptional opportunity to shape its experimental approaches, contribute to its scientific direction, and help build a collaborative, ambitious research environment. Your primary responsibility will be to establish and optimize experimental systems to investigate PCP signaling in reconstructed human epidermis. You will work closely with the PI while taking substantial ownership of day-to-day experimental development and execution of the project. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Establish and optimize robust, reproducible assays with mature, stratified RHE cultures.
  • Develop and optimize immunostaining, advanced microscopy, and quantitative imaging workflows.
  • Analyze and interpret experimental data, contributing scientific ideas, and identifying promising new research directions.
  • Prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at local and international conferences.
  • Contribute to the development of a supportive, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous lab environment.
  • Help train and supervise students or other researchers as the group expands.
Profile We are seeking a curious and proactive researcher who can take ownership of their experiments while collaborating constructively with the project team. You do not need experience with every method listed below; training and collaboration will help you develop the techniques needed for the project. Essential experience and skills:
  • PhD in cell biology, developmental biology, skin biology, molecular biology, tissue engineering, biophysics, or a closely related field by the time of appointment.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, with demonstrated ability to independently establish, optimize, and troubleshoot experimental protocols.
  • Demonstrated experience in fluorescence microscopy and immunofluorescence staining.
  • Evidence of scientific independence, initiative, and the ability to advance an experimental research project, including strong organizational skills.
  • A solid publication record appropriate for your career stage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills.
In the cover letter, you are encouraged to highlight an example of experimental independence, including situations in which you have established or substantially improved an experimental method, solved a challenging technical problem, or independently advanced a research project. Desirable experience and skills:
  • Experience with human keratinocyte culture, reconstructed human epidermis, organotypic skin cultures, or other 3D epithelial models.
  • Experience establishing new experimental model systems or developing and optimizing complex cell-culture protocols.
  • Experience with quantitative image analysis using Fiji/ImageJ, Python, or other comparable computational tools.
  • Experience with molecular perturbation techniques, including CRISPR/Cas9, RNA interference, and genetic manipulation of mammalian cells.
  • Experience with confocal microscopy or an advanced imaging technique such as SIM, TIRF, or STED.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or junior researchers.
Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you are excited about this position and believe you can contribute, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if your experience does not perfectly match every point. We value curiosity, motivation, and the potential and willingness to learn. What we offer
  • An opportunity to join a newly established research group and meaningfully contribute to its scientific development.
  • A central role in an ambitious, externally funded research project that addresses fundamental and medically relevant questions.
  • Substantial scientific independence and opportunities to develop novel experimental approaches.
  • Close scientific interaction with the PI and opportunities to shape future research directions.
  • Access to the research infrastructure and collaborative environment at the University of Copenhagen.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and professional development.
The position offers an excellent opportunity for a researcher seeking to develop greater scientific independence and strengthen their qualifications for a future academic or research leadership career. jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

  • Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

We Expect You To:

  • Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

  • Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

  • Be reliable, independent, and responsible

  • Be physically fit and able to handle freight

  • Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

  • Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

➕ It Is an Advantage If You:

  • Have experience with distribution driving or similar transport work

⭐ We Offer:

  • A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

  • Well-maintained trucks

  • Thorough training in routes and procedures

  • Good colleagues and an informal working environment

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Interested?

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@naka.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and to a successful future collaboration.

There are 2 vacancies available.

jobs.title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace.

We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists.

The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room.

The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t.

 - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup.

 - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field.

 - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping.

 - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same

 - Agents are already part of how you build. You’ve gone beyond autocomplete. You can show us workflows you’ve put together, what they do on their own, how you check their work, and what you’ve learned when they go wrong.

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Tehnosüsteemide hooldustehnik
jobs.description:
Kütte-, ventilatsiooni-, jahutusseadmete- ja mehaanikatehnik

Tööülesanded: Otsime kogenud kütte-, ventilatsiooni- ja jahutussüsteemide (KVJ) / mehaanikatehnikut, kellel on vähemalt 5-aastane praktiline töökogemus tehnosüsteemide hoolduse, tööstushoolduse, andmekeskuste või tehnilise kinnisvarahalduse valdkonnas. Edukas kandidaat vastutab KVJ- ja mehaanikasüsteemide ohutu, töökindla ja tõhusa toimimise eest läbi ennetava hoolduse, ülevaatuste, rikete tuvastamise ning remonditööde. Peamised tööülesanded: Teostada KVJ- ja hoone mehaanikasüsteemide plaanilist ennetavat hooldust (PPM) ning korrigeerivat hooldust. Kontrollida, hooldada, diagnoosida ja remontida seadmeid, sealhulgas jahutusmasinaid (chillereid), ventilatsiooniseadmeid, puhurkonvektoreid (fan coil), split-süsteeme, pumpi, mootoreid, ventiile, laagreid, sidureid, paisusüsteeme ja nendega seotud pöörlevaid seadmeid. Jälgida seadmete tehnilist seisukorda, sh vibratsiooni, müra, temperatuuri, määrimist, joondust, rõhku ja üldist töövõimet. Diagnoosida ja kõrvaldada mehaanika- ja KVJ-süsteemide rikkeid, seadmete tõrkeid ning süsteemi jõudlusprobleeme. Paigaldada, vahetada ja seadistada KVJ- ning mehaanikakomponente vastavalt vajadusele. Tagada, et kõik hooldustööd vastavad ettevõtte protseduuridele, ohutusstandarditele, tööloa (permit-to-work) protsessidele ja seadmete lukustamise/märgistamise (LOTO) nõuetele. Pidada täpset hooldusregistrit ning koostada ülevaatusaruandeid ja töökäske CMMS-süsteemis. Teha koostööd eritööde alltöövõtjatega ning toetada vajadusel seadmete kasutuselevõttu, remonti ja uuendamist. Tuvastada riske, teha parendusettepanekuid ja ennetada võimalikke seadmete rikkeid.

Omalt poolt pakume: Väljakutseid pakkuvat ja mitmekülgset tehnilist tööd, kus on võimalus töötada kriitilise tähtsusega hoonete taristuga, arendada erialaseid oskusi ning panustada keerukate tehnosüsteemide töökindlasse toimimisse.

Muud nõuded: Tehniline või kutseharidus KVJ, külmatehnika, mehaanikainseneri, hoonete tehnosüsteemide või seotud erialal.Vähemalt 5-aastane praktiline töökogemus KVJ- ja mehaanikasüsteemide hoolduses ärihoonetes, tööstusrajatistes või kriitilise tähtsusega keskkondades. Põhjalikud teadmised KVJ-süsteemidest, külmutusseadmetest, pumpadest, mootoritest, ventiilidest, laagritest, pöörlevatest seadmetest ja hoone mehaanilistest tehnosüsteemidest. Praktiline kogemus rikete otsimisel, ennetavas hoolduses, seadmete remondis ja süsteemide optimeerimisel. Hea arusaam CMMS-süsteemidest, tehnilisest dokumentatsioonist ja hoolduse planeerimisest. Ohutusprotseduuride, riskianalüüside, tööloasüsteemide ja seadusandlike nõuete tundmine. Tugev probleemide lahendamise, organiseerimis- ja suhtlemisoskus. Võime töötada iseseisvalt ning teha tõhusat koostööd alltöövõtjate, klientide ja kohapealsete meeskondadega. Hea eesti ja inglise keele oskus nii kõnes kui kirjas. Vene keele oskus tuleb kasuks. Väga hea arvutikasutusoskus (haldustarkvara ja Microsoft Office). Valmisolek töötada vahetustega graafiku alusel. Kehtiva juhiloa olemasolu on eelistatud.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Spain
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in Spanish.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Manager søges til Restaurant Sukaiba
jobs.description:
Har du en stærk faglighed inden for service og ledelse — og et ønske om at præge driften i et af Københavns mest spektakulære restauranter?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en del af Norrlyst-koncernen og et hus, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære bindes sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse. Her mødes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi, et ambitiøst drikkeprogram og et professionelt team, der hver dag arbejder for at løfte standarderne for moderne restaurantdrift.

Vi søger nu en dedikeret og erfaren Floor Manager, der med naturligt lederskab og skarpt overblik kan understøtte den daglige drift og sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen altid lever op til vores høje niveau.

Rollen

Som Floor Manager vil du være en central del af restaurantens ledelsesteam. Du vil samarbejde tæt med restaurantchefen og få ansvar for at:

  • Sikre en stabil og professionel drift på gulvet i alle serviceperioder

  • Lede og motivere personalet, så der skabes et trygt, disciplineret og engageret arbejdsmiljø

  • Være til stede i driften som rollemodel, sparringspartner og problemløser

  • Bidrage til oplæring, udvikling og kvalitetssikring af teamet

  • Understøtte planlægning af vagter, struktur og arbejdsrutiner

  • Gå forrest i at opretholde den høje standard, vores gæster forventer af Sukaiba

Dette er en hands-on stilling, hvor både servicefaglighed, nærvær og ledelseskompetence er afgørende.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har minumum 2 års erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen og mindst et år i en ledende eller superviserende rolle

  • Trives i et miljø, hvor tempoet er højt, og hvor kvalitet aldrig kompromitteres

  • Har en naturlig autoritet og formår at skabe ro, retning og motivation omkring dig

  • Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og nærværende

  • Har øje for detaljer og en stærk forståelse for, hvad førsteklasses service kræver

  • Er ambitiøs, driftssikker og klar til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og processer

Vi tilbyder

  • En nøgleposition i en af Københavns mest spektakulære restauranter

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med høje standarder og stærke værdier

  • Et professionelt team med stor faglighed og ambition

  • En kultur, hvor medarbejdertrivsel, kvalitet og udvikling vægtes højt

  • Karriere- og udviklingsmuligheder i en organisation i vækst

  • En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og ordentlige arbejdsvilkår

Om dig

Du bevæger dig med både overblik og beslutsomhed.Du er løsningsorienteret, struktureret og stærk i din kommunikation.Du trives i rollen som leder og er motiveret af at udvikle både mennesker og drift.Du bringer professionalisme, ansvarlighed og en passion for service ind i alt, hvad du gør.

Praktisk

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Laborant praktikant 2027 - VBM Laboratoriet Ishøj
jobs.description:
FirmabeskrivelseEurofins VBM laboratoriet – Geoteknik tilbyder en bred vifte af laboratorieanalyser og feltundersøgelser. Vi har mange års erfaring med både små og store projekter - alt fra kunstgræsbaner, boliger, motorveje, jernbaner/metro til store broforbindelser. Derudover hjælper vi vores kunder med miljødelen i anlægsprojekter, hvor specielt overskudsjord ofte er en betydelig del af projektet. Vores analyser udføres på en række forskellige materialer til anlægsprojekter heriblandt vejmaterialer og tilslagsmaterialer til beton og asfalt (grus-, sand, ler samt materialer stabiliseret med cement og/eller kalk).

JobbeskrivelseHos Eurofins VBM Laboratoriet A/S i Ishøj søger vi på nuværende tidspunkt en dygtig og energisk laborantpraktikant med tiltrædelse 1..februar 2027Du vil blive en del af en af verdens største og mest ambitiøse laboratorievirksomheder, hvor du kan se frem til et spændende udviklings- og læringsforløb. I din tid som laborantpraktikant vil du indgå i vores forskellige laboratorieteams sammen med dygtige og engagerede arbejdskollegaer.Hos os har du mulighed for at præge hverdagen, hvad enten det angår idéer til nye arbejdsområder, brug af ny teknologi eller andre tiltag til gavn for både virksomhed og medarbejdere. Der er meget kort vej mellem ledelsen og medarbejderne og koblet med en uformel stemning, søger vi at få det meste ud af vores medarbejderes viden og idéer.Hvis du har lyst til at arbejde på et laboratorium med de ovenstående værdier, hvor fleksibilitet, alsidighed, og troværdighed er i højsædet, er Eurofins VBM Laboratoriet A/S noget for dig.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil indebære:

  • Vejtekniske laboratorieforsøg

  • Arbejde med og vedligehold af udstyr og maskiner, fx sigter, vibrationsbord og standard proctor

  • Kvalitetsarbejde i henhold til ISO 17025 (DANAK)

Kvalifikationer

Faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har afsluttet grundforløbet på en laborantskole eller Erhvervsakademi

  • Du har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsforbedringer og optimering af eksisterende processer under anvendelse af bl.a. LEAN

  • Du forstår, skriver og taler dansk, samt har godt kendskab til IT og Office-pakken

Personlige kvalifikationer

  • Du arbejder godt selvstændigt, har gode samarbejdsevner og en fleksibel indstilling til tingene

  • Du er villig til at udfordre traditioner i forhold til at effektivisere processer

  • Du er mødestabil, positiv og har et stort drive

  • Du er kvalitets- og ansvarsbevidst og arbejder struktureret og systematisk  

  • Du har flair for at planlægge arbejdsdagen og få afsluttet dine opgaver

  • Flere arbejdsprocesser kan være fysisk krævende, hvorfor det er vigtigt, at du trives med dette

Yderligere oplysninger

Vi tilbyder:Et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel omgangstone. Du bliver en del af en dynamisk og fremadrettet international virksomhed, der er blandt verdens største laboratorier. Forløber og afsluttes dit praktikforløb tilfredsstillende, vil der være mulighed for fastansættelse efterfølgende.

Tiltrædelse og ansættelsesperiode:Tiltrædelse 1.februar 2027. Der er tale om en lønnet fuldtidspraktikperiode på et år.

Arbejdstider:Vi har flekstid og dine ugentlige 37 timer vil være i tidsrummet mellem kl. 07.00-17.00 på hverdage.

Arbejdssted:Baldershøj 9, 2635 Ishøj

Vil du vide mereDu kan læse mere om Eurofins VBM Laboratoriet A/S på www.VBMlab.dk og www.eurofins.dk.

AnsøgningSend dit CV, ansøgning, uddannelsespapir og andre relevante bilag ved at klikke på "søg jobbet" hurtigst muligt. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat og opfordrer derfor til, at du ansøger hurtigst muligt. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier. På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 63.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 60 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.I 2024 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 6,515 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

jobs.title: Census Field Support Officer
jobs.description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. In some cases, you may be required to make repeat visits to homes to ensure that the householder is aware of and supported to take part in the census.A mobile phone will be provided with a census field app to show you the map of your area and the list of homes to visit. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.
