jobs.title: Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline.




As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI.

 - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way.

 - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Creative
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Creative is how millions of people first meet Replit, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 500 buyer. Our product lets anyone turn an idea into working software. The creative challenge is making that feel obvious, exciting and human, whether you’re talking to someone who has never written a line of code or a CIO deciding how their company will build. We believe enterprise marketing doesn’t have to look like enterprise marketing, and we’re looking for the creative leader who believes that too.

As Executive Creative Director, you'll own the creative vision for everything Replit puts into the world: brand campaigns, product launches, the website, social and demand generation. You'll lead our in-house team of designers, and partner closely with product, product marketing, enterprise marketing and the executive team. You'll find the big ideas, sell them to leadership, and get them made at Replit's speed.

This is the right role if you’ve led integrated work that shaped culture and moved the business, both at agencies and inside tech companies, and across consumer and B2B brands. You can write and art direct well enough to tell a good idea from a great one, and you’d rather build an in-house creative engine than manage a roster of agencies.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the creative vision: Define how Replit looks, sounds and feels across every touchpoint, from major brand moments to product launches to everyday social

 - Lead big ideas end to end: Take integrated campaigns from brief to concept to production across film, OOH, social, web, events and paid, all organized around a single idea

 - Raise the craft bar: Push for higher production value, especially in video and motion, and know when to push for perfect and when to ship

 - Build and lead the team: Manage and develop designers, art directors and copywriters, grow senior talent into leaders, and hire where the team has gaps

 - Run the creative engine: Own intake, briefing and creative review so work comes in early with a clear strategy and goes out on-brand; decide what stays in-house, what goes to freelancers, and when an agency or production partner is worth it

 - Make AI part of the craft: Build AI creative tools into how the team concepts, produces and iterates, with a clear point of view on where human taste matters most

 - Champion the work: Present and defend creative to executives and cross-functional partners with clear strategic rationale and conviction




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 12+ years of creative leadership at a top agency and/or an in-house consumer tech brand, with a portfolio of culturally relevant work that drove business results

 - Conceptual and craft range across verbal and visual: campaign ideas, brand platforms, verbal identity and art direction

 - Proven experience at both B2C and B2B brands and businesses, leading integrated campaigns across film, social, OOH, digital and experiential

 - Strong video and motion instincts, including directing higher-production shoots with production partners

 - Track record of building or scaling an in-house creative team, and recruiting, developing and retaining top talent

 - Experience making complex or technical products simple, emotional and accessible

 - Executive presence: you can sell a bold idea to a CEO and explain why it matters to the business

 - Comfort in a fast, lean, ambiguous environment where you set the strategy and stay hands-on in the work

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at an AI, developer-tool or product-led growth company

 - Hands-on use of generative AI creative tools, with evidence of building them into team workflows

 - Work recognized at Cannes, D&AD or One Show

 - Active Replit user, you've built and shipped something with the product



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 25. Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Ur.broj: 857/2023 od 18. 10. 2023.g., Odluke o izmjenama i dopunama Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Urbroj: 649/2024 od 15. 7. 2024.g. i Odluke o izmjenama i dopunama Statuta Ustanove Zagreb film Urbroj: 240/2026 od 14. 4. 2026.g., te članka 8. Pravilnika o radu br.359/2023 od 16. 5. 2023.g., Ustanova Zagreb film, Zagreb, Vlaška 70, raspisuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ za radno mjesto tehničar u održavanju (m/ž) 1 izvršitelj/ica, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, uz probni rad od 2 mjeseca Uvjeti za radno mjesto: • SSS tehničke struke • najmanje 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima • koeficijent 3,60.

Opis poslova i radnih zadataka: • obavljanje redovnih obilazaka objekta i opreme i njihov pregled • upravljanje sustavima grijanja, klimatizacije i ventilacije • obavljanje manjih popravaka i domarskih poslova • obavljanje jednostavnijih održavanja, ukoliko ne remete jamstvene uvjete (npr. čišćenje filtera: split klima uređaji, ventilokonvektori, zamjena filtera na rekuperacijskim jedinicama i klima komorama i sl.) • koordinacija vanjskih izvođača prilikom obavljanja radova • redovito tjedno paljenje diesel električnog agregata (DEA) i rad u praznom hodu u trajanju od 10 minuta (ukoliko postoji) • koordinacija dovoza goriva za potrebe Diesel-električnog agregata (DEA) na objektu (ukoliko postoji) • skladištenje zamjenjivih dijelova tehničkog otpada (baterije, toneri i sl.) • obavljanje manjih preseljenja • montaža projekcijskih plata i spajanje prezentacijske opreme • obavljanje svečanog uređenja objekta za praznike • briga oko rasporeda i pripreme soba za sastanke • prilagođavanje pomičnih pregradnih stijena u multifunkcijskim dvoranama • poslovi montaže i demontaže • popravak namještaja • organizacija odvoza i zbrinjavanje dijela otpada (papir, plastika) s objekta • obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu ravnatelja.

Probni rad: 2 mjeseca.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi upotrijebljeni u ovom javnom natječaju, a koji imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod, bez obzira na to u kojem su rodu navedeni.

Dokumentacija koju su kandidati, u elektroničkom obliku, obvezni priložiti: - prijava (mora sadržavati osnovne informacije o kandidatu – ime, prezime, kontakt podaci: adresa, telefon, adresa elektroničke pošte) - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (presliku svjedodžbe) - dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje zajedno sa potvrdom o vrsti poslova i razdoblju njihovog obavljanja, ugovori o radu, ugovori o djelu i ostali odgovarajući dokazi) - uvjerenje pribavljeno od nadležnog suda ili sustavom e-Građani da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja) - životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada (potpisan od strane prijavitelja/prijaviteljice).

U slučaju da kandidat sve potrebne podatke iz prijave dostavi u tekstu elektroničke pošte prilikom slanja dokumentacije uz prijavu na natječaj, smatrat će se da je kandidat poslao potpunu prijavu. Obveznu dokumentaciju potrebno je priložiti u PDF formatu, svaki dokument kao zasebni prilog. Dokazi koji se dostavljaju moraju biti na hrvatskom jeziku i latiničnom pismu, odnosno kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku, dužni su uz istu dostaviti i ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Iz priložene dokumentacije mora biti nedvojbeno jasno ispunjenje uvjeta propisanih natječajem. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista).

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju. Osoba čija je prijava nepravodobna ili nepotpuna odnosno osoba koja ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj, niti će biti pozvana na dopunu istih.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete bit će pozvani na kvalifikacijski razgovor s Povjerenstvom za provedbu natječaja u cilju utvrđivanja organizacijskih vještina te snalažljivosti kandidata u zadanim okolnostima, o čemu će biti obaviješteni e-poštom.

Prijave na natječaj s traženom obveznom dokumentacijom poslati elektroničkom poštom na mail adresu: antonela.copo@zagrebfilm.hr

Naslov: NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO TEHNIČAR U ODRŽAVANJU Elektronička pošta s prijavom i svom dokumentacijom ne smije biti veća od 25 MB. Kandidati će dobiti povratnu elektroničku poruku s potvrdom zaprimanja prijave.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je petnaest (15) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Ustanove Zagreb film.

Primitak prijave u propisanom roku utvrđuje se uvidom u vrijeme primitka elektroničke pošte . Prijavom na natječaj prijavitelji su izričito suglasni da Ustanova Zagreb film kao voditelj obrade može prikupljati, koristiti se i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajne procedure, sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni elektroničkom poštom a Odluka o rezultatima bit će objavljena i na mrežnim stranicama Ustanove Zagreb film sukladno članku 10. stavku 1. točka 10. Zakona o pravu na pristup informacijama (Narodne novine broj: 25/13, 85/15, 69/22).

Provoditelj natječaja zadržava pravo ne izabrati nijednog kandidata i poništiti natječaj.

jobs.title: PRODAJNI MENADŽER/MENADŽERICA PRIVATNOG SMJEŠTAJA
jobs.description:
Lokacija: Dubrovnik (mogućnost povremenog remote rada) Industrija: Turizam / Kratkoročni najam smještaja Vrsta zaposlenja: Puno radno vrijeme

Tvoja uloga u Direct Bookeru

Tražimo ambicioznu i prodajno orijentiranu osobu koja zna prepoznati priliku, izgraditi povjerenje i zatvoriti suradnju koja donosi stvarnu vrijednost. Kao Prodajni Menadžer, tvoj zadatak bit će širenje naše mreže privatnog smještaja u Hrvatskoj – uz maksimalnu podršku iskusnog tima i fleksibilnost rada od kuće.

Ovo je prilika da aktivno oblikuješ budućnost turizma, a istovremeno izgradiš karijeru u rastućoj globalnoj kompaniji.

Što ćeš raditi:

? Proaktivno pronalaziti i kontaktirati vlasnike apartmana, vila i kuća za odmor putem poziva, preporuka, društvenih mreža, sajmova i drugih kanala. ? Jasno i uvjerljivo predstaviti prednosti partnerstva s Direct Bookerom – uz korištenje komercijalnih analiza i konkretnih benefita. ? Voditi pregovore i izrađivati ponude koje zadovoljavaju obje strane. ? Graditi dugoročne odnose s partnerima i biti njihova kontakt osoba od povjerenja.

✅ Tražimo te ako:

? Imaš iskustva u B2C/B2B prodaji (idealno u turizmu, ugostiteljstvu ili najmu smještaja). ? Uspješno si razvijao/la partnerske odnose i ostvarivao/la prodajne ciljeve. ? Odlično komuniciraš i znaš prepoznati što je važno klijentima. ? Vješt/a si u samostalnom radu i donošenju strateških odluka.

Što nudimo:

✨ Ravnotežu između privatnog i poslovnog života ✨ Ugovor na određeno s mogućnošću stalnog zaposlenja ✨ Podršku i mentorstvo unutar pozitivne, motivirajuće radne okoline ✨ Bonusi za rezultate – bez gornje granice!

Zašto Direct Booker?

Direct Booker je dio međunarodnog brenda Belvilla by OYO / PRISM, lidera u upravljanju kratkoročnim najmom. Radit ćeš lokalno, ali kao dio velike globalne mreže. Zajedno mijenjamo način na koji ljudi putuju i iznajmljuju – budi dio te promjene!

Zainteresiran/a?

Prijavi se danas i napravi korak prema karijeri u kojoj tvoja energija i ideje čine razliku. Direct Booker čeka tebe!

jobs.title: Program Manager, Office of the CEO (PMO)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Program Manager to operationalize the CEO's external presence and growth work: founder-led marketing, founder-led sales, investor relations, and strategic go-to-market (GTM) efforts around the world. Reporting to the Chief of Staff and working on strategic special projects, you will turn the CEO's priorities into repeatable systems, clear workplans, and completed actions.

This is an execution-heavy role. You should be equally comfortable building a founder-led sales playbook, preparing an investor update, and following up on an overdue deliverable. Success requires strong judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and a willingness to take on both high-impact initiatives and the routine work that keeps them moving.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



FOUNDER-LED MARKETING

 - Build and run the operating system for the CEO's marketing presence: content calendar, speaking and event schedule, media and podcast opportunities, and social channels.

 - Turn the CEO's ideas, conversations, and public moments into repeatable content, working with Brand, Comms, and Content teams.

 - Set up intake, approval, and review workflows so the CEO's time goes to the highest-leverage appearances and posts.

 - Track reach, engagement, and pipeline influence, and report what is working.



FOUNDER-LED SALES

 - Operationalize the CEO's role in the sales motion: target account lists, executive outreach, customer and partner meetings, and follow-up.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, and RevOps to prepare briefs, talking points, and next steps for every CEO-involved deal.

 - Maintain a tracker of CEO-sourced and CEO-assisted opportunities with owners, stages, and commitments.

 - Document the playbook so founder involvement scales without adding burden to the CEO.



INVESTOR RELATIONS SUPPORT

 - Support the preparation of investor updates, board materials, and fundraising and diligence materials.

 - Maintain the investor and stakeholder tracker: relationships, meetings, asks, and follow-ups.

 - Coordinate data requests across Finance, Legal, and functional leaders, and check inputs for accuracy and consistency before review.

 - Prepare briefing documents for investor meetings and other external engagements.



STRATEGIC GTM, GLOBALLY

 - Support GTM strategy and execution across regions, including market entry, partnerships, government and ecosystem engagement, and regional events.

 - Coordinate with regional teams and partners across time zones, local requirements, and travel logistics.

 - Translate initiatives into workplans with defined scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Surface cross-regional insights and delivery risks early, with clear recommendations.



STRATEGIC SPECIAL PROJECTS AND OPERATING CADENCE

 - Own time-sensitive special projects assigned by the Chief of Staff, from scoping through close-out.

 - Run project check-ins, maintain issue and decision logs, and escalate missed commitments or unresolved dependencies.

 - Build agendas, collect pre-reads, and document decisions and action items for recurring leadership and planning meetings.

 - Maintain trackers, dashboards, and scorecards for priorities, programs, and milestones, reporting to the Chief of Staff.

 - Document standard operating procedures, and replace repetitive manual work with templates, tools, and AI-enabled automation.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience in program management, business operations, chief of staff or executive operations, GTM operations, or a comparable execution-focused role.

 - Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects and recurring operational processes.

 - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to maintain detailed trackers and manage competing deadlines.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex inputs into concise executive materials.

 - Proficiency with AI. Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and make practical decisions with incomplete information.

 - Discretion with confidential investor, customer, and company information.

 - Willingness to perform hands-on administrative and logistical work alongside program management responsibilities.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or Chief of Staff.

 - Experience in marketing, sales, or investor relations at a fast-paced or high-growth company.

 - Experience working across regions or with international teams and partners.

 - Experience preparing board and investor materials.

 - Experience improving workflows through automation and AI-enabled tools.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The CEO's marketing and sales activity runs on clear systems, with consistent output and few last-minute scrambles.

 - Every founder-involved deal has a brief, an owner, and tracked follow-up.

 - Investor materials are accurate, on time, and consistent across audiences.

 - Global GTM initiatives have clear ownership and steady progress against agreed milestones.

 - The Chief of Staff has a clear, current view of priorities, risks, and decisions needed.

 - Routine requests and operational issues are resolved with minimal CEO involvement.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers.

 - By your 90th day:
   
   - Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide.
   
   - Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization.
   
   - Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions.

 - By the end of your first year:
   
   - Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment.
   
   - Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes.

 - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment—the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions.

 - Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments.

 - Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on.

 - Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings.

 - 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We're hiring our first FDE in the UK! Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.

 

You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.

 

Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

Enterprise Marketing is responsible for driving B2B pipeline and revenue at Replit. The team partners closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, and Growth to engage enterprise buyers and turn demand into qualified opportunities. With millions of individual users already in the product, Replit has a unique opportunity to connect product-led adoption with enterprise growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Senior Manager, Demand Generation to lead integrated campaigns that accelerate enterprise pipeline and revenue growth at Replit. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of full-funnel programs that win new customers and expand adoption within existing accounts.

Reporting to the Director / Sr. Director of Demand and Digital, you’ll partner with Product Marketing to translate Replit’s AI capabilities, positioning, and customer use cases into compelling campaigns for technical and business audiences. You’ll build account-based programs, launch targeted campaigns, and work closely with Sales to turn engagement into qualified opportunities.

You’ll bring deep channel expertise and partner with channel owners to optimize spend, improve conversion, and allocate budget toward programs that deliver the strongest pipeline and revenue impact. This is a hands-on role that combines strategic planning with detailed execution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own campaign strategy and pipeline results. Build and execute enterprise demand generation programs with clear audiences, offers, pipeline goals, and measures of success.

 - Build enterprise campaign playbooks. Create repeatable programs across account-based marketing, webinars, content syndication, email nurture, and integrated field marketing.

 - Develop account-based programs. Partner with Sales to select high-value accounts, identify buying groups, and coordinate multi-touch campaigns with relevant sales outreach.

 - Own land-and-expand campaigns. Develop and execute integrated programs across new customer acquisition and account expansion. Partner with Sales to prioritize target accounts and buying groups, tailor campaigns to customer use cases, and generate qualified pipeline for new business, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.

 - Shape campaign messaging and creative. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, and Design to develop compelling assets and offers across the buyer journey, from awareness through opportunity progression.

 - Test and improve performance. Experiment with audiences, messaging, creative formats, calls to action, and landing pages to improve conversion and pipeline quality. Partner with the paid media optimization team to apply findings across campaigns.

 - Connect product-led growth with enterprise sales. Identify expansion signals within Replit’s individual user base and build programs that nurture high-potential users and accounts toward enterprise adoption.

 - Strengthen lead management and sales handoff. Work with Sales, SDRs, and RevOps on targeting, lead scoring, qualification, routing, and follow-up. Partner with Product and Analytics on product-qualified lead signals.

 - Measure and communicate business impact. Track campaign contribution, funnel conversion, and program efficiency. Bring clear insights and recommendations to business reviews, including where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.

 - Deliver high-quality execution. Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and cross-functional dependencies. Coordinate internal teams and external partners to launch programs on time and turn successful experiments into repeatable playbooks.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - A strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.

 - 10+ years of demand generation experience, including 5+ years in B2B SaaS focused on enterprise customers.

 - A proven track record of building and scaling demand generation programs with measurable pipeline contribution and ROI.

 - Expertise with account-based marketing, including account selection, multi-channel campaigns, engagement measurement, and creative development.

 - Experience developing lead scoring, qualification, and funnel optimization approaches in partnership with Sales and RevOps.

 - Strong analytical skills and a disciplined approach to experimentation—connecting data across sources, interpreting results, and translating findings into action.

 - The ability to provide clear campaign briefs and creative direction while partnering effectively with Content, Product Marketing, and Design.

 - Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, with the ability to move from strategy to hands-on execution.

 - Must have a strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.

jobs.title: TRAKTORIST/TRAKTORISTICA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA:

  • prima radne zadatke i upute od Voditelja Sektora proizvodnje i Tehnologa mehanizacije
  • prije početka rada dužan je pregledati stroj ili opremu i o učenim nedostacima obavijestiti nadređenog, a nakon završetka rada stroj i ostala sredstva rada ostaviti uredne i o eventualnim nedostacima ili opasnostima obavijestiti nadređenog
  • obavlja prijevoz roba i proizvoda unutar i izvan Društva
  • radi na osnovnom obrađivanju zemljišta i pripremi zemljišta za sjetvu
  • radi na sjetvi
  • radi na zaštiti usjeva od bolesti, štetočina i korova
  • ubire proizvode (žetva, vršidba, vađenje, siliranje, kosidba i dr.)
  • održava strojeve
  • podešava priključne strojeve
  • radi sa žetvenim strojevima
  • vodi evidencije o izvršnom radu i utrošku goriva i maziva
  • obavlja sitne popravke na strojevima
  • rukovodi djelatnicima koji su dodijeljeni kao pratioci kod pojedinih poslova (sjetva, prskanje, žetva, raspodjeljivanje gnojiva i sl.)
  • pomaže kod obavljanja većih popravaka na traktoru (remont)
  • razni utovari i istovari
  • radi sa sredstvima za zaštitu bilja
  • radi na njezi kultura: kopanje, prorjeđivanje, zakidanje, zalamanje, navodnjavanje
  • radi na berbi i vađenju: pratilac kombajna, utovar, istovar, uskladištenje vreća, utovar i istovar i kamarenje slame – sijena po potrebi berba kukuruza, vađenje repe i krumpira

UVJETI:

  • KV- tehničkog usmjerenja
  • Jedna godina radnog iskustva na poslovima traktoriste
  • Vozačka dozvola B ili G kategorije
  • Stručno osposobljavanje za rukovatelja traktorom
  • Izobrazba o održivoj uporabi pesticida za korisnika

NUDIMO:

  • ugovor na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zasnivanja stalnog radnog odnosa,
  • mogućnost napredovanja i dodatnog usavršavanja,
  • timski rad, dinamično i stabilno poslovno okruženje

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description: Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.Your responsibilities:Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership TeamContribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function. Your background:Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controlsResults-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skillsStrong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organizationAbility to translate financial and operational insights into actions10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilitiesDigital mindset with proof record on digital innovationsYour benefits:Attractive compensation & benefitsEmployee Assistance Program GlobalParental Leave ProgramWe look forward to receiving your application. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - UAE
Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

 - Fluency in Italian or Spanish
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €153,000-€171,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working
   
   

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.

 - Fluency in additional languages

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients
